scope.market_definition: The Medical Alert Systems market encompasses devices and services designed to provide emergency assistance to individuals, particularly the elderly or those with health conditions. Participants include manufacturers, service providers, and technology developers, operating globally to enhance safety and health monitoring.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the production of medical alert devices, including wearables and stationary units.
This layer includes companies that provide monitoring and emergency response services associated with medical alert systems.
This layer focuses on the development of software applications that enhance the functionality of medical alert systems.

relevant_companies.company_summary: ADT Health specializes in providing comprehensive security solutions, including professional installation and DIY options for home and business security systems. Their core offerings encompass a range of products such as cameras, sensors, and smart home devices, aimed at enhancing safety for residential and commercial clients. With a focus on health and senior safety, ADT Health caters to a diverse market seeking reliable monitoring and protection services.

# When Seconds Matter, Bay Alarm Medical Delivers

Bay Alarm Medical is committed to providing fast and reliable 24/7 emergency response services to
help seniors and families stay safe and independent. We promise to be there in any crisis and aim to
turn emergencies into manageable moments of care and support.

[Image][Image]
[Image][Image]
Mission, Vision & Core Values

## Our Commitment to You

#### Our Mission

Delivering peace of mind to families and their loved ones at every stage of aging.

#### Our Vision

Helping families love longer, laugh longer, live longer.

#### Our Core Values

Commitment to our customers: To always C.A.R.E. (Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Ethics)
and to give our customers everything they need and none of the extra gimmicks that they don’t.

To ensure that all of our services and policies are designed to protect our customers and to treat
our customers as if they were our own loved ones. To protect customer data and personal information,
and to make our customer’s well being and safety a top priority.

Commitment to our company: To employ caring and ethical individuals who treat our business as though
it is their own. To roll up our sleeves and work hard to support the company initiatives and to
embrace change. To support company growth without compromising integrity and to always deliver more
than expected.

Commitment to our employees: To maintain an open-door policy and to always be honest. To be
supportive of our employee’s growth and career paths. To be respectful and to invest in our
employees so they can be successful here and hopefully in all areas of life.

Company History

## How We Got Started

Founded in 1946 by Marj and Everett Westphal (pictured), Bay Alarm had a straightforward goal: work
diligently, maintain honesty, treat everyone like family, and provide top-notch service. Throughout
the decades, the Westphal family has stayed dedicated to nurturing Bay Alarm and it’s subsidaries,
caring for its workforce, and safeguarding its clients. Now, their grandson Matt Westphal leads Bay
Alarm Medical as its owner and CEO.

[Image][Image]
OUR LEGACY

Marj and Everett Westphal founded Bay Alarm to serve families and businesses.

The Westphal family launches a dedicated medical alert company.

#### Code of Ethics Launched

To address the issue of the elderly being the biggest target for scammers.

2012

#### First GPS Device Introduced

Our first GPS-enabled mobile medical alert system is introduced.

2015

#### Getsafe is Introduced

Getsafe introduces the first medical alert system that truly didn't "need to be worn"

2019

#### SOS Smartwatch Introduced

We launch our award-winning SOS Smartwatch.

2020

#### Top Rated by Consumer Report

Bay Alarm Medical was recognized in Consumer Reports’ 2020 review of medical alert systems

2022

#### 16,500+ 5-Star Google Reviews

The Westphal family launches a dedicated medical alert company.

found the reset button to be inconveniently located. That said, it’s the best medical alert system

affordable and flexible pricing plans.

# When Seconds Matter, Bay Alarm Medical Delivers

Bay Alarm Medical is committed to providing fast and reliable 24/7 emergency response services to
help seniors and families stay safe and independent. We promise to be there in any crisis and aim to
turn emergencies into manageable moments of care and support.

[Image][Image]
[Image][Image]
Mission, Vision & Core Values

## Our Commitment to You

#### Our Mission

Delivering peace of mind to families and their loved ones at every stage of aging.

#### Our Vision

Helping families love longer, laugh longer, live longer.

#### Our Core Values

Commitment to our customers: To always C.A.R.E. (Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Ethics)
and to give our customers everything they need and none of the extra gimmicks that they don’t.

To ensure that all of our services and policies are designed to protect our customers and to treat
our customers as if they were our own loved ones. To protect customer data and personal information,
and to make our customer’s well being and safety a top priority.

Commitment to our company: To employ caring and ethical individuals who treat our business as though
it is their own. To roll up our sleeves and work hard to support the company initiatives and to
embrace change. To support company growth without compromising integrity and to always deliver more
than expected.

Commitment to our employees: To maintain an open-door policy and to always be honest. To be
supportive of our employee’s growth and career paths. To be respectful and to invest in our
employees so they can be successful here and hopefully in all areas of life.

Company History

Founded in 1946 by Marj and Everett Westphal (pictured), Bay Alarm had a straightforward goal: work
diligently, maintain honesty, treat everyone like family, and provide top-notch service. Throughout
the decades, the Westphal family has stayed dedicated to nurturing Bay Alarm and it’s subsidaries,
caring for its workforce, and safeguarding its clients. Now, their grandson Matt Westphal leads Bay
Alarm Medical as its owner and CEO.

The Bay Alarm Medical In-Home Medical Alert ($27.95 per month) is a moderately priced, no-contract
personal emergency response system that’s a breeze to install and use. It delivered quick response
times in testing, and its two-way hands-free communication is excellent. We love the base unit’s
extra-large help button, and the pendant help button’s solid in-home and outdoor range, though we
found the reset button to be inconveniently located. That said, it’s the best medical alert system
we’ve tested, and our Editors’ Choice… The company also gets our recommendation for having the most
affordable and flexible pricing plans.

John R. Delaney | Contributing Editor, PCMag

The Bay Alarm Medical On-The-Go GPS Help Button is small, simply designed and easy to use. Even
better, the response times to my calls were so quick that it gave me a real sense of confidence in
the system’s ability to provide emergency help rapidly and effectively when needed.

Nicole Gregory | Contributor, Forbes Health

Bay Alarm Medical is our top pick for the “Best Customer Service & Pricing Plans” for medical alert
systems and is one of our overall top picks out of 23 companies reviewed. It particularly excelled
in the “Reliability and Reputation” category, which measures the company qualities that impact the
customer experience.

Christopher Norman, GNP | Senior Care Expert Contributor, Caring.com

Offering systems that work on either a landline or cellular connection, Bay Alarm Medical is one of
the best in-home medical alert systems.

**Affordable pricing:** With no long-term contracts, Bay Alarm Medical offers affordable pricing
options starting at $24.95 a month, making them one of the most affordable medical alert providers.

**No long-term contracts**: Companies like Life Alert require you to lock into three-year contracts;
however, Bay Alarm Medical allows you to pay month-to-month, canceling at any time..

Amie Clark | Co-Founder & Senior Editor, TheSeniorList

**Best in-home medical alert:** Starting at $20 per month, $0 device fee, $0 activation fee.

Home-based medical alert devices are ideal for those who don’t leave the house often. They can’t be
used on the go (like at the grocery store), since they have to stay connected to an in-home base
unit. They work in the yard or even a few houses down, as long as you find one with good range —
like this medical alert from Bay Alarm Medical.

**Best medical alert smartwatch:** $30 per month, $179 for device.

Some medical alert watches require a smartphone, but the Bay Alarm SOS Smartwatch is functional all
on its own. It has two-way calling, so if you press the help button, you can talk directly to the
dispatcher through the smartwatch (and you can also talk to your loved ones). It also features
location tracking and a built-in step tracker. The battery life ranges from six to 18 hours,
depending on usage, and the device is water resistant with a rating of IP67.

Kim Wong-Shing | Senior Associate Editor, CNET

**Why we chose Bay Alarm Medical:** Bay Alarm Medical covers all the bases with one of the lowest
monthly fees in the market, while also providing free in-home device with no contract attached.

Bay Alarm Medical starts at $24.95 a month for a base station and one wearable medical alert button,
in step with industry prices. What pushes it over the top is pairing it with no hidden charges for
device fees or activation fees (which can often cost as much as $99), and no contract. This makes
their basic in-home package an ideal medical alert system if you’re on a budget.

Their mobile subscription is also on the less-expensive side at $29.95 per month. The SOS All-In-One
lets you bundle the mobile medical alert button with GPS tracking and 4G LTE along with the in-home
unit for $39.95.

For home landline systems, Bay Alarm is one of the best deals you can get.

Nicole Gregory | Contributor, Forbes Health

# When Seconds Matter, Bay Alarm Medical Delivers

Bay Alarm Medical is committed to providing fast and reliable 24/7 emergency response services to
help seniors and families stay safe and independent. We promise to be there in any crisis and aim to
turn emergencies into manageable moments of care and support.

[Image][Image]
[Image][Image]
Mission, Vision & Core Values

## Our Commitment to You

#### Our Mission

Delivering peace of mind to families and their loved ones at every stage of aging.

#### Our Vision

Helping families love longer, laugh longer, live longer.

#### Our Core Values

Commitment to our customers: To always C.A.R.E. (Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Ethics)
and to give our customers everything they need and none of the extra gimmicks that they don’t.

To ensure that all of our services and policies are designed to protect our customers and to treat
our customers as if they were our own loved ones. To protect customer data and personal information,
and to make our customer’s well being and safety a top priority.

Commitment to our company: To employ caring and ethical individuals who treat our business as though
it is their own. To roll up our sleeves and work hard to support the company initiatives and to
embrace change. To support company growth without compromising integrity and to always deliver more
than expected.

Commitment to our employees: To maintain an open-door policy and to always be honest. To be
supportive of our employee’s growth and career paths. To be respectful and to invest in our
employees so they can be successful here and hopefully in all areas of life.

Company History

## How We Got Started

Founded in 1946 by Marj and Everett Westphal (pictured), Bay Alarm had a straightforward goal: work
diligently, maintain honesty, treat everyone like family, and provide top-notch service. Throughout
the decades, the Westphal family has stayed dedicated to nurturing Bay Alarm and it’s subsidaries,
caring for its workforce, and safeguarding its clients. Now, their grandson Matt Westphal leads Bay
Alarm Medical as its owner and CEO.

[Image][Image]

## America’s #1 Rated Medical Alert Provider

The Bay Alarm Medical In-Home Medical Alert ($27.95 per month) is a moderately priced, no-contract
personal emergency response system that’s a breeze to install and use. It delivered quick response
times in testing, and its two-way hands-free communication is excellent. We love the base unit’s
extra-large help button, and the pendant help button’s solid in-home and outdoor range, though we
found the reset button to be inconveniently located. That said, it’s the best medical alert system
we’ve tested, and our Editors’ Choice… The company also gets our recommendation for having the most
affordable and flexible pricing plans.

John R. Delaney | Contributing Editor, PCMag

The Bay Alarm Medical On-The-Go GPS Help Button is small, simply designed and easy to use. Even
better, the response times to my calls were so quick that it gave me a real sense of confidence in
the system’s ability to provide emergency help rapidly and effectively when needed.

Nicole Gregory | Contributor, Forbes Health

Bay Alarm Medical is our top pick for the “Best Customer Service & Pricing Plans” for medical alert
systems and is one of our overall top picks out of 23 companies reviewed. It particularly excelled
in the “Reliability and Reputation” category, which measures the company qualities that impact the
customer experience.

Christopher Norman, GNP | Senior Care Expert Contributor, Caring.com

Offering systems that work on either a landline or cellular connection, Bay Alarm Medical is one of
the best in-home medical alert systems.

**Affordable pricing:** With no long-term contracts, Bay Alarm Medical offers affordable pricing
options starting at $24.95 a month, making them one of the most affordable medical alert providers.

**No long-term contracts**: Companies like Life Alert require you to lock into three-year contracts;
however, Bay Alarm Medical allows you to pay month-to-month, canceling at any time..

Amie Clark | Co-Founder & Senior Editor, TheSeniorList

**Best in-home medical alert:** Starting at $20 per month, $0 device fee, $0 activation fee.

Home-based medical alert devices are ideal for those who don’t leave the house often. They can’t be
used on the go (like at the grocery store), since they have to stay connected to an in-home base
unit. They work in the yard or even a few houses down, as long as you find one with good range —
like this medical alert from Bay Alarm Medical.

**Best medical alert smartwatch:** $30 per month, $179 for device.

Some medical alert watches require a smartphone, but the Bay Alarm SOS Smartwatch is functional all
on its own. It has two-way calling, so if you press the help button, you can talk directly to the
dispatcher through the smartwatch (and you can also talk to your loved ones). It also features
location tracking and a built-in step tracker. The battery life ranges from six to 18 hours,
depending on usage, and the device is water resistant with a rating of IP67.

Kim Wong-Shing | Senior Associate Editor, CNET

**Why we chose Bay Alarm Medical:** Bay Alarm Medical covers all the bases with one of the lowest
monthly fees in the market, while also providing free in-home device with no contract attached.

Bay Alarm Medical starts at $24.95 a month for a base station and one wearable medical alert button,
in step with industry prices. What pushes it over the top is pairing it with no hidden charges for
device fees or activation fees (which can often cost as much as $99), and no contract. This makes
their basic in-home package an ideal medical alert system if you’re on a budget.

Their mobile subscription is also on the less-expensive side at $29.95 per month. The SOS All-In-One
lets you bundle the mobile medical alert button with GPS tracking and 4G LTE along with the in-home
unit for $39.95.

For home landline systems, Bay Alarm is one of the best deals you can get.

Nicole Gregory | Contributor, Forbes Health

**Affordable pricing:** With no long-term contracts, Bay Alarm Medical offers affordable pricing
options starting at $24.95 a month, making them one of the most affordable medical alert providers.

**No long-term contracts**: Companies like Life Alert require you to lock into three-year contracts;
however, Bay Alarm Medical allows you to pay month-to-month, canceling at any time..

Amie Clark | Co-Founder & Senior Editor, TheSeniorList

**Best in-home medical alert:** Starting at $20 per month, $0 device fee, $0 activation fee.

Home-based medical alert devices are ideal for those who don’t leave the house often. They can’t be
used on the go (like at the grocery store), since they have to stay connected to an in-home base
unit. They work in the yard or even a few houses down, as long as you find one with good range —
like this medical alert from Bay Alarm Medical.

**Best medical alert smartwatch:** $30 per month, $179 for device.

Some medical alert watches require a smartphone, but the Bay Alarm SOS Smartwatch is functional all
on its own. It has two-way calling, so if you press the help button, you can talk directly to the
dispatcher through the smartwatch (and you can also talk to your loved ones). It also features
location tracking and a built-in step tracker. The battery life ranges from six to 18 hours,
depending on usage, and the device is water resistant with a rating of IP67.

Kim Wong-Shing | Senior Associate Editor, CNET

**Why we chose Bay Alarm Medical:** Bay Alarm Medical covers all the bases with one of the lowest
monthly fees in the market, while also providing free in-home device with no contract attached.

Bay Alarm Medical starts at $24.95 a month for a base station and one wearable medical alert button,
in step with industry prices. What pushes it over the top is pairing it with no hidden charges for
device fees or activation fees (which can often cost as much as $99), and no contract. This makes
their basic in-home package an ideal medical alert system if you’re on a budget.

Their mobile subscription is also on the less-expensive side at $29.95 per month. The SOS All-In-One
lets you bundle the mobile medical alert button with GPS tracking and 4G LTE along with the in-home
unit for $39.95.

For home landline systems, Bay Alarm is one of the best deals you can get.

Nicole Gregory | Contributor, Forbes Health

## Protecting Lives and Providing Peace of Mind since 1987

## Our Legacy of Lifesaving Protection

Since our founding in 1987, Life Alert Emergency Response, Inc. has been at the forefront of medical
alert devices and technology designed with one simple goal: **To Save Lives**.

For almost 40 years, Life Alert has been the trusted name that families turn to when they need
reliable, 24/7, emergency help for their loved ones.

Life Alert is more than a medical alert system, it allows seniors and individuals with medical
conditions to live independently and safely in the comfort of their own homes while providing their
family with peace of mind.

[image for Our Legacy of Lifesaving Protection]

## The Only Medical Alert Device Proven to
## **Save a Life Every 11 Minutes³**

Your browser does not support the video tag.

Life Alert stands alone as the only medical alert device with a proven track record of saving a life
every 11 minutes.³ This remarkable statistic isn't just a number - it represents real people, real
emergencies, and real lives saved through our unwavering commitment to rapid response and reliable
technology.

Every year, thousands of members credit Life Alert with preventing injuries or saving their life.
You can read our subscriber's stories here:
[Testimonials Page][1]

We believe everyone deserves the dignity of living at home without fear. Our medical alert devices
are easy to use, lightweight, waterproof, and work even if you can't reach a phone. Life Alert
offers solutions for in-home protection and on-the-go safety, so you're covered anywhere you are.

## Endorsed by America's Surgeon General

Life Alert earned a distinction that no other company can claim: we were the only company endorsed
by former U.S. Surgeon General C. Everett Koop.

Dr. Koop, a respected voice in American healthcare, served as our spokesperson until his passing in
2013, lending his credibility and passion for public health to our mission of protecting seniors and
individuals with medical conditions.

His endorsement reflected his deep belief in our technology and our commitment to saving lives - a
testament to the quality and reliability that defines Life Alert.

[image for old man]

## A Message That Resonates

Our iconic slogan, "Help! I've fallen and I can't get up," has become more than just an advertising
campaign - it's a cultural touchstone that captured the very real fears and needs of millions of
Americans.

USA TODAY recognized it as the #1 most-memorable ad of the past 25 years, and for good reason - it
spoke directly to a genuine concern senior citizens had. Life Alert offered a simple, effective
solution.

While the phrase has entered popular culture, the serious message behind it remains unchanged. When
an emergency strikes, Life Alert is there to help, 24/7.

## Our Commitment to You

At Life Alert, we understand that behind every call for help is a person who matters - someone's
parent, grandparent, spouse, or a friend. That's why we've built our entire organization around one
principle - being there when it matters most.

Life Alert owns and operates our 24/7 U.S.-based Emergency Dispatch centers with trained dispatchers
who work together seamlessly to provide help in any emergency situation.

When you choose Life Alert, you're not just getting a medical alert device, you're gaining a partner
with almost 40 years of knowledge in senior safety and independence.

Life Alert provides you a team that's dedicated to your wellbeing, and the peace of mind that comes
from knowing help is always just a push of a button.

To learn more on how Life Alert
can help you or a loved one

# About Life Alert

## Protecting Lives and Providing Peace of Mind since 1987

## Our Legacy of Lifesaving Protection

Since our founding in 1987, Life Alert Emergency Response, Inc. has been at the forefront of medical
alert devices and technology designed with one simple goal: **To Save Lives**.

For almost 40 years, Life Alert has been the trusted name that families turn to when they need
reliable, 24/7, emergency help for their loved ones.

Life Alert is more than a medical alert system, it allows seniors and individuals with medical
conditions to live independently and safely in the comfort of their own homes while providing their
family with peace of mind.

[image for Our Legacy of Lifesaving Protection]

## The Only Medical Alert Device Proven to
## **Save a Life Every 11 Minutes³**

Your browser does not support the video tag.

Life Alert stands alone as the only medical alert device with a proven track record of saving a life
every 11 minutes.³ This remarkable statistic isn't just a number - it represents real people, real
emergencies, and real lives saved through our unwavering commitment to rapid response and reliable
technology.

Every year, thousands of members credit Life Alert with preventing injuries or saving their life.
You can read our subscriber's stories here:
[Testimonials Page][1]

We believe everyone deserves the dignity of living at home without fear. Our medical alert devices
are easy to use, lightweight, waterproof, and work even if you can't reach a phone. Life Alert
offers solutions for in-home protection and on-the-go safety, so you're covered anywhere you are.

## Endorsed by America's Surgeon General

Life Alert earned a distinction that no other company can claim: we were the only company endorsed
by former U.S. Surgeon General C. Everett Koop.

Dr. Koop, a respected voice in American healthcare, served as our spokesperson until his passing in
2013, lending his credibility and passion for public health to our mission of protecting seniors and
individuals with medical conditions.

His endorsement reflected his deep belief in our technology and our commitment to saving lives - a
testament to the quality and reliability that defines Life Alert.

[image for old man]

## A Message That Resonates

Our iconic slogan, "Help! I've fallen and I can't get up," has become more than just an advertising
campaign - it's a cultural touchstone that captured the very real fears and needs of millions of
Americans.

USA TODAY recognized it as the #1 most-memorable ad of the past 25 years, and for good reason - it
spoke directly to a genuine concern senior citizens had. Life Alert offered a simple, effective
solution.

While the phrase has entered popular culture, the serious message behind it remains unchanged. When
an emergency strikes, Life Alert is there to help, 24/7.

## Our Commitment to You

At Life Alert, we understand that behind every call for help is a person who matters - someone's
parent, grandparent, spouse, or a friend. That's why we've built our entire organization around one
principle - being there when it matters most.

Life Alert owns and operates our 24/7 U.S.-based Emergency Dispatch centers with trained dispatchers
who work together seamlessly to provide help in any emergency situation.

When you choose Life Alert, you're not just getting a medical alert device, you're gaining a partner
with almost 40 years of knowledge in senior safety and independence.

Life Alert provides you a team that's dedicated to your wellbeing, and the peace of mind that comes
from knowing help is always just a push of a button.

## When it comes to easy, *there's only one Jitterbug*

Beyond our easy-to-use devices and helpful services, discover why customers have chosen us to help
them age with confidence for 20 years.

[Why switch to Jitterbug][68]

## Loved by our customers

Meet Marcia. A real Jitterbug customer.
[Video thumbnail]

### Excellent product

The [Urgent Response} is incredible and the software allowing family to follow movement is great,
especially for persons living alone. It is a great service.

— Cynthia C.

### Great service

The response I received to my distress call was immediate. The agent stayed with me until the
ambulance arrived.

— Sam F.

### Love it

Got this for my Mom. She's 91, and this makes perfect sense!

— Royce T.

### Highly recommend

Easy to use. Features readily accessible. Friendly Help Desk.

— Bill K.

## Our services *set us apart*

From our 100% U.S.-based advisors to specially trained Urgent Response agents and Care Advocates,
our services help you feel connected, safe, and healthy.

[Smartphone displaying an app interface with 'Urgent Response' button on a blurred background]
Urgent Response

### Have an emergency?

At the touch of a button, Urgent Response connects you to certified agents who can help in
emergencies big or small. *Requires a Preferred or Premium plan.*

[Learn More ][69]
[Smartphone displaying an app interface with 'Urgent Response' button on a blurred background]
[Hand holding a smartphone displaying an app with a 'Mom' profile and incident report.]
Lively Link

### Need to notify family?

Our Lively Link smartphone app keeps friends and family updated on your health and safety. *Requires
Preferred or Premium plan.*

[Hand holding a smartphone displaying an app with a 'Mom' profile and incident report.]
[Two people sitting in a car, one in the front and one in the back seat.]
Lively Rides

### Need a ride?

Our Lively Rides team can schedule a Lyft ride for you - no app needed.

[Two people sitting in a car, one in the front and one in the back seat.]
[Two call center agents working at their desks with headsets.]
Ask Lively

### Have a question?

With Ask Lively, you can learn more about your new device,  get help looking up a number, get
directions, or much more.

[Two call center agents working at their desks with headsets.]
[Two women walking and smiling outdoors, one in a yellow shirt and the other in a red sweater.]
[Woman using a tablet computer indoors]
[Man talking on a phone outdoors with trees in the background]

Get Lively service in four easy steps.

1. Shop our site to find your perfect product
2. Explore our plans and services
3. Order your product
4. When it arrives, activate it and select your plan online or by phone

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Lively is a telecommunications company that specializes in providing user-friendly mobile phones and medical alert systems, primarily designed for seniors. Their core offerings include the Jitterbug line of phones, which feature simplified interfaces and affordable service plans, alongside health and safety services tailored to enhance the well-being of older adults. With a focus on accessibility and support, Lively aims to empower seniors to stay connected and safe.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Medical Guardian is a leading provider of Digital Health & Safety solutions, dedicated to empowering aging adults and their families to live a life without limits. The company offers a range of innovative medical alert systems, including portable devices like the MG Mini and MG Move, as well as home-based solutions such as the MG Home Cellular and MG Home Landline, all designed to ensure safety and support through advanced technology and 24/7 monitoring. With a focus on the healthcare and senior living industries, Medical Guardian is committed to enhancing the quality of life for its target market.

## Geoff Gross

Founder & Chief Executive Officer

Geoff Gross is the founder and CEO of Medical Guardian, a leading provider of Digital Health &
Safety solutions serving over 625,000 active members nationwide. With over two decades of experience
in HealthTech, Geoff has built Medical Guardian into a mission-driven company focused on empowering
older adults to live a life without limits. Since founding the company in 2005, he has led its
growth into a nationally recognized brand, driven by a commitment to innovation, member experience,
and expanding access to aging-in-place solutions.

As CEO, Geoff oversees the company’s strategic vision and leads cross-functional teams focused on
product transformation, member experience, and growth across both consumer and healthcare channels.
Under his leadership, Medical Guardian has launched industry-leading solutions that provide health,
wellness and safety services at home and on the go, while advancing the company’s impact on aging
and independent living. The company has been recognized multiple times as one of Philadelphia’s
“Best Places to Work” and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies
for 13 consecutive years.

Geoff has been honored as Ernst & Young’s Entrepreneur of the Year (2019) and a Glassdoor Top CEO
(2018 and 2021) and was named to the “Most Admired CEOs” list by the Philadelphia Business Journal.
He’s also been recognized as a “40 Under 40” by Philadelphia Business Journal, Direct Marketing
News, and Smart CEO Magazine. Geoff currently serves as President of the Board for the Connected
Health & Safety Association (CHS), the industry’s sole trade association focused on advocacy and
expansion initiatives. He also serves on the board of the National Multiple Sclerosis Society of the
Delaware Valley. He is an active member of the Young Presidents’ Organization (YPO).

[][51]

## Farhan Mustaq, PHD, MBA, MS

Vice President of Engineering

Known for driving innovation at the intersection of software, healthcare, and connected technology,
Farhan Mushtaq has built a career leading high-impact engineering initiatives across some of the
industry’s most trusted organizations. He spent over a decade at Philips Healthcare
(Lifeline/Connect America), where he led firmware, software, AI, V&V, and IoT development for senior
living and personal emergency response systems. His leadership contributed to the creation of the
Cares application, a senior care management and emergency response platform, as well as advanced
machine learning models for Fall Risk and Risk of Transport Prediction. Farhan also held leadership
roles at Walgreens and Health Recovery Solutions, where he drove innovation in patient engagement
systems and AI-powered remote monitoring tools, including a nurse chatbot and anomaly detection
systems.

As Vice President of Engineering at Medical Guardian, Farhan leads the company’s engineering and
technology strategy, overseeing the development of scalable, high-impact solutions that improve
patient safety, caregiver engagement, and system performance. His work supports the evolution of
Medical Guardian’s remote monitoring and emergency response platforms—ensuring reliability,
innovation, and continuous improvement across the company’s growing portfolio of healthcare
technologies. Known for his collaborative leadership and focus on execution, Farhan fosters a
culture of technical excellence and forward-thinking innovation.

Farhan holds a PhD in Data Science, an MBA, and an MS in Computer Engineering. He combines deep
technical expertise with strategic insight, making him a key contributor to Medical Guardian’s
mission of transforming healthcare experiences through cutting-edge technology. His work continues
to push the boundaries of what’s possible in connected care and intelligent health solutions.

[][52]

## Alex Prough

Chief Commercial Officer

Alex Prough brings over 15 years of healthcare and health technology leadership experience, with a
deep focus on payer strategy, provider partnerships, and expanding access to care through innovative
engagement solutions. He has led growth and commercialization efforts across home health, care
management, digital pharmacy, and connected care platforms. Prior to joining Medical Guardian, Alex
served as Vice President of Business Development at Truepill, where he led go-to-market strategy
across health plans and employers. He also held leadership roles at Best Buy Health and was a member
of the executive team at Critical Signal Technologies (CST), where he built new partnerships, scaled
care delivery models, and supported CST’s successful acquisition by Best Buy.

As Chief Commercial Officer at Medical Guardian, Alex oversees the company’s healthcare strategy and
leads payer, provider, and senior living partnerships. His work spans Medicaid, Medicare Advantage,
D-SNPs, Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), home health agencies, and senior living
communities—advancing scalable, mission-driven solutions that close care gaps, improve quality
performance, and support aging adults at home. He leads cross-functional teams developing remote
monitoring and engagement programs that drive better outcomes and more equitable access to care for
high-acuity and underserved populations.

Alex holds a bachelor’s degree from Bowling Green State University, graduating cum laude. He
continues his professional development through coursework in chronic care management, data security,
and transitional care strategies, and has presented to healthcare leaders nationwide on member
engagement, health equity, and connected care. His leadership has been recognized with awards such
as the Corporate Leadership Award from Philadelphia Business Journal, and he was named to the “40
Under 40” list by City & State Pennsylvania. Outside of work, Alex continues to build on his passion
for expanding access to care through his involvement with Team Frank, a nonprofit that builds
preschools and provides essential health resources to underserved communities across
Africa—advancing both healthcare and education for future generations.

[][53]

## Brian Aman

Chief Financial Officer

Brian Aman brings over 25 years of financial leadership experience spanning the health technology,
SaaS, pharmaceutical, and telecommunications industries. Most recently, Brian served as Chief
Financial Officer at Best Buy Health, a business unit of Best Buy, focused on enabling care at home
through technology, services and logistics. As Chief Financial Officer, Brian led the finance
planning & analysis and strategic planning capabilities and helped lead multiple successful M&A
transactions. Prior to Best Buy Health, Brian held senior finance roles at GreatCall, Inc., a
provider of connected health solutions, where he helped guide the business through a successful sale
process to GTCR, a leading private equity firm, and then Best Buy, Solera, the global leader in
vehicle lifecycle management solutions, and several early to mid-stage pharmaceutical, SaaS, and
telecommunications businesses.

As Chief Financial Officer at Medical Guardian, Brian leads the finance, accounting, reporting,
treasury, and strategic planning capabilities. He works closely with the executive team to shape the
financial strategy as the organization continues to grow, diversify, and expand its impact. His
oversight ensures disciplined financial stewardship, scalable processes, and data-driven
decision-making across the organization, while also supporting strong teams, driving performance,
and fostering innovation.

Brian began his career at KPMG in its assurance practice. Brian holds a bachelor’s degree in
Business Administration, with an accounting and finance concentration, from Washington State
University.

[][54]

# About MobileHelp

# About MobileHelp

Founded in 2006, MobileHelp® is America’s leading provider of M-PERS (Mobile-Personal Emergency
Response System) technology. Based in Philadelphia, PA, MobileHelp services clients in all 50
states. MobileHelp develops and distributes market leading products such as DUO, the first fully
integrated medical alert system with GSM/GPS technology*, SOLO, an innovative alert solution for
people without home telephone lines and Classic Help, a traditional Medical Alert System. MobileHelp
M-PERS devices are integrated with nationwide wireless voice and data and GPS technology to provide
real-time medical monitoring services and location tracking for expedited personal emergency
assistance. MobileHelp also offers MobileHelp CareHub an innovative event notification and online
tracking platform for families and caregivers. MobileHelp, has built a reputation for quality and
affordable solutions for personal protection and peace-of-mind in or away from your home.

## Frequently Asked Questions

We offer simple, emergency monitoring.
Need to know more? We’ve got all of the answers you’re looking for:

### How is this different than 9-1-1?

When you press your button, you’re connected instantly to our 24/7 U.S.-based monitoring center—no
need to search for your phone, dial a number or explain who you are. We already know your name,
location, and emergency contacts, so we can act fast. Unlike 9-1-1, which only routes you through
EMS dispatch, we send the right help right away—whether that’s EMS or someone you trust like a
neighbor, caregiver, or family member. It’s faster, more personal, and built around you.

### Do I need a medical alert system?

While you may not be concerned about your safety now, accidents and other unexpected health concerns
become increasingly likely as we get older. For example, each year 1 in 4 people age 65 or older
suffer a fall. After you’ve fallen once, your chance of falling again unfortunately doubles.
Additionally, throwing out your back, unexpected bouts of vertigo, and other accidents are all
reasons why having a medical alert system can ensure your safety.

The good news is that 90% of older adults who get help within one hour will be able to return home
and resume their lives. Being proactive ensures that if an accident does happen again, the help you
need is on the way.

[**Take our quiz**][32] to find out which medical alert system is right for you.

### Can’t I just use my cell phone?

Cell phones are handy, but they don’t replace the need for a medical alert device. Unlike a cell
phone, most MobileHelp devices are water resistant, meaning you’re protected even while in the
shower. Because the devices are worn around the neck or on the wrist, help is always within reach. A
single button press activates our medical alert devices, setting them apart from even the most
user-friendly cell phone.

### Does MobileHelp work outside the home?

Yes. The brand new MobileHelp Elite is an on-the-go wearable medical alert device powered by AT&T’s
nationwide, 4G LTE network. The MobileHelp Elite uses GPS and Wi-Fi-assisted location so help can be
directed to the member, with backup signals for better reliability. The MobileHelp Classic Cellular
and Classic Landline home medical alert systems provide in-home coverage up to 1400 feet (depending
on device). For complete, on-the-go coverage, the MobileHelp Elite is the best protection for
coverage both in and out of the home.

### What happens if the operator doesn’t hear me?

In the event that you are unable to speak due to a fall or the emergency responder can’t hear you,
we will contact emergency response on your behalf, as we will assume that you are having an
emergency.

### Can my device be worn in the shower?

The MobileHelp Elite is water resistant and can be worn in both the shower or the bath, under normal
conditions. Neck and wrist pendants included in MobileHelp home medical alert systems can be worn in
the shower or bath. They are not designed to be submerged or exposed to water for a prolonged period
of time. The Cellular and Landline base stations and wall buttons are not waterproof.

### How long does it take emergency responders to respond?

This depends on the local authorities available in your area. While we cannot provide an estimated
time, MobileHelp’s state-of-the-art medical alert systems connect you to an operator at our
monitoring center in as little as 10 seconds.

### How does the device know when I fall?

Our latest advanced fall detection technology uses machine-learning models trained on real fall data
to help detect falls and automatically initiate an SOS call. In the event that you are unable to
speak, our operators will contact emergency response on your behalf.

### Do I have to sign a contract?

No. MobileHelp does not require a contract. Our service subscription is month-to-month and can be
cancelled at any time. Your device’s monthly monitoring plan includes mobile service on AT&T’s
nationwide network. For more information, please visit our [**Terms and Conditions**][33]**.**

# A focused leader in health technology

#### Over the past decade we have transformed into a focused leader in health technology

[banner our purpose]

### Driven by purpose

At Philips, our purpose is to improve people’s health and well-being through meaningful innovation.
We aim to improve 2.5 billion lives per year by 2030, including 400 million in underserved
communities.

As a technology company, we – and our brand licensees – innovate for people with one consistent
belief: there’s always a way to make life better.

## Our strategy

### Driving profitable growth to deliver sustainable value

Our focus is clear: delivering better care for more people. Our strategy is designed to deliver
impact at scale by combining focus, innovation and disciplined execution.
[ Find out more ][99]

### Innovating to address global health challenges

**We have a proud heritage of ground-breaking innovation that stretches back over 130 years.
Meaningful innovation – focused on our customers’ needs – remains at the heart of everything we do.

## Our planet

### Doing business responsibly and sustainably

As a responsible company, we operate sustainably, to high Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG)
standards. We continue to embed sustainability ever deeper in the way we do business – in our own
operations and beyond, together with our partners.
[ Find out more ][101]

## Our people

### A diverse and inclusive workplace

The continued success of our company depends on every employee feeling valued, respected, and
empowered to contribute fully.

We are a diverse team made up of some 69,700 individuals across over 100 countries, all with
different backgrounds, perspectives and experiences.

We value these differences – they’re what make creativity and innovation flourish.

We want Philips to be the best place to work for people who share our passion.

Join our team

### Our management structure combines responsible leadership and independent supervision

### Board of Management and Executive Committee

The Executive Committee operates under the chairmanship of the Chief Executive Officer and supports
the Board of Management in the deployment of Philips' strategy and policies, and the achievement of
its objectives and results.

As a separate and independent body, the Supervisory Board supervises the policies of the executive

### Over 130 years of people-focused innovation

Products come and go... Technologies change... But Philips is still about one thing: Creating

At Philips, we want people to be healthy, live well and enjoy life. We are a technology company that

# Connected Care

Our solutions have been designed to support a wide range of people, including older people, those at
risk of falls, with limited mobility and conditions such as dementia, and those who care for them

[
Connected Care

## Redefining Connected Care & Health

For over 65 years, Tunstall Healthcare has pioneered the use of technology to support those
requiring care & health intervention to live independently in their chosen home setting. The aim is
to balance independence with reassurance, and provide tailored support which meets individuals'
needs now and in the future.

Our solutions and services enable independent living, by defining new models of care and creating
connected global healthcare solutions which support more than five million people daily.

[Learn more][39]

## Connected Care

Our innovative range of care solutions and services enable people to live more independent and
fulfilling lives. Whether it's in an individual’s home or in residential care, our proactive and
integrated approach provides 24/7 monitoring and support to deliver efficient and responsive care.

Learn more

## Connected Services

Our connected services enable organisations to achieve the next level of care and health
transformation, building on many years of experience and research gained across international care
and health organisations. We use data and insight to focus resources, enabling person-centred models
of care.

# We're Here to Help You Age in Your Own Home

You shouldn’t have to figure it all out on your own. AgingInPlace.org is here to make it easier,
more affordable, and more fun to age at home.

Data shows that 77% of adults 50 and older want to remain in their homes for the long term, but one
third of adults 50 years and older say they need to modify their current home for themselves or a
loved one to do so. The good news: There is no one way to age in place: You may need only a few new
products and small changes to your home, or you want to make larger modifications but don’t know
where to begin.

What does aging in place look like to you? Let’s make it happen together.

[Start Exploring ][24]
[Aging in Place Header Image]

## Who we are?

AgingInPlace.org provides free online resources for all aspects of aging at home. [Our mission][34]
is to connect older adults and their loved ones with the right tools to make remaining in their
homes and communities a reality. We’re an extension of your community as you prepare for this next
step.

You won’t need to spend hours researching multiple blogs, sites, and product reviews, and still
wonder if you’ve found all the resources you need—we’ve done it for you.

[Aging in Place Header Image]

## I want to learn more about:

### Medical Alert Systems

Keep your independence at home and on the go knowing you’re always connected to a 24/7 monitoring
center in case of an emergency.

[See our top picks ][35]

### Hearing Aids

Connect with your loved ones and surroundings with confidence. Find the right hearing aid tailored
to your lifestyle.

[See our top picks ][36]

### Adjustable Beds

Get a more restful, healthier sleep with a bed designed to completely support you in multiple
positions.

[See our top picks ][37]

### Walk-in Tubs

Make your bathtub your oasis again. Easily get in and out of your walk-in tub or shower without
stepping over a slippery, high threshold.

[See our top picks ][38]

### Portable Oxygen Concentrators

Receive oxygen therapy while still doing the activities you love. A portable oxygen concentrator is
more compact and easier to carry around than a traditional home oxygen concentrator.

[See our top picks ][39]

### Home Modifications

Learn how to modify each room in your home for a safer, more comfortable space.

[Explore our guide ][40]

### Retirement Planning and Insurance

Make the most of your hard-earned money as you navigate retirement, long-term care insurance,
Medicare options, life insurance, and more.

[Explore our guide ][41]

### Mobility Accessories

Stay active with the right wheelchair, electric scooter, and other mobility accessories.

[Explore our guide ][42]

## How We Approach Every Review

1

### Conduct firsthand testing and research

We score each feature and our overall experience using every product, including working with
customer support, costs, value, and more.

2

### Incorporate reader surveys into our evaluations

Your past shopping experiences tell us what matters most in our product reviews. We survey readers
about their favorite brands, non-negotiable product features, ease of use, and other factors to
incorporate into [our rating system][43].

3

### Consult industry professionals and experts

We interview doctors, audiologists, nurse practitioners, professional caregivers, and other industry
experts to learn more about the products and services we write about.

4

### Have content medically reviewed

From product reviews to informational guides, our team of medical experts (including doctors,
nurses, and more) reviews each piece of content to ensure you're getting the most medically
accurate, up-to-date information throughout our site.

## Our Medical Reviewers

### Conduct firsthand testing and research

customer support, costs, value, and more.

about their favorite brands, non-negotiable product features, ease of use, and other factors to
incorporate into [our rating system][43].

3

### Consult industry professionals and experts

We interview doctors, audiologists, nurse practitioners, professional caregivers, and other industry
experts to learn more about the products and services we write about.

nurses, and more) reviews each piece of content to ensure you're getting the most medically
accurate, up-to-date information throughout our site.

should be taken with a grain of salt! The reality is that several factors influence the cost of a
panic button.

exchange for an agreement of a few months. Conversely, a panic button without a subscription costs
more upfront but gives you complete freedom with the service provider.

How do I determine which package is right for me?

Simply based on your needs. You can choose a panic button with a subscription, without a
subscription, connected to a central monitoring station, or simply connected to a smart app. 

Besides, emergency bracelets are extremely versatile and customizable devices. Some have a fall
detector, some have a GPS chip, and most have a two-way communication feature. Many models now

Can I wear an alarm button with a pacemaker?

In theory, yes! But be careful… Some personal emergency devices produce an electromagnetic field
that can actually cause interference with the pacemaker. 

Most alarm button manufacturers claim that their products do not cause interference and that they
can be worn safely by people with pacemakers.

product is compatible with a pacemaker. And in any case, it is also essential to seek the advice of
a medical professional if you find yourself in such a situation.

# Protecting You & The Ones In Your Care, Since 2007

Trusted by healthcare providers, senior living facilities, and government agencies for delivering
peace of mind to the people in their care

[ Request a Demo ][33]

# Industries We Serve

#### Veterans Affairs

For more than 18 years, LogicMark has been a trusted provider of medical alert solutions for the VA.
As a GSA-approved supplier and federal contract holder, we help VA hospitals and veteran service
organizations support veterans’ unique safety needs.

[ Learn More ][34]

#### Senior Living Facilities

Our medical alert devices help senior living communities and caregivers respond quickly to
emergencies, reduce fall-related risks, and ensure peace of mind for residents and families.

[ Learn More ][35]

#### Home Healthcare Providers

Our emergency response systems for healthcare providers help patients and workers stay safe at home
with easy-to-use devices, real-time monitoring, and caregiver support tools.

[ Learn More ][36]

# Cutting-Edge Solutions For Your Needs

[icon-fall-detection]

#### Patented Fall Detection

Detects falls instantly and notifies caregivers or emergency services — even if the person is
unresponsive or can’t speak. Includes emergency caregiver video (exclusive to LogicMark) for fall
validation. Essential for seniors with mobility challenges, neurological conditions, or a history of
falls.

[icon-geofencing]

#### Geofencing

Creates custom safe zones and sends alerts if a resident wanders beyond these safe zones. Especially
valuable in memory care units or communities serving seniors with Alzheimer’s, dementia, or vision
impairments.

[icon-24-7-crisis-hotline]

#### Crisis Hotline Access

Provides direct connection to emotional support during moments of distress through the 988 Suicide
and Crisis Prevention hotline. A must for individuals coping with PTSD, depression, or other mental
health challenges.

[icon-24-7-monitoring]

#### 24/7 U.S. Based Monitoring

A number of our solutions offer dependable 24/7 U.S.-based monitoring — providing added support
around the clock. These professionals can assess the situation, provide reassurance, and promptly
dispatch the right help.

# Our Products

#### Freedom Alert

Home-based landline solution for clients with little to no cell coverage.
* **Direct-to-911**
* **Connect to Caregivers**
* **Landline-Based**
* **Two-way Voice Communication**
* **Unmonitored**
* **No Monthly Fees**

[ Learn More ][37]

#### Guardian Alert 911 Plus

Low cost 4G technology and simple mobile solution with:
* **Direct-to-911**
* **Patented Fall Detection**
* **4G LTE Mobile Connection**
* **Two-Way Voice Communication**
* **Unmonitored**
* **No Monthly Fees**

[ Learn More ][38]

#### Freedom Alert Mini

Includes all the features of Guardian Alert 911 Plus, as well as:
* **24/7 U.S.-Based Monitoring**
* **Patented Fall Detection**
* **Geofencing**
* **GPS Tracking**
* **4G LTE Mobile Connection**
* **Two-way Voice Communication**
* **Caregiver Companion App**

[ Learn More ][39]

#### Freedom Alert Max

A cell phone that Includes all the features of Freedom Alert Mini, plus:
* **24/7 U.S.-Based Monitoring**
* **Patented Fall Detection**
* **Geofencing**
* **GPS Tracking**

Medical alert systems are becoming more popular as modern medicine is breathing new and extended
life into our beloved Golden Agers. With newfound independence and the energy (and vivacity!) to
venture out into the world on their own, seniors are tackling the modern era like never before.
Modern medical alerts are empowering them to do it all and more, safely.

Medical alert devices give peace of mind to both the elderly who are wearing the devices and their
children, grandchildren, and caregivers, who only want what’s best for them.

# How Medical Alert Systems Work

You’ll find all sorts of medical alert devices out there, including wearable devices, wall-mounted
units, and voice-controlled systems. But they all work under the same basic premise: when you need
help, someone is there to respond. Here’s how it works in general:
* The user wears their medical alert device of choice
* If an emergency situation arises, they press the medical alerts button
* The on-call monitoring center will respond immediately, making contact with the wearer
* The responder will ask the user a few questions and decide which type of emergency response is
  appropriate for the situation
* The emergency monitoring agent will then dispatch the appropriate responder to your location and
  remain in contact until help has arrived

Most medical alert services will allow you to create a hierarchy of who should be called in case of

# Kanega Watch Hub Service

$50.00

Want the **most reliable connection** possible for your Kanega Watch during emergencies but don’t
have home WiFi? The Kanega Watch Hub Service allows your watch to connect reliably for **far less**
than paying for a home WiFi connection. With **zero setup** and no need to share your home WiFi
password, the Kanega Watch Hub **makes it easy** to ensure you can get the help you need even when
cellular signal strength is limited. Simply plug in the Kanega Watch Hub device, flip up the
antenna, put it somewhere out of the way, and you’re good to go!

**Pricing**

Equipment Deposit: $50 (refunded when the Kanega Watch Hub device is returned in good condition
after cancelling service)

Service Fee: $10/month for monthly subscribers, or $84/year for annual subscribers ($7 a month
equivalent)

**Important Notes**
* Purchasing this service from the UnaliWear web store will immediately charge you for the equipment
deposit and get your unit shipped to you.
* The Hub service fee will automatically be added to your monthly or annual Kanega Watch service
subscription based on your current plan.
* Annual Subscribers: You will be charged once for a partial year of hub usage to cover the service
until your next annual renewal.
* The Kanega Watch Hub must be returned at the end of service in good condition to receive a refund
of the deposit.
* Annual Subscribers: Upon cancellation, you will receive a pro-rated refund for any remaining full
months of service.
* The Kanega Watch Hub works only with your Kanega Watch.

### Frequently Asked Questions
* What happens in an emergency—say I fall or my loved one falls? Where does the alert go? 911?
1. With the Kanega Watch, you have 3 ways to get help in an emergency–button, voice and fall
detection. All these alerts go to our US-based 24/7 monitoring center. The agent who receives
that alert will try and speak to the wearer through the watch. The agent will say “Hi, this is
X from UnaliWear, do you need help?”
2. If the wearer is responsive, the wearer can speak to the agent and direct whatever care is
needed; from “call my neighbor to help me off the floor” to “call EMS, Police or Fire” or even
“call my daughter and have her come over to get the blankets from the top of the closet” (this
really happened). The agent does what the wearer asks.
3. If the wearer is not responsive, the agent will call the wearer’s phone number and, if there is
no response, immediately call the first listed emergency contact (as listed in the wearer’s
profile) – we recommend that is someone who lives nearby. The agent will say “Hi this is X from
UnaliWear. We just received an alert from (wearer) and (wearer) is not responding. Are you able
to check on (wearer)?” Note: It’s not infrequent where the emergency contact is in the same
house as the wearer and didn’t know the wearer had fallen in the garage.
1. If the answer is no or if no emergency contacts answer the call, the agent will dispatch
local emergency services to the wearer’s location. The agent has the same access to EMS as
911 does, so it is not an extra call to 911, so it saves a step. In addition, the agent can
also provide EMS with the wearer’s medical info—such as medicine allergies, health
conditions, etc.; and, if the wearer is home, can even provide spare key location or lock
box info, so EMS does not have to break down the door. This ensures the EMS response can be
faster and more informed than a generic 911 dispatch.
4. If EMS is dispatched, the agent will inform all the emergency contacts via phone of what has
taken place. Note that our monitoring center agents call from the same phone number, so the
wearer and all emergency contacts can add this number to their phone contact list, so they know
it is not spam.

# Our Story

Our name derives from Cherokee: “Unalii” meaning “friend”, and “Kanega” meaning “speak” – so we are
the “friend that speaks to you.”
Jean Anne Booth thought she was sailing into the sunset. She’d spent 30 years working in
semiconductors and had sold businesses to Apple and Texas Instruments. But while working for a scuba
diving outfit off the coast of Florida, an idea burrowed into her head and wouldn’t leave. In the
end, it was her own mother who pulled her back to shore and into business.
Booth observed her elderly mother, and saw the vulnerability that old age can bring. She noted that
traditional medical alert systems are both ugly and socially stigmatizing, so many people avoid
getting much-needed medical alert systems. As a result, many don’t receive the care they need at
critical moments.

Faced with this challenge, Booth set out on a mission to create a smartwatch that can give
vulnerable populations greater independence. Her company, UnaliWear, has created the Kanega Watch,
the only watch with built-in Fall Detection that connects to emergency response agents 24/7/365.
Until her mother passed away in late 2018, Booth continued to run every prototype by her mother to
make sure her tech made sense in the real world (her mother had the title of “Senior Experience
Officer” – both literally and figuratively). That’s why the Kanega Watch is water-resistant, voice,
button and fall detection activated, and it never needs to be removed to charge (among other key
features) – providing real round-the-clock peace of mind for wearers and those that care for them.
Booth’s mother loved her Kanega Watch and the stylish, discreet protection it provided her and the
growing community of wearers throughout the country.

Our Safety And Security Services

Professional Monitoring Services

Becklar’s commercial and residential wholesale monitoring services help to protect your most valuable assets – your people and your property. We save lives and protect property 24/7. Our advanced, customizable safety technology, combined with our highly skilled, caring operators, enables us to respond quickly and accurately to signals from any connected safety system and device. Our state-of-the-art monitoring centers are located throughout the US and Canada, so we’re there where you need us most!

Learn More

Personal Emergency Response System

Becklar Personal Health and Safety solutions include market-leading devices and mobile applications designed to protect your customers from social, physical, and emotional risk. Our innovative wholesale solutions range from medical alert pendants to discreet personal safety apps. When combined with our exclusive customer engagement technologies and caring monitoring specialists, you can be confident your customers will be protected in the event of an emergency.

Learn More

Workforce Safety

Becklar’s flexible, end-to-end workforce safety technologies protect your employees who work alone (lone workers), at height, or in other potentially hazardous work environments. Our exclusive, dedicated applications, devices, management dashboards, and professional monitoring services help improve safety protocols with fall detection, check-ins and more. Reduce your corporate risk by providing innovative health and safety solutions for your employees that meet or exceed OSHA regulations.

Learn More

AI Engage Platform

The Becklar AI Engage platform allows us to build customizable solutions to meet the safety needs of our customers across various industries. This integrated set of services is designed to be robust and flexible to fit into your environment as an end-to-end ecosystem or as stand-alone services. Combining a human element with cutting-edge safety technology ensures our enterprise clients can help their audiences at the right time.

FAQ

What makes Becklar's security solutions unique?

Our all-in-one security solutions package means you can access 24/7 monitoring, personal health and safety, and workforce safety all in one place. Our award-winning services and customizable solutions are leveraged to meet your individual needs, no matter the industry.

How do connected safety solutions enhance security?

By using real-time data, Becklar helps prevent crimes and workplace injuries before they happen. Security equipment like cameras, sensors, and wearable devices allows for quick response times that may not be delivered otherwise.

About Becklar

Becklar has emerged as the industry leader in connected safety solutions, providing businesses and individuals with an unrivaled all-in-one suite of lifesaving and life-enhancing technologies. We leverage our exclusive platform of innovative technology and award-winning safety and services to create customizable solutions to meet the connected safety needs of our enterprise and individual customers, across diverse industries, to protect your most valuable assets.
Becklar Workforce Safety provides a suite of end-to-end solutions that reduce corporate risk by protecting employees who work alone, at height, or in other potentially hazardous environments with dedicated devices coupled with innovative safety apps.
Becklar Personal Health and Safety delivers cutting-edge devices that protect users and provide peace of mind to professional or family caregivers. Our solutions protect, monitor, and engage with end users to increase their safety and enable the success of their caregivers.
Becklar’s Enterprise Monitoring solutions provide superior wholesale critical event monitoring and response solutions along with advanced interactive video monitoring and remote guarding services through our award-winning companies (AvantGuard, Armstrongs, and Eyeforce) with state-of-the-art monitoring centers across North America.
Becklar customers enjoy peace of mind through the implementation of our customized safety solutions that meet their unique enterprise needs and ensure the safety of their people, the security of their assets, and the success of their organization.
Our team of safety experts can help you create the perfect customized connected safety solution to protect your employees, corporate customers, subscribers, property, and other important assets. Contact Becklar today !

# About Becklar

Experienced Leaders. Passionate Teams. Continuous Innovation.

## Our History

Becklar’s history is steeped in innovation, caring, and helping others. Located in Ogden, Utah,
we’re proud to call Utah’s silicone slopes home! Our connection to the West runs deep, even in our
name. Our name, Becklar, is derived from the Bechler River in Yellowstone National Park, where our
founder, Josh Garner, enjoyed peaceful days fishing with his father.

Becklar’s journey goes back 40 years to when monitoring company ‘AvantGuard’ began operations in
Ogden, Utah. Our pioneering spirit has guided us ever since, from acquiring Freeus, the leading
North American provider of mobile personal emergency response systems (PERS), to establishing
Becklar, to uniting the complimentary Freeus and AvantGuard businesses – and future acquisitions –
into one entity. In 2020, BV Investment Partners, a tech-focused private equity firm, became
Becklar’s majority shareholder. Their guidance has fueled our rapid growth and enabled Becklar to
provide enterprise-scale solutions based on industry-leading technology.

## What We Do

Becklar creates industry-leading connected safety solutions for enterprises and individuals,
delivering a world class comprehensive suite of lifesaving and life-enhancing technologies. Becklar
leverages its platform of innovative technology and award-winning services to create customizable
and comprehensive solutions to meet the connected safety needs of their enterprise and individual
customers across diverse industries, including video monitoring and remote guarding, personal
emergency response solutions, workforce safety, personal health & safety, vitals monitoring and
event response monitoring.

## Our Mission

We bring together innovative technologies and caring people to enhance our customers’ freedom,
confidence, and peace of mind. We envision a future of a safer, more connected world.

## Our Core Values
## We Care FIRST

At Becklar, we strive daily to show our customers, partners, and employees that we care by living
the following values.

[Becklar Core Company Values We Care F.I.R.S.T.]

### Fun

**We love what we do.** We invest in developing a rewarding, fun culture. We laugh and joke,
enjoying the company of our coworkers.

## Innovation

**We lead, not follow.** We believe that innovative solutions that make the world a safer place
happen at the intersection of humanity and technology. We are driven to be better every day.

## Relationships

**“We” is always greater than “I”.** We build authentic relationships where everyone has a voice. We
lean on each other, trusting that everyone is doing our part.

## Service

**Caring is at our core value.** We support and serve our customers, team members, and communities
in moments that matter.

## Teamwork

**None of us is as smart as all of us. **We combine exceptional partners, coworkers, and customers
to collaboratively and passionately achieve a common goal.

## Our Leadership Team

### Steve Richards

CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
Steve Richards is a seasoned CEO with over three decades of leadership at numerous publicly traded
and private companies. A skilled leader known for systemically driving growth via organic and
acquisition-driven initiatives, his track record includes experience across technology, media,
communications, business process outsourcing, and recurring services firms, all marked by a
consistent history of driving transformational growth and exceptional client service.

### Josh Garner

FOUNDER
Josh Garner founded Becklar and launched his career as the founder of AvantGuard. He built the
company from a small mom-and-pop central station to a national leader in the wholesale monitoring
space. This 3rd generation alarm guru led AvantGuard to become one of the fastest-growing wholesale
monitoring companies in the United States. He saw the opportunity to expand the markets served by
acquiring Freeus and forming Becklar.

### Ray Langhaim

CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER
Ray Langhaim is an experienced CFO with numerous publicly traded and private companies. Leadership
and our We Care First core values are rooted within him. Ray has worked with companies from $40m to
$3B. He started his career after graduating from Fresno State in 1990 with Ernst and Young in San
Jose, California and received his CPA. During his assignment as an expat in the Philippines he
learned to SCUBA dive. He also enjoys football and being a husband, father, and grandfather.

### Tyler Tribe

CHIEF TECHNOLOGY & PRODUCT OFFICER
Tyler Tribe is a seasoned technology executive with almost three decades of experience in creating
software solutions. He is passionate about helping organizations develop world-class customer and
employee experiences, building strong teams, and collaborating on vision and strategy for global
corporations and small and medium-sized businesses. Before joining Becklar, he spent twenty years at
IBM.

### Clint Halverson

CHIEF PEOPLE & ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER
Clint Halverson is a people and culture leader with an HR heart and a business mind—a strategic
leader with broad and diversified business experience. Clint has extensive experience leading
organizational design and effectiveness, human resources, culture and engagement, talent
acquisition, total rewards, and talent development. Before joining the Becklar team, he spent 15
years with a publicly traded real estate company, ultimately spending his last six years as their
head of people.

### Kirsten Kelley

VP OF MARKETING & NEW
OFFERINGS
Kirsten Kelley brings over two decades of enterprise software offering management and marketing
experience to the Becklar team. Kirsten spent most of her career at IBM in various roles, including
sales, channel management, product and offering management, and marketing. A proven leader, she
worked with cross-functional teams and partners to improve customer retention and analyst
recognition for IBM products and services.

### Brock Winzeler

President, Becklar Workforce Safety / Personal Health & Safety
Brock Winzeler is President of the Freeus, Becklar Workforce Safety, and Becklar Connected Wellness

valuable assets – your people and your property. We save lives and protect property 24/7. Our

Becklar Personal Health and Safety solutions include market-leading devices and mobile applications
designed to protect your customers from social, physical, and emotional risk. Our innovative
wholesale solutions range from medical alert pendants to discreet personal safety apps. When
combined with our exclusive customer engagement technologies and caring monitoring specialists, you
can be confident your customers will be protected in the event of an emergency.

[ Learn More ][58]

(lone workers), at height, or in other potentially hazardous work environments. Our exclusive,
dedicated applications, devices, management dashboards, and professional monitoring services help
improve safety protocols with fall detection, check-ins and more. Reduce your corporate risk by
providing innovative health and safety solutions for your employees that meet or exceed OSHA
regulations.

# How Health and
# Home Connect

We envision a world where **everyone** is empowered to age gracefully and well at home. Our
next-generation connective care platform makes that possible.

[How Health and Home Connect]

## Smarter Response. Better Outcomes.

Connect America elevates traditional personal emergency response systems (PERS) with clinical
intelligence and data-driven insights. Our solution integrates connected devices with clinical
triage, analytics and insights, and a 24/7 response center.

Every alert presents an opportunity to guide vulnerable individuals to the most appropriate level of
care in the moment of need, helping to reduce unnecessary emergency department visits. Meanwhile,
CareSage, our robust analytics engine, provides health plans with visibility into critical changes
and trends in healthcare utilization.

[Drive Better Health Outcomes]

## Our Connective Care Solution

[[Connected Devices]][11]

### [Connected Devices][12]

Innovative health and safety devices and wearables that connect to critical emergency and
non-emergency services.

[[Concierge Call Center]][13]

### [Concierge Call Center][14]

Trained specialists answer in seconds at the press of a button and provide critical support
services.

[[Analytics and Insights]][15]

### [Analytics and Insights][16]

Actionable data that enhances health insights and results in better care at lower costs.

[[Medication Management]][17]

### [Medication Management][18]

Help ensure medication adherence and reduce adverse events related to prescription medications.

## Improving Healthcare Outcomes and Experiences

Connect America’s connective care solution enables vulnerable populations to live safely and
independently at home. Our connected devices and tech-enabled services help improve care and
outcomes while reducing unnecessary hospitalizations and healthcare costs.

[Let's Talk][19]
[CareSage Analytics Engine]

## Actionable Insights from CareSage

CareSage is our data analytics platform that ingests data from across the CA Home platform and turns
it into actionable information and insights. We identify patterns in your data to provide insights
on:
* Activity and mobility levels
* Engagement with the plan
* Assistance and monitoring away from home
* Fall management
* Hospitalization prediction

This real-time reporting enables earlier intervention by supporting proactive care for your member
and patient populations.

[Learn More][20]

## Simple to Start. Easy to Use.

We tear down the barriers to adoption by creating a simple solution that’s intuitive for all users.

For individuals and their caregivers, we offer push-button products ready to use out of the box
without complex setup or configuration. If help is ever needed, a virtual health assistant is just a
text message away.

We offer end-to-end implementation support to allow healthcare providers staff get their connective
care program up and running without overtaxing their staff. Our goal is to serve as an extension of
your staff, increasing your bandwidth so you can focus on your care population.
