## About Alert Care

At Alert Care, our story began over two decades ago, in 2001, with a singular mission: to enhance
the lives of seniors by providing them with innovative in-home healthcare monitoring solutions. Our
commitment is rooted in the belief that everyone deserves to live with dignity and independence,
especially as they age or navigate disabilities. Today, we stand proud as one of the leading
providers in the industry, helping countless individuals maintain their autonomy and comfort within
the familiar surroundings of their homes.

### Our Foundation

Alert Care is more than just a company; we’re a community, locally owned and deeply integrated into
the fabric of the places we serve. Our roots are firmly planted in Ohio, where our dedicated call
center operates around the clock. Here, our expertly trained response teams are always ready,
offering support and assistance 24/7, every day of the year.

### Our Services

For over 20 years, Alert Care has specialized in Personal Emergency Response Systems (PERS),
delivering peace of mind to our clients and their families. We take pride in our diverse range of
safe, user-friendly, and budget-friendly products designed to meet the unique needs of each
individual we serve.

Our state-of-the-art Emergency Response Center is the heart of our operations, providing relentless
coverage nationwide, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. Accredited as a Five Diamond
Certified Medical-only Monitoring Center and boasting an AAA rating with the Better Business Bureau,
our commitment to excellence is unmatched.

## Our Unwavering Commitment: The Alert Care Promise

At Alert Care, we are steadfast in our commitment to enriching the lives of those we serve. Our
principles guide every decision we make and every service we provide. Here is our promise to you:

#### No Hidden Fees

Integrity guides our pricing. You’ll find transparency everywhere, without unexpected fees or
binding contracts.

#### Nationwide Coverage

Our protective reach spans the entire U.S., ensuring that you’re always within our care no matter
where you are.

#### Trained Professionals

Our team, from installers to customer support, comprises only the most skilled and compassionate
individuals committed to your well-being.

#### Flexible Devices

Choose from various products, such as in-home systems, mobile units and wrist wearables, tailored to
fit your lifestyle seamlessly.

#### Customized Solutions

We recognize the uniqueness of each individual’s needs, offering personalized service and device
options to ensure your safety, convenience and independence.

#### Accessible Services

As a provider for Medicaid, Passport and Ohio Waiver programs, we strive to make our life-saving
services available to everyone.

## A Team-Focused Approach to Your Independence

At Alert Care, your safety and independence are our highest priorities. We are more than a service
provider; we are your partners in navigating the challenges of aging or disability with confidence
and dignity. With Alert Care by your side, you and your loved ones can rest assured that help is
always within reach.

# Real People. Real Support.

At Alert Care, we pride ourselves on providing comprehensive support services to our customers. From
consultations to technical support and customer service, our dedicated team is here to assist you
every step of the way. Our 24/7 USA-based emergency call center ensures that all calls are promptly
responded to, separate from our day-to-day operations. While our business offices observe holidays
such as New Year’s Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day, our emergency monitoring centers remain
fully staffed 24/7, 365 days a year.

## FAQs

Find answers to common questions about Alert Care’s medical alert systems and services. Whether
you’re new to our products or seeking clarification on features, our FAQs are here to help. Explore
our frequently asked questions for insights that will enhance your experience with Alert Care. If
you need further assistance, our customer support team is ready to help. Your safety and peace of
mind are important to us, and we’re dedicated to providing the information you need to feel
confident with Alert Care.

#### Do I need wifi or a cell phone to use the AC Home Cellular system?

No. You do not need to have wifi or a cell phone to use the Home Cellular unit.

#### With the AC Home Cellular system, what's the range of the pendant?

The range of the AC Pendant and Fall Sensor is approximately 150′, giving the user the ability to
call for help from a lobby or while outside in the yard.

#### Where can I buy replacement or additional pendants for the AC Home Cellular?

You can get an additional Pendant or Fall Sensor to replace one that has been damaged or for an
additional user in the home.

[Click here to purchase a Pendant][24]

[Click here to purchase a Fall Sensor][25]

#### Can two people use one AC Home Cellular unit?

Yes, two people can use the same Home Cellular unit. Each person will need their own Pendant or Fall
Sensor, and they will need to pay an extra $9.99 for the addition to the monitoring service.

#### Do the Alert Care systems automatically call 911 when the button is pushed?

No. When the button is pressed, it calls our U.S.-based trained response team. They will assess the
situation and call for an ambulance or a loved one.

#### Are Alert Care's medical alert systems water-resistant?

Absolutely. All of Alert Care’s medical alert systems are highly water-resistant, allowing you to
wear them confidently even in the shower.

the lives of seniors by providing them with innovative in-home healthcare monitoring solutions. Our
commitment is rooted in the belief that everyone deserves to live with dignity and independence,
especially as they age or navigate disabilities. Today, we stand proud as one of the leading
providers in the industry, helping countless individuals maintain their autonomy and comfort within
the familiar surroundings of their homes.

### Our Foundation

Alert Care is more than just a company; we’re a community, locally owned and deeply integrated into
the fabric of the places we serve. Our roots are firmly planted in Ohio, where our dedicated call
center operates around the clock. Here, our expertly trained response teams are always ready,
offering support and assistance 24/7, every day of the year.

### Our Services

For over 20 years, Alert Care has specialized in Personal Emergency Response Systems (PERS),
delivering peace of mind to our clients and their families. We take pride in our diverse range of
safe, user-friendly, and budget-friendly products designed to meet the unique needs of each
individual we serve.

Our state-of-the-art Emergency Response Center is the heart of our operations, providing relentless
coverage nationwide, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. Accredited as a Five Diamond
Certified Medical-only Monitoring Center and boasting an AAA rating with the Better Business Bureau,
our commitment to excellence is unmatched.

## Our Unwavering Commitment: The Alert Care Promise

At Alert Care, we are steadfast in our commitment to enriching the lives of those we serve. Our
principles guide every decision we make and every service we provide. Here is our promise to you:

#### No Hidden Fees

Integrity guides our pricing. You’ll find transparency everywhere, without unexpected fees or
binding contracts.

#### Nationwide Coverage

Our protective reach spans the entire U.S., ensuring that you’re always within our care no matter
where you are.

#### Trained Professionals

Our team, from installers to customer support, comprises only the most skilled and compassionate
individuals committed to your well-being.

#### Flexible Devices

Choose from various products, such as in-home systems, mobile units and wrist wearables, tailored to
fit your lifestyle seamlessly.

#### Customized Solutions

We recognize the uniqueness of each individual’s needs, offering personalized service and device
options to ensure your safety, convenience and independence.

#### Accessible Services

As a provider for Medicaid, Passport and Ohio Waiver programs, we strive to make our life-saving
services available to everyone.

## A Team-Focused Approach to Your Independence

At Alert Care, your safety and independence are our highest priorities. We are more than a service
provider; we are your partners in navigating the challenges of aging or disability with confidence
and dignity. With Alert Care by your side, you and your loved ones can rest assured that help is
always within reach.

# Real People. Real Support.

At Alert Care, we pride ourselves on providing comprehensive support services to our customers. From
consultations to technical support and customer service, our dedicated team is here to assist you
every step of the way. Our 24/7 USA-based emergency call center ensures that all calls are promptly
responded to, separate from our day-to-day operations. While our business offices observe holidays
such as New Year’s Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day, our emergency monitoring centers remain
fully staffed 24/7, 365 days a year.

## FAQs

Find answers to common questions about Alert Care’s medical alert systems and services. Whether
you’re new to our products or seeking clarification on features, our FAQs are here to help. Explore
our frequently asked questions for insights that will enhance your experience with Alert Care. If
you need further assistance, our customer support team is ready to help. Your safety and peace of
mind are important to us, and we’re dedicated to providing the information you need to feel
confident with Alert Care.

#### Do I need wifi or a cell phone to use the AC Home Cellular system?

No. You do not need to have wifi or a cell phone to use the Home Cellular unit.

#### With the AC Home Cellular system, what's the range of the pendant?

The range of the AC Pendant and Fall Sensor is approximately 150′, giving the user the ability to
call for help from a lobby or while outside in the yard.

#### Where can I buy replacement or additional pendants for the AC Home Cellular?

You can get an additional Pendant or Fall Sensor to replace one that has been damaged or for an
additional user in the home.

[Click here to purchase a Pendant][24]

[Click here to purchase a Fall Sensor][25]

#### Can two people use one AC Home Cellular unit?

Yes, two people can use the same Home Cellular unit. Each person will need their own Pendant or Fall
Sensor, and they will need to pay an extra $9.99 for the addition to the monitoring service.

#### Do the Alert Care systems automatically call 911 when the button is pushed?

No. When the button is pressed, it calls our U.S.-based trained response team. They will assess the
situation and call for an ambulance or a loved one.

#### Are Alert Care's medical alert systems water-resistant?

Absolutely. All of Alert Care’s medical alert systems are highly water-resistant, allowing you to
wear them confidently even in the shower.

#### Why choose Alert Care's Lockbox?

With our Lockbox, you can avoid the physical and financial repercussions of emergency responders
forcing their way into the home. Simply create your own four-digit code, securely stored by us and
only revealed in emergencies. It will be shared with first responders or a loved one if there’s an
emergency.

#### Who benefits from an Alert Care medical alert system?

Our systems cater to individuals of all ages who:
* Live alone or spend extended periods alone during the day
* Have medical conditions requiring immediate attention, such as epilepsy, seizures, strokes, and
heart conditions
* Are recovering from major surgeries, falls, heart attacks, or hip replacements
* Experience hearing difficulties and may find it challenging to communicate with 911 during
emergencies
* Prefer the independence of living in their own home
* Desire the freedom to continue living life on their own terms

#### Why choose an Alert Care medical alert device over a cell phone for emergencies?

Our devices are specifically designed for safety, featuring highly water-resistant wearable buttons
ideal for use in the shower. Unlike a cell phone, which may not always be within reach during an
emergency, our devices provide reliable access to help at all times. Whether worn discreetly around
your neck or on a belt clip, our devices ensure you’re always prepared for emergencies with just a
simple button press. Plus, they offer more than just emergency assistance – you can also use them to
contact family members or loved ones instantly. The convenience and ease of use of our products
truly set them apart from traditional cell phones, especially when it matters most in an emergency.

#### What should I know about fall prevention?

As we age, the risk of falling rises. Falls pose significant dangers for older adults, often
resulting in fractures, hospitalization, and disability. Fortunately, many falls can be prevented.

## AC Smartwatch

**With Monthly Monitoring Subscription**

AC Smartwatch offers an economical yet advanced Mobile Personal Emergency Response System (MPERS)
designed for active individuals who want to explore their surroundings confidently. This innovative
device ensures users can easily access assistance from anywhere within the United States, providing
peace of mind for both the wearers and their loved ones. The AC Smartwatch is only $119 to own the
unit.

The AC Smartwatch requires monthly monitoring to ensure continuous and reliable emergency response
services. This fee is $39.95/month and will be added to your cart. Optional fall detection is
available during checkout.

## Revolutionizing Safety and Independence

The AC Smartwatch is an affordable, advanced safety device for active seniors. It offers 24/7
US-wide assistance, health and location tracking and easy communication features, fostering
independence and peace of mind.

#### All-Day Battery Life

Best-in-class check-in and monitoring configuration allows up to 24 hours of battery life.

#### Location Detection

The combination of GPS and WiFi provides the fastest and most accurate location service.

#### Full Sensor Suite

Customers can monitor their heart rate and daily step count using our simple touch interface.

#### Weather Forecast

Users can view the detailed weather forecast for today.

#### Water Resistant

Designed for daily wear, AC Smartwatch is shower-safe but should not be fully submerged.

#### Text to Locate

Increase RMR with this innovation, allowing caregivers to locate the device with a simple text
message.

### Optional Fall Detection

Fall Detection is a great failsafe option and an added level of protection for your Alert Care
device. While you should always push your button in an emergency, your fall will be automatically
detected by your AC Smartwatch and an alarm will be sent to the emergency response center.
* Cost is an additional $9.99 per month
* Works anywhere you go in the U.S. provided there is AT&T cellular service in your area.

[Add to cart][34]

When fall detection is added to your account, battery life may be reduced.
Since no fall detection system detects 100% of falls, if able, subscribers should press their help
button in any emergency.

## AC Mobile-W

AC Mobile-W is a wrist-worn emergency system with 4G LTE coverage nationwide. It offers optional
fall detection and a robust two-way communication feature, ensuring immediate assistance is always
accessible. With a weekly charge, this shower-safe, water-resistant device is perfect for active
individuals seeking discreet, 24/7 safety. Our commitment to the latest technology ensures top-tier
emergency response services. The AC Mobile-W is only $99 to own the unit.

The AC Mobile-W requires monthly monitoring to ensure continuous and reliable emergency response
services. This fee is $34.95/month and will be added to your cart. Optional fall detection is
available during checkout.

## Power Up Your Protection

AC Mobile-W Wearable adapts to your needs, offering extended battery life that keeps pace with your
active lifestyle. Less charging means more time for what matters most, with peace of mind always
within reach.

#### Cellular Coverage

Stay connected anywhere using Verizon and AT&T networks, ensuring nationwide coverage.

#### Battery Life

Enjoy 1-2 days with fall detection on, or extend to 7 days in standard mode.

#### Water-Resistant

Designed for daily wear, AC Mobile-W is shower-safe but should not be fully submerged.

#### Instant Help

Press a button for a quick VRI Care Center connection, ensuring independence and safety.

#### Direct Communication

Communicate directly during emergencies via a powerful two-way speaker-and-microphone system.

#### Fall Detection

Enhances safety with automatic care center alerts if a fall is detected, adding peace of mind.

### Optional Fall Detection

Fall Detection is a great failsafe option and an added level of protection for your Alert Care
device. While you should always push your button in an emergency, your fall will be automatically
detected by your AC Mobile-W and an alarm will be sent to the emergency response center.
* Cost is an additional $9.99 per month
* Works anywhere you go in the U.S. provided there is AT&T cellular service in your area.

When fall detection is added to your account, battery life may be reduced.
Since no fall detection system detects 100% of falls, if able, subscribers should press their help
button in any emergency.

## AC Home Cellular

Introducing the AC Home Cellular 4G medical alarm system, known for its reliability and ease of use.
With an intuitive voice prompt for seamless sensor setup and emergency guidance, safety has never
been easier. Enjoy crystal-clear two-way voice communication, connecting you directly to the
Monitoring Center for prompt assistance. The AC Home Cellular is your reliable companion, providing
peace of mind to both users and their loved ones, knowing that help is just a button press away.

**The AC Home Cellular comes with one [AC Pendant][29]. From the bottom of the cart page, you’ll
have the option to add another pendant or fall detection for a second household member.**

The AC Home Cellular is only $99 to own the unit.

The AC Home Cellular requires monthly monitoring to ensure continuous and reliable emergency
response services. This fee is $34.95/month and will be added to your cart. Optional fall detection
is available during checkout.

$99.00

## Elevate Your Peace of Mind

The AC Home Cellular goes beyond the basics to offer advanced safety and communication features.
Designed to provide users and their families with peace of mind, it integrates cutting-edge
technology with user-friendly functionality.

#### Voice Prompt

Offers step-by-step voice instructions for easy setup, emergency responses, and system status
checks.

#### Hands-Free Voice

Enables direct, echo-free communication with the Monitoring Center for immediate assistance.

#### Remote Sensor Setup

Quickly integrate safety sensors into the system remotely by ID, enhancing home security.

#### Alarm Reporting

Supports CID, SMS, or Speech over 3G / 4G networks for timely emergency alerts.

#### Sensor Integration

Allows connection of multiple devices for a comprehensive safety network within the home.

#### Certification

Complies with UL1635 & 1637, CSA C22.2 No. 205, CE, and FCC standards for reliability.

### Optional Fall Detection

Fall Detection is a great failsafe option and an added level of protection for your Alert Care
device. While you should always push your button in an emergency, your fall will be automatically
detected by your AC Home Cellular and an alarm will be sent to the emergency response center.
* Cost is an additional $9.99 per month
* Works anywhere you go in the U.S. provided there is AT&T cellular service in your area.

[Add to cart][30]

When fall detection is added to your account, battery life may be reduced.
Since no fall detection system detects 100% of falls, if able, subscribers should press their help
button in any emergency.

# About us

There’s no assurance in life. At one moment, we could be lying in bed, paralyze and could not walk.
Accidents happen as accidents. There’s no way that we will know when these dangers occur to you. We
are prone to danger anytime and anywhere we are. Nonetheless, even the richest and most powerful guy
in the world could experience these things, how much simple human could be?

That is why, you should never get always be relaxed. There’s nothing to be worried only if you’ll
keep everybody guarded and protected in case something bad takes place. There is something we could
do to attend to this issue with just a basic push of a button, with no complications and any medical
help will come to you.

### What are we providing?

In a life where we don’t get any guarantee, it is necessary to always be safe when something bad
happens to us and to our loved ones. It is vital that we could contact immediately any medical
services or to anyone for assistance every time the situation seems to call on.

That is why, we offer you effective medical alert system services with the pool of experts and
operators that will keep you worry-free anywhere you are in the locality. Assured, we will bring
matters fast track without giving you difficulties on nonessential queries. We will carry a quick
solution to your medical problem and will reach out to the suitable team to address the concern that
you have.

### Who are our potential clients?

Primarily, everybody could utilize this medical alert system. Unfortunate incidents and medical
threats could occur to anybody. There’s nothing wrong when you are just ensuring of every little
thing. Medical alert systems are not only for unhealthy or senior who really needs severe medical
attention. Our medical alert services are accessible to everybody who would like to stay protected
in their life from day to day activity. Whether you are a grown-up man or female, a young adult, or
an elderly already, we will be making sure that you’ll be supplied the most suitable procedure when
this type of emergencies call you to.

#### Medical Emergencies: Who is very most at risk?

But nevertheless, the majority of the customers who make use of these services are those who are
aged people and are at sick. They are most in danger for medical distress. As a consequence, they
need to have the most medical assistance. That is why our company often tends to give significance
to every senior citizen or impaired people who register for our services.

### Why Consider Our Business?

Our company provides a wide range of medical emergency system services to provide comfort to our
clients. We expand our assistance and take advantage of the most up to date technology to readily
get in touch with you out whenever and wherever you are in the area. We surely not just preserve
lives but we often ensure to keep you secure. We will establish peace of mind and assurance that you
had never felt before.

### Reach out to Us

If you are planning and would like to make use our support services, then you could comfortably get
in touch with us by calling with our phone number. You could also reach our office located not far
away the community.

What is PERS?

Alert Medical Alarms Personal Emergency Response Systems (PERS) are specialized products and solutions designed to provide immediate assistance and support to individuals to promote better social determinants of health (SDOH) outcomes. The primary purpose of PERS is to ensure the safety and well-being of users by connecting them to a monitoring center or a designated caregiver when help is needed.

Typically, an AMA PERS consists of a wearable device, such as a pendant or a GPS smartwatch, which the user can activate with a simple push of a button. When the button is pressed, the device establishes a communication link with a central monitoring station staffed by 5 diamond certified operators 24/7. These operators can assess the situation, communicate with the user, and take appropriate action based on the nature of the emergency.

AMA PERS can assist members with everything; Social Isolation, Elder Maltreatment Dementia and Wondering, Satey and Security, and of course, Reduce The Impact of Falls . Alert Medical Alarms PERS is at the forefront of cutting-edge innovation when it comes to solving real-time concerns for Managed Care trying to achieve positive yet cost-effective outcomes for their participants in the surge of the looming caregiver shortage crisis. We are simply there when caregivers may not be.

What is PERS?

Alert Medical Alarms Personal Emergency Response Systems (PERS) are specialized products and solutions designed to provide immediate assistance and support to individuals to promote better social determinants of health (SDOH) outcomes. The primary purpose of PERS is to ensure the safety and well-being of users by connecting them to a monitoring center or a designated caregiver when help is needed.

Typically, an AMA PERS consists of a wearable device, such as a pendant or a GPS smartwatch, which the user can activate with a simple push of a button. When the button is pressed, the device establishes a communication link with a central monitoring station staffed by 5 diamond certified operators 24/7. These operators can assess the situation, communicate with the user, and take appropriate action based on the nature of the emergency.

AMA PERS can assist members with everything; Social Isolation, Elder Maltreatment Dementia and Wondering, Satey and Security, and of course, Reduce The Impact of Falls . Alert Medical Alarms PERS is at the forefront of cutting-edge innovation when it comes to solving real-time concerns for Managed Care trying to achieve positive yet cost-effective outcomes for their participants in the surge of the looming caregiver shortage crisis. We are simply there when caregivers may not be.

# Memory Care
# Package

## Finding lost loved ones

# Finding lost loved ones

[ Download PDF ][22]

## Lost Mom?

Our Cognitive Impairment Package is the complete set up to help find family members and loved ones.
When in a crisis, our text to locate feature is your solution.

## What if she takes
## off the device?

Our smartwatch has a wristband that locks. This is a great solution for cognitively impaired members
who may tamper or take their devices off!

[smartwatch]

## Locking wristband

Simple Turn-key Solution Locks wrist band in place.

## Can we prevent elopement?

We have door and bed alarms that alert all family members and caregivers in the home when a member
may try to wander. We’ve helped thousands of members with this solution.

## Is this an extra cost?

NO! Our package is totally complimentary with your members PERS authorization. Schedule time to
train with our team today!

## Safe and Secure

Lockboxes are a great addition to your members medical alert system in the event EMS needs to access
their home during an emergency.

## Know your lockboxes

The lockbox hangs easily on any doorknob, fence, or railing. We can have the code preset with your
members PERS device so, EMS will know before arriving to the scene.

[grandchildren-grandmother]
[Successful-grandparents]

## Is this an extra cost?

NO! AMA Lock Box are complimentary with your client’s PERS authorization. If you have a client with
any need or challenge, please call your case manager specialist and tell us the situation. Together
we can solve most problems.
Necessity is the mother of invention. When we know needs, we create solutions. Schedule time to
train with our team today!

## Safe and Security

At Alert Medical Alarms (AMA), our mission is to empower families and caregivers with innovative
tools to ensure the safety and well-being of their most vulnerable loved ones. Through close
collaboration with our dedicated Case Managers, we develop tailored solutions that address the
unique needs of each client. Our enhanced Safety and Security Solutions, seamlessly integrated with
a client’s Personal Emergency Response System (PERS) authorization, provide peace of mind and
elevate care to new heights.

For individuals with dementia or those prone to wandering, AMA’s cutting-edge security camera
systems offer a comprehensive safety strategy that prioritizes both protection and dignity. Here’s
how AMA’s solutions make a difference:

## Key Benefits of AMA’s Safety and Security Solutions

**Real-Time Observation for Immediate Response**

****With AMA’s advanced security cameras, families and caregivers can monitor their loved ones in
real time. Whether it’s checking in during the day or responding to an unexpected event, this
technology fosters peace of mind and ensures loved ones are safe, no matter the time or distance.
The ability to stay connected enhances involvement in care, keeping families in the loop and ready
to act when needed.

[cctv camera]

**Pattern Identification for Proactive Care****
**Our video review capabilities allow caregivers to analyze patterns in behavior, such as wandering
tendencies or daily routines. By identifying these patterns, families and Case Managers can develop
proactive strategies to prevent incidents and improve overall care plans, ensuring a safer and more
comfortable environment.

**Hazard Monitoring for a Safer Home****
**AMA’s security cameras help monitor living spaces for potential hazards, such as cluttered
walkways or unsafe conditions. This proactive approach promotes a safer home environment, reducing
the risk of accidents and ensuring your loved one’s space is optimized for their well-being.

**Caregiver Interaction Insights for Quality Assurance****
**Our solutions provide visibility into caregiver interactions, ensuring that your loved one
receives high-quality, compassionate assistance. This transparency fosters trust and accountability,
giving families confidence that their loved ones are in good hands.

[cctv cameras]

## Balancing Safety with Privacy and Dignity

At AMA, we understand the importance of preserving privacy and dignity while enhancing safety. Our
security camera systems are designed to focus on key areas of the home, ensuring monitoring is
effective without being intrusive. This balance allows families to protect their loved ones while
respecting their autonomy.

## Beyond Cameras:
## Explore AMA’s Lockbox Technology

For added protection, we encourage families to explore our lockbox technology, which provides secure
access to the home for authorized caregivers and emergency responders. This additional layer of
security ensures that help is always available when needed, further safeguarding your loved one.

## Take the Next Step with AMA

AMA’s Safety and Security Solutions are more than just technology—they’re a lifeline for families
and caregivers. By integrating real-time monitoring, hazard detection, and caregiver insights, we
empower you to keep an eye on your loved ones, right in the palm of your hand.

To learn more about how AMA can enhance safety and security for your family, schedule a training
session with your Case Manager specialist today. Email [**training@alertmedicalalarms.com**][23]

## Empowering Care Managers with Transparent Updates

As a service coordinator or care manager, you know that clear, timely communication isn’t just a
courtesy—it’s the foundation of trust and effective care. At Alert Medical Alarms (AMA), we
prioritize communication in every interaction, ensuring you stay informed throughout the process.
From the moment you submit an authorization to the final device activation, our process is designed
to keep you informed, reducing uncertainty and allowing you to focus on what matters most: your
clients’ well-being.

Our commitment to open, proactive dialogue has helped us build lasting partnerships with care teams
across America’s Managed Care landscape. Whether it’s a quick email confirmation or a collaborative
troubleshooting call, we’re here to make the transition smooth, efficient, and client-centered.

## Why Communication Drives Our Success

Nurturing relationships starts with transparency. Here’s how our communication-first approach
supports you and your clients:
* **Immediate Acknowledgment of Authorizations**: As soon as you initiate and submit an
authorization, our Intake Department sends a personalized email confirming receipt and outlining
next steps. No more radio silence— you’ll know we’re on it right away.
* **Proactive Follow-Ups for Seamless Connections**: If we encounter any hurdles in reaching your
client (like scheduling conflicts or address clarifications), we’ll loop you in immediately via
email or phone. We’re collaborative partners, not just vendors, ensuring issues are resolved
swiftly without derailing timelines.
* **Comprehensive Installation Notifications**: Once your client is connected and the device is
installed, you can expect a detailed email summarizing the process. This includes confirmation of
satisfactory setup, successful testing, and the training provided—whether in-person or over the
phone. We celebrate these milestones with you so that you can update records with confidence
* **Flexible Training Tailored to Your Client’s Needs**: We’re experts in no-contact installations,
guiding even the most tech-savvy (or not-so-savvy) clients through setup via phone—just like
teaching them to master the remote control. Our clients often surprise us with innovative tips
that make us better, and we’re always eager to learn. For those who thrive on face-to-face
support, we offer in-person visits upon request. This might extend the timeline slightly, but it
ensures the best outcome every time.

Both methods are highly effective, and we’re flexible to accommodate your preferences. Please let us
know during the referral process, and we’ll prioritize accordingly.

[checking-her-work]

## The AMA Difference: Communication That Cares

Our process isn’t just efficient—it’s empathetic. By keeping you informed, we minimize disruptions
to your workflow and maximize your clients’ independence. Thousands of families and care teams trust
us because we treat every update as an opportunity to strengthen our shared commitment to safety and
support.

Ready to experience communication that truly partners with your team? Contact our Intake Department
today at [intake@alertmedicalalarms.com][23] to discuss authorizations or request a demo at
[training@alertmedicalalarms.com][24]

## Real Stories, Real Impact

The combination of our PERS and Perfect Petzzz pets is transforming lives. Families share
heartwarming stories of loved ones naming their plush companions and finding solace in their gentle
presence. Caregivers in memory care settings report reduced agitation and increased tactile
engagement among residents. One daughter shared, “My mom’s Perfect Petzzz kitten gives her something
soft to hold onto during tough days, and the PERS gives our family peace of mind knowing she’s
protected.” With these affordable companions gaining popularity in homes and communities nationwide,
and our PERS trusted by tens of thousands of clients, this partnership is a game-changer for
cost-conscious care.

**Testimonial:**

## At Alert Medical Alarms, we’re dedicated to empowering seniors to live with independence,
## dignity, and security—whether at home or in their communities. Our Personal Emergency Response
## Systems (PERS) have been a lifeline for countless individuals, providing instant access to help
## when it matters most. Today, we’re excited to introduce an innovative new offering that enhances
## our commitment to holistic senior care: Perfect Petzzz Interactive Plush Pets. By pairing our
## industry-leading PERS with these lifelike, budget-friendly companions, we’re addressing both
## physical safety and emotional well-being like never before—without breaking the bank.

[ Download PDF ][23]

## A Powerful Combination: Safety Meets Emotional Support

Our PERS devices are designed to support seniors facing unique challenges, including **dementia &
wandering, social isolation, elder maltreatment,** and **reducing the impact of falls.** Our
packages are fully covered by **Medicaid waivers or grant funding**. These devices offer powerful
interventions that keep clients safe and connected. Now, with the addition of **Perfect Petzzz
Interactive Plush Pets**, we’re taking senior care to the next level by fostering joy, reducing
loneliness, and enhancing quality of life—all at an accessible price point.

[tabby cat bundle]

**Perfect Petzzz plush puppies** and kittens are more than adorable companions; they’re thoughtfully
designed tools that provide emotional comfort, particularly for seniors with Alzheimer’s, dementia,
or those living alone. Crafted from soft, hypoallergenic synthetic fur, these pets feature realistic
breathing motions and gentle snoring sounds that activate with a simple touch or when placed in
their cozy bed—delivering the soothing warmth of companionship without the responsibilities of
caring for a real animal. At a fraction of the cost of more advanced robotic options, Perfect Petzzz
makes therapeutic pet therapy available to everyone. Together, our PERS ensures safety, while
Perfect Petzzz brings daily moments of calm and happiness.

[beagle-plush]

## How AMA PERS and Perfect Petzzz Work Together

Our PERS systems are tailored to address critical needs:
* **Dementia & Wandering:** GPS-enabled PERS devices help locate clients who may wander, ensuring
their safety and granting loved ones peace of mind.
* **Social Isolation:** By connecting clients to caregivers or emergency services, our systems
foster connection and engagement with a special touch of kindness.
* **Elder Maltreatment:** Instant access to help empowers clients to report concerns and stay
protected, while enhanced monitoring supports those at risk.
* **Reducing Fall Impacts:** Fall detection technology alerts responders immediately, minimizing
injury risks.

## Complementing these features, Perfect Petzzz Interactive Plush Pets add emotional and cognitive
## support:

Our PERS systems are tailored to address critical needs:
* **Lifelike and Low-Maintenance:** These pets simulate gentle breathing and soft sounds, responding
to cuddles with a calming rise and fall of the chest—powered by simple batteries with no need for
feeding or vet care.
* **Emotional Benefits:** User experiences and studies on plush companions show these pets reduce
anxiety, improve mood, and encourage sensory engagement, especially for those with dementia or
experiencing isolation.
* **Personalized Companionship:** Clients can choose from beloved breeds like fluffy Huskies, Golden
Retrievers, Orange Tabby Cats, or Calicos, creating a personal bond that feels just like a
sleeping pet in their arms.
* **Trusted and Accessible:** Ideal for home use or senior living, Perfect Petzzz pets are durable,
fully washable, and making them a practical choice for facilities and families alike
[puppy being pet]

Imagine a senior with dementia wearing our PERS pendant to stay safe from wandering, while their
Perfect Petzzz plush puppy breathes softly against their chest during quiet moments, easing
agitation and sparking a sense of comfort. This powerful duo addresses both safety and emotional
health, creating a more fulfilling life—all while staying well within budget constraints.

## Accessible and Supported by Expert Training

At Alert Medical Alarms, we believe in making care accessible and effective. Our PERS devices are
fully covered by Medicaid waivers or grant funding, ensuring no one is left behind. We also provide
comprehensive training for care managers, service coordinators, and teams to unlock the full
potential of our systems and the Perfect Petzzz offering. Interested in learning more about our
training programs? Email us at **training@alertmedicalalarms.com** to get started!

## Redefining Senior Care

At Alert Medical Alarms, we’re not just about responding to emergencies—we’re about helping seniors
thrive. By combining our PERS—fully covered by Medicaid waivers or grants—with the heartwarming
companionship of Perfect Petzzz plush pets, we’re addressing dementia & wandering, social isolation,
elder maltreatment, and fall risks, while bringing affordable joy to everyday life. With expert
training for care teams, we’re ensuring these tools make a lasting difference.

# Ensuring

## ADAPTATIVE DEVICES

## Adaptive Devices

[ Download PDF ][22]

Of course, we know there are many members with certain limitations, and we’ve always been able to
figure out ways to assist almost all clients. Utilizing adaptive devices in technology is crucial
for ensuring accessibility and inclusivity for all users. Alternative ways to activate devices to
call for help include pillow push pads, sip-and-puff devices, and switches for the visually
impaired. These can all be implemented to modify your clients’ solutions. Alert Medical Alarms’
Adaptive Device solutions are only limited by our imagination. That is why we rely heavily on yours

## Here are some favorites:

## Pillow Switches

The Pillow Switch is a wired single assistive technology device activated by a client’s head or
cheek and conveniently positioned with velcro.

This assistive technology can easily be fastened to a pillow or wheelchair cushion with a safety pin
and Velcro. Visual and auditory feedback occurs when the wired single switch is activated. It has a
smooth and soft foam surface ideal for activation by the user’s head or cheek no matter where
pressed

This soft, flexible foam-encased switch makes an excellent activation solution for users with
limited physical movement or dexterity.

## What is Sip and Puff?

This assistive technology is a form of switch system that sends signals through air pressure by
having users sip (inhale) or puff (exhale) through a tube, straw, or wand.

Users can calibrate their SNP device to recognize their ability to sip and puff, which allows the
client to activate their AMA Pers

Our 36-inch Easy Flex Sip and Puff Switch is ideal for users with limited mobility or physical
challenges, allowing mouth operation.

## Bright Switch for the
## Visually Impaired

A great choice for visually impaired users, this switch’s bright blinking light makes it easy to
locate. When the switch is activated, its textured yellow light shines, music plays and the switch
vibrates.

## Is this an extra cost?

NO! AMA Adaptive Devices are complimentary with your client’s PERS authorization.

If you have a client with any need or challenge, please call your case manager specialist and tell
us the situation. Together we can solve most problems.

Necessity is the mother of invention. When we know needs, we create solutions. Schedule time to
train with our team today!

## FAQ About BeWell Medical Alert Necklaces
* ### Is the medical alert necklace waterproof?

The product is water-resistant and safe to wear while showering or washing hands. However, to
protect the components, we recommend removing the necklace for extended submersion, like in a bath
or swimming pool.
* ### Does it include GPS?

Yes, every necklace comes with a built-in GPS. This allows emergency responders to locate the user
accurately, even if they’re outside the home.
* ### Can I get fall detection?

Absolutely. You can choose a model with automatic fall detection. The device will remain alert if
your loved one falls and can’t press the SOS button.
* ### How much does BeWell Mini SOS Button cost?

The device itself is completely free — you only pay for your plan. Choose from monthly, quarterly,
or annual billing options, with the annual plan offering the best value. You can even split the
annual payment into installments.
* ### Does it work without Wi-Fi?

Yes. The alert system uses cellular connectivity and doesn’t rely on Wi-Fi. It’s ideal for seniors
who don’t use Wi-Fi but still want reliable, on-the-go protection.

## In-Home Alert System – Common Questions
* ### Do I need a phone line or Wi‑Fi?

No. Our home emergency alert system uses a reliable cellular connection, so there’s no need for a
landline or internet. It stays active 24/7 to keep you protected.
* ### What happens if the power goes out?

The system automatically switches to its backup battery, keeping you connected for over 30 hours
during power outages.
* ### Is it set up complicated?

Not at all. Just plug the device into an outlet and press the activation button. It’s ready in
minutes — no tools, no technician.
* ### Can it be used in the bathroom?

Yes. The emergency button is water-resistant and safe for use in high-humidity environments, such
as showers.
* ### How much of my home does it cover?

The system covers up to 50 SQM and supports additional home medical alert devices if needed —
ideal for larger homes or multiple rooms.

the commitment to keeping the solution simple and intuitive, BluePoint provides critical information

!important;}”]**Visual Point Identification:**
A map of the facility, clearly indicating the location of the activated pull station, advises where
in a facility the incident started. This is critical for emergency responders, building leaders, and
designated employees. This data intuitively empowers people with actionable information for saving
their own life and the lives of those around them.

**Security Camera Feeds:**
The solution can make live camera feeds available to first responders and building leaders in a way
that is organized and easily understood—crucial for all responders. Instead of using cameras to look
at what happened in the past, the system can make them a critical tool to learn what is happening in
the moment.

**Location & Reunification:**
People can report their location, and—during the crisis only—have their location tracked. This
allows emergency responders to see where people are, where they are moving to, and where they are
moving from. It also provides a means for people to respond with their status (“I’m okay” or “Need
help”) so emergency responders can get a quicker handle on the severity of the situation. Lastly, it
enables building leaders to more quickly account for their people during the reunification
process.[/vc_column_text]

# Meet Our Team

BluePoint Alert Solutions has its origins in the aftermath of the tragic Sandy Hook school shooting
in Connecticut. During a regular client meeting with a local school district, John McNutt and
Stephen Nelson discussed with the District Superintendent the idea of a user-friendly, rapid
notification system to immediately connect schools with law enforcement and how valuable it could be
to saving lives in extreme emergency situations. From this conversation, BluePoint Alert Solutions
was born.

that is organized and easily understood—crucial for all responders. Instead of using cameras to look
at what happened in the past, the system can make them a critical tool to learn what is happening in
the moment.

**Location & Reunification:**
People can report their location, and—during the crisis only—have their location tracked. This
allows emergency responders to see where people are, where they are moving to, and where they are
moving from. It also provides a means for people to respond with their status (“I’m okay” or “Need
help”) so emergency responders can get a quicker handle on the severity of the situation. Lastly, it
enables building leaders to more quickly account for their people during the reunification
process.[/vc_column_text]

##### What is the BluePoint Police Alert system?

The BluePoint Police Alert system is a rapid emergency response system designed to immediately
notify law enforcement and key personnel during active threats, lockdowns, or other urgent security
incidents in schools, corporate buildings, and other facilities.

##### How is Police Alert activated?

The system can be activated via wall-mounted pull stations, pre-fabricated Compact Response Units
(CRUs), wearable pendants or panic buttons, instantly alerting the central monitoring station and
sending notifications to first responders.

##### Can Police Alert integrate with existing security systems?

Yes. It integrates with access control, cameras, mass notification systems, and other building
security devices to provide a coordinated emergency response.

##### How quickly does law enforcement get notified?

Activation triggers near-instant notification to law enforcement via direct digital channels and
phone calls, ensuring response in seconds.

Yes. The system is designed to meet life-safety requirements and provide real-time situational
awareness for administrators and first responders.

# Command & Control

**BluePoint’s Command & Control platform transforms emergency communication into real-time
coordination. **With integrated alerts, live mapping, and instant data sharing, it empowers
responders and facility leaders to make faster, smarter decisions. Automated notifications and
visual intelligence deliver complete situational awareness, keeping everyone connected and informed
through every stage of an incident.

[Contact Us][28]

## Incident Management System

Building occupants provide real-time situational awareness to the Command Group through simple text
or email responses.

#### Familiar + Intuitive

Similar in appearance and function to the universal pull station, the BluePoint system is simple and
intuitive to activate

#### Fast + Reliable

Automated, reliable rapid response system notifies building occupants and first responders within
life-saving seconds

#### Versatile + Dynamic

The BluePoint system can be customized to fit each building's needs and provides real-time, two-way
communication

## What's Included

With BluePoint, your teachers, staff, students and visitors have the most simple, intuitive, and
responsive means to neutralize a threat.

#### 2-Way Communication Portal

Building occupants provide real-time situational awareness to the Command Group through simple text
or email responses. Common word filtering offers the Command Group quick insights into the
information being provided. The Command Group is equipped to provide faster, more informed
instructions to the building occupants.

#### Map (Floorplan)

Your facility layout with pertinent information for informed decisions.

#### Mobile Alerts & Notifications

Instant text, e-mail, and voice communication with designated groups. The Command Group has access
to all information from any device through the emergency mobile command center.

Situational awareness is gained through automated texts, emails, and phone calls to key stakeholders
within a facility.

#### Live Security Camera Links

Select individuals can be given access to view live security camera feeds on the premises during an
emergency. Real time information is crucial to an effective response by building occupants and first
responders.

#### Location & Reunification

People can report their location, and – during the crisis only – have their location tracked. This
allows first responders to see where people are, where they are moving to, and where they are moving
from. It also provides a means for people to respond with their status: “I’m okay” or “Need Help”,
which enables first responders to get a quicker handle on the severity of the situation. Lastly, it
enables building leaders to more quickly account for their people during the reunification process.

## Emergency Document Storage

Your emergency documents accessible and available for distribution

##### What is the BluePoint Command & Control platform?

##### How does Command & Control improve emergency coordination?

The platform consolidates alerts, provides dashboards for first responders and administrators,
enables role-based access, and supports multi-facility oversight.

##### Can Command & Control integrate with existing building systems?

Yes. It supports integration with access control, cameras, mass notification systems, and other

Admins can create unlimited user groups with role-based permissions to control who receives alerts,
who can activate devices, and who can manage the system.

protect sensitive information and ensure compliance with industry best practices.

## [Home][37] > [Support][38] > About Us

About Us

With an entrepreneurial spirit, beginning in 1954 as a custom engineering house, Monroe Electronics
was founded by Robert E. Vosteen, who specialized in designing and manufacturing instrumentation &
systems for local industries. By the late 1950s, he had invented a reliable, precise, drift-free
method for non-contact measurement of static electricity and his feedback electrostatic measurement
technique became the international standard for measurements utilized in photocopier R&D, industrial
monitoring, sensitive electronic assembly, bio-electric research, lightning warning among many other
applications. In the late 1960s timed & remote control were advancing and the company developed a
series of high-speed cue-tone decoders. The company designed and manufactured cue tone control
devices for a variety of circuits having an audio path – pioneering work in the early days of Cable
Television (CATV) industry led to developing a cue-tone switching for the fledgling Home Box Office
(HBO) movie service where the signals could be switched under unattended control. It was in this
same time period the company developed the first emergency override system for CATV. In 2003 Digital
Alert Systems' founders Bruce Robertson and Tom Wood determined that there were three important
issues surrounding Emergency Alerting Systems (EAS); The original scope of EAS was expanding –
becoming more important and critical to government agencies, the current equipment available was not
up to task and needed significant technological improvements, and a blended approach leveraging
preeminent information processing technology with network-centric thinking better served the
customer with a more relevant EAS platform that incorporated simplified and upgradable software to
ensure long-term viability. The result of this market-understanding and innovative thinking was the
DASDEC™ EAS Encoder-Decoder product line. Which, when certified by the FCC in 2004, revolutionized
the industry. Both company leaders identified the collective benefits to its customers and in 2005
Digital Alert Systems entered exclusive manufacturing and licensing agreements with Monroe
Electronics to manufacture and market the DASDEC for the Cable, IPTV, and Campus communications
industries under the One-Net™ brand. In late 2009 Digital Alert Systems and Monroe Electronics took
their partnership to a new level by merging operations, manufacturing and worldwide support under
one primary organization. Under this new chapter, Digital Alert Systems became a division of Monroe
Electronics. The combined Digital Alert Systems and Monroe Electronics organization maintained its
customer-centric focus while becoming the foremost market leader with units sold into the cable,
telecommunications, IPTV, and campuses throughout the world. In 2018, the company's focus emphasized
its commitment to the emergency messaging market and divested the electrostatic product line, and
with it the Monroe Electronics corporate name, formally making the enduring organization Digital
Alert Systems, Inc. At Digital Alert Systems, we remain dedicated to the company's initial vision -
create innovative improvements for emergency messaging products, with hardware, software, and
service, to address changing needs, leveraging superior technologies with a network-centric
approach, and providing customers with exceptional sales, service, and support.

## [Home][37] > [Support][38] > About Us

About Us

With an entrepreneurial spirit, beginning in 1954 as a custom engineering house, Monroe Electronics
was founded by Robert E. Vosteen, who specialized in designing and manufacturing instrumentation &
systems for local industries. By the late 1950s, he had invented a reliable, precise, drift-free
method for non-contact measurement of static electricity and his feedback electrostatic measurement
technique became the international standard for measurements utilized in photocopier R&D, industrial
monitoring, sensitive electronic assembly, bio-electric research, lightning warning among many other
applications. In the late 1960s timed & remote control were advancing and the company developed a
series of high-speed cue-tone decoders. The company designed and manufactured cue tone control
devices for a variety of circuits having an audio path – pioneering work in the early days of Cable
Television (CATV) industry led to developing a cue-tone switching for the fledgling Home Box Office
(HBO) movie service where the signals could be switched under unattended control. It was in this
same time period the company developed the first emergency override system for CATV. In 2003 Digital
Alert Systems' founders Bruce Robertson and Tom Wood determined that there were three important
issues surrounding Emergency Alerting Systems (EAS); The original scope of EAS was expanding –
becoming more important and critical to government agencies, the current equipment available was not
up to task and needed significant technological improvements, and a blended approach leveraging
preeminent information processing technology with network-centric thinking better served the
customer with a more relevant EAS platform that incorporated simplified and upgradable software to
ensure long-term viability. The result of this market-understanding and innovative thinking was the
DASDEC™ EAS Encoder-Decoder product line. Which, when certified by the FCC in 2004, revolutionized
the industry. Both company leaders identified the collective benefits to its customers and in 2005
Digital Alert Systems entered exclusive manufacturing and licensing agreements with Monroe
Electronics to manufacture and market the DASDEC for the Cable, IPTV, and Campus communications
industries under the One-Net™ brand. In late 2009 Digital Alert Systems and Monroe Electronics took
their partnership to a new level by merging operations, manufacturing and worldwide support under
one primary organization. Under this new chapter, Digital Alert Systems became a division of Monroe
Electronics. The combined Digital Alert Systems and Monroe Electronics organization maintained its
customer-centric focus while becoming the foremost market leader with units sold into the cable,
telecommunications, IPTV, and campuses throughout the world. In 2018, the company's focus emphasized
its commitment to the emergency messaging market and divested the electrostatic product line, and
with it the Monroe Electronics corporate name, formally making the enduring organization Digital
Alert Systems, Inc. At Digital Alert Systems, we remain dedicated to the company's initial vision -
create innovative improvements for emergency messaging products, with hardware, software, and
service, to address changing needs, leveraging superior technologies with a network-centric
approach, and providing customers with exceptional sales, service, and support.

# About Galaxy Medical Alert Systems

## Galaxy Medical Alert Systems

> With over 25 years of expertise in the alarm and security industries, our company has become one
> of the leading providers of medical alert systems for seniors and at-risk individuals across North
> America. The safety and care of a loved one is something we take very seriously. We treat every
> customer as if they were part of our own family.

### What We Offer

##### Galaxy Medical Alert Systems offers a variety of medical alert systems to ageing and at-risk
##### individuals. Our company firmly believes that everyone should be able to enjoy the freedom of
##### independent living and that this can be achieved with the security and peace of mind of a
##### personal medical alert system.

### Why Galaxy Medical Alert Systems?

We value honesty, integrity, respect, and most of all trust.
* ##### First-rate 24/7 emergency medical monitoring services
* ##### Modern and reliable personal medical alert technology
* ##### Expertly trained and certified emergency medical technicians
* ##### Emergency medical support in over 150 languages
* ##### Galaxy Medical Alert Systems Response Center is a CSAA Five Diamond certified monitoring
##### center

### Medical Alert Systems Are Ideal For:
* ##### Individuals that live alone
* ##### Individuals that require special assistance
* ##### Ageing individuals that remain in their own homes
* ##### Individuals with medical conditions

The Home Cellular Medical Alert System is a reliable, easy-to-use emergency response system designed
for individuals who spend most of their time at home and want immediate access to help in case of an
emergency.

Unlike traditional systems, this unit does not require a landline. It uses secure cellular
(3G/4G/LTE) technology to connect you directly to the Galaxy Medical Alert Response Centre at the
press of a button.

Whether it’s a fall, sudden illness, or any situation where help is needed quickly, trained
emergency operators are available 24/7 to assess the situation and dispatch assistance.
* Senior citizens and elderly individuals living independently
* Individuals with limited mobility or balance issues
* People recovering from surgery or medical procedures
* Individuals with chronic conditions such as heart disease, diabetes, or respiratory issues
* People living alone who want added peace of mind
* Individuals with hearing or vision impairments
* Anyone who may be at risk of falls or medical emergencies at home

caretakers or a monitoring station to communicate easily with the resident through voice only. It
works by recognizing a specific spoken phrase and triggering an alarm when needed. Multiple
Communicators can be installed throughout the home for added convenience.

# **How the LifeCall system works**

LifeCall Medical Alert Systems provides exceptional service, unmatched dependability, and a
commitment to enriching the lives of our clients is why LifeCall is trusted by thousands of families
across North America.

 


## **24/7 Monitoring**

With LifeCall Medical Alert Systems your home and loved ones are protected by advanced medical
monitoring technology which provide reliable security and continuous protection every hour of every
day. Our Response Centers support you around-the-clock with state-of-the-art technology backed by
powerful equipment, high-tech infrastructure and secure communication links.


## **Alarm Activated**

No matter the time, day or night, if you sense trouble simply press the alert button on your
wristband or pendant. A signal will be sent to the Response Center and a professional emergency
response operator will quickly establish two-way communication.

## **E****mergency Response**

As soon as an alarm signal is received, one of the CSAA-certified Emergency Care Specialists on our
safety and security monitoring team will inquire as to whether you are okay or need assistance and,
if there is an emergency, the appropriate party(s) will be notified and/or a responder (medical,
fire or police) will be dispatched.

# Why families choose LifeCall

When you want safety and security for your loved ones, your home and your possessions, you owe it to
yourself and your family to explore our **Medical Alert Systems** with 24/7 protection solutions.

Our Experience

#### [Our Experience][36]

[LifeCall Medical Alert Systems has over 40 years of experience in life safety and security
solutions for seniors and at-risk persons seeking to retain their independence and remain in their
own homes.][37]
[LEARN MORE →][38]

Our Capabilities

#### [Our Capabilities][39]

[The cornerstone of LifeCall’s nationwide service is a 24/7 US-based UL^{®}-listed, FM-Approved and
CSAA 5-Diamond Certified Response Center, in which every Emergency Care Specialist on our safety and
security monitoring team is CSAA Level I or Level II certified.][40]
[LEARN MORE →][41]

Our Technology

#### [Our Technology][42]

[LifeCall Medical Alert system platforms only incorporate the most rugged, durable and reliable
technology available. Our hospital-grade medical alert devices feature the technology of global
leaders in medical communications with millions of systems in use around the world.][43]
[LEARN MORE →][44]

Our Support

#### [Our Support][45]

[LifeCall supports over 150 different languages to communicate with our non-English or
English-as-Second-Language clients. Popular options include: Chinese, Spanish, Polish, French, and
Vietnamese.][46]
[LEARN MORE →][47]

Our Responsiveness

#### [Our Responsiveness][48]

[The moment an alarm signal is received at our Response Center, trained safety and security
Emergency Care Specialists assess the situation and, as necessary, contact family members,
neighbors, or dispatch emergency services.][49]
[LEARN MORE →][50]

Our Service

#### [Our Service][51]

[The moment an alarm signal is received at our Response Center, trained safety and security
Emergency Care Specialists assess the situation and, as necessary, contact family members,
neighbors, or dispatch emergency services.][52]
[LEARN MORE →][53]

# What will LifeCall cost you?

There are numerous options for medical alert devices in the marketplace, with different fee
structures depending on the service provider and the sophistication of the system. The value of a
medical alert system from LifeCall includes:

Fewer out-of-pocket expenses related to assisted living, in-home health, institutional or facility
care
Increased sense of security, self-sufficiency and confidence with living alone
Fewer medical costs and complications resulting from long lie times after a fall
Greater confidence in functioning independently and safely at home increases the likelihood of
remaining there

LifeCall has several options depending on the plan you choose. No matter which system is best for
you, you can rest assured that you will never have to purchase equipment, pay activation or
installation fees, sign a long-term contract – and the price is guaranteed to never go up once you
subscribe!

Safety is important at home! Our In-Home systems are great for those who live independently and want

# **How the LifeCall system works**

LifeCall Medical Alert Systems provides exceptional service, unmatched dependability, and a
commitment to enriching the lives of our clients is why LifeCall is trusted by thousands of families
across North America.

 


## **24/7 Monitoring**

With LifeCall Medical Alert Systems your home and loved ones are protected by advanced medical
monitoring technology which provide reliable security and continuous protection every hour of every
day. Our Response Centers support you around-the-clock with state-of-the-art technology backed by
powerful equipment, high-tech infrastructure and secure communication links.


## **Alarm Activated**

No matter the time, day or night, if you sense trouble simply press the alert button on your
wristband or pendant. A signal will be sent to the Response Center and a professional emergency
response operator will quickly establish two-way communication.

## **E****mergency Response**

As soon as an alarm signal is received, one of the CSAA-certified Emergency Care Specialists on our
safety and security monitoring team will inquire as to whether you are okay or need assistance and,
if there is an emergency, the appropriate party(s) will be notified and/or a responder (medical,
fire or police) will be dispatched.

# Arthritis; Aging of the Bones

Our bodies consist of 206 bones and each one is attached with a separate joint. Damage to these
joints can result in Arthritis. Mostly, it occurs in old age, but certain injuries can also result
in Arthritis at a younger age. The symptoms of this disease seem common at first like joint pain and
swelling, but as Arthritis develops stiffness in the bones starts. Furthermore, Arthritis reduces
the range of motion in the joint with skin discoloration, increased sensitivity to touch, and a
feeling of heat around the joints.

Arthritis varies in its types. Some of the most common ones include Osteoarthritis, Rheumatoid
Arthritis, Gout, and Juvenile Arthritis. This study focuses on Osteoarthritis and how the MedAlert
device benefited an individual’s life. People with Osteoarthritis in an accident or other medical
emergency require immediate access to medical facilities. This is Farhan’s story, a MedAlert Care
member.

# Living with Seizures

A sudden and uncontrolled burst of electrical activity in the brain is commonly known as a seizure.
This abnormal activity causes a variety of symptoms, including changes in behavior, movement,
sensation, and consciousness. It often disturbs muscle control. Seizures can affect anyone at any
age. It is not necessary to have an underlying medical condition. It can also be caused by an injury
or illness. Furthermore, extreme stress can also lead to severe seizures. There are treatments
available that can help control their frequency, but you can never know if one is on its way.

Epilepsy is often characterized as a cause of seizures. Its frequency ranges from having two or more
seizures at least 24 hours apart. To add on, a single seizure can last 30 seconds. In addition,
other factors for seizures occur due to head injury or infections like meningitis.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

How much do in-home medical alert systems cost?

The cost of an in-home medical alert system generally ranges from $20 to $60 per month. The price
typically involves two components: an initial setup fee (sometimes waived) and a recurring monthly
monitoring fee.

What is the difference between a landline and a cellular medical alert system?

A landline medical alert system connects to your home’s traditional phone line. It’s a reliable
option if you have consistent landline service. A cellular medical alert system uses a cellular
network to connect to the monitoring center. This is ideal for individuals who don’t have a landline
or experience frequent phone line outages.

Can I wear the pendant in the shower or bath?

Medical alert pendants and wristbands are designed to be water-resistant or even waterproof. This is
important because falls are more likely to occur in the bathroom. Check the specifications of the
system you are considering to ensure it is water-resistant or waterproof and suitable for use in the
shower or bath.

charging, a call is being placed or a call has ended, or that the unit needs to be charged.

The MedEquip Alert is very simple to use, I just pressed the SOS button and a monitoring service

needed. I will never go anywhere without my MedEquip Alert.

monitoring company answered within seconds and the help I needed arrived as promised.

door, all in all it was a good choice and a restful feeling knowing I can get the help when I need
it.

to use, just press the MedEquip Alert SOS button for help and the operator answers. I can now enjoy
the freedom of living independently without fear of being alone and not getting help during an
emergency. I still miss my husband dearly but I’m able to go on without fear of being isolated -
thank you to the MedEquip Alert company!
Evelyn from Far Rockaway, NY

I feel safe knowing when I push the button they respond within seconds. I don’t go anywhere without it. - Sharon ## Frequently Asked Questions ### How much do Medical Alert systems cost? Medical Alert systems start at $29.95/mo. Prices vary depending on the system, rate plan and add-ons selected. To find the right Medical Alert system for your lifestyle, please complete our [free medical monitoring assessment][29]. ### Who should wear a Medical Alert system? A Medical Alert system is ideal for anyone who would like peace of mind by getting a 24-hour response in case of a medical emergency, fire or break-in by simply having a help button. It is especially helpful for older adults or seniors who live alone and as shown by studies are more likely to suffer a fall at home. A Medical Alert system can also be used as a panic button. Our systems are available with fall detection, which alerts a response specialist in the event of a fall even if you are unable to press your help button. ### What types of Medical Alert systems are available? We have options for different lifestyles. Our Home System works with a cellular connection and provides coverage in and around the house up to 800 ft. Our Mobile Systems and Smartwatch include GPS location services so that you can get help wherever you are—at home or on the go. All our Medical Alert systems are available with fall detection technology that adds a layer of protection in the event of a fall where you cannot call out for help. ### How do Medical Alert systems work? It’s simple: You wear a Medical Alert help button, mobile communicator or Smartwatch and press your button if you need help. The help button then sends a signal to the two-way speaker, which connects you with one of our trained response specialists. The response specialist assesses the situation and sends appropriate emergency help—family, friends or first responders. ### What kind of emergency help do I get? That depends on what kind of emergency you’re having. If it’s a minor situation, Medical Alert can contact somebody (such as a neighbor or loved one) on your contact list and have them go to you. For serious emergencies, our response coordinators will immediately dispatch an ambulance, or contact the police or fire station, depending on what you need. ### Can I use a Medical Alert system if I don’t speak English? Yes, our response center staff includes employees who are native speakers of languages other than English; in addition, our operators are trained to use the International Language Line for real-time translation services in 140 languages. Contact us at 800-800-2537 for more details about the specific language you would need. That depends on what kind of emergency you’re having. If it’s a minor situation, Medical Alert can contact somebody (such as a neighbor or loved one) on your contact list and have them go to you. For serious emergencies, our response coordinators will immediately dispatch an ambulance, or contact the police or fire station, depending on what you need. ### Can I use a Medical Alert system if I don’t speak English? Yes, our response center staff includes employees who are native speakers of languages other than English; in addition, our operators are trained to use the International Language Line for real-time translation services in 140 languages. Giving people, their families, and caregivers a feeling of confidence and safety is what Numera® personal emergency response system (PERS) products are all about. Whether you are an active senior, a lone worker, or someone concerned about personal security, you can go about your daily life with the assurance that help is always within reach.

Hundreds of thousands of people trust Numera’s advanced medical alert devices across the U.S. and Canada. With 4G, GPS, and industry-leading fall detection technology, the Libris Aura™ mPERS and Home Safety Hub give customers the freedom to live independently and age in place safely. The EverThere® portal keeps caregivers connected and reassured, while lone workers and employers benefit from enhanced safety and reduced liability. Each device links directly to a monitoring center, ensuring emergency services are alerted the moment they’re needed.

Numera® solutions deliver more than protection – they empower independence, peace of mind, and support virtually everywhere, all from a single medical alert device.

Aging in Place

Libris Aura™ with EverThere® gives seniors the confidence to live independently, at home or on the go. Caregivers stay connected and reassured, knowing help is always within reach.

FALL DETECTION

With advanced multi-sensor technology and a new barometric sensor, Libris Aura™ delivers the industry’s most accurate fall detection. 4G LTE connectivity ensures users have instant access to trained operators, 24/7.

PROACTIVE WELLNESS

With one touch, emergency help is on the way. Libris Aura™ combines alert services, GPS location tracking, and real-time event notifications to keep family members and healthcare providers informed and connected.

Lone Workers

For retail, delivery, and warehouse employees, Libris Aura™ offers immediate protection and peace of mind. With two-way voice, discreet alert options, and companion wearables, workers can request help openly or in silent mode, ensuring safety in any situation.

COVERT HELP

In sensitive situations, Aura’s silent mode allows users to request help discreetly. Audio and visual cues are suppressed, ensuring an emergency call can be placed without drawing attention.

DISCREET WEARABLE OPTIONS

Aura also pairs with a discreet companion pendant, giving workers flexible, low-profile options for requesting assistance. Monitoring centers can dispatch help immediately and provide critical insight for security and law enforcement.

Personal Security

In today’s world, staying safe matters more than ever. Libris Aura™ offers reliable protection at home, on the road, or while traveling, ensuring you and your loved ones are never alone in an emergency.

AT HOME AND ON THE MOVE

With 4G LTE connectivity and GPS-enabled location services, Libris Aura™ delivers fast, accurate response wherever you are. Coverage across leading carrier networks ensures help can always find you.

PEACE OF MIND

At the touch of a button, Libris Aura™ connects you with trained operators who can dispatch emergency personnel to your exact location. Whether you’re fall-prone, traveling, or simply seeking added security, Aura provides confidence and peace of mind for you and those who care about you.

## Who We Are

### Eighteen years ago…

We started Proficient with one goal in mind, to provide audio-video system integrators with
everything they need to do home theater, whole home and outdoor sound systems: great sounding
products with rock solid reliability. This objective guides everythiing we do, from the
top-of-the-line Signature Series architectural speakers to the new Protege Cabinet Loudspeakers and
more.

Proficient is part of the Nice North America (NSC) family. Nice North America LLC (NSC) is a global
leader in smart connected devices and systems for residential, security, access control, and digital
health markets.

NSC and its partners have deployed more than 5 million connected systems and over 25 million
security and home control sensors and peripherals. Through its family of brands including 2GIG®,
ELAN®, Linear®, GoControl®, Mighty Mule® and Numera®, NSC designs solutions for national telecoms,
big box retailers, OEM partners, service providers, security dealers, technology integrators and
consumers.

Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, NSC has over 50 years of innovation and is dedicated to
addressing the lifestyle and business needs of millions of customers every day. For further
information, visit[ nortekcontrol.com][22].
