# Dual 6″ Floor Standing Speaker

We designed Proficient Protege Cabinet Loudspeakers for today’s listening environments. Before we
put pen to paper, we researched emerging audio technologies like Dolby Atmos® and DTS:X® and took a
hard look at the way homeowners want loudspeakers to look and play in their homes. The result is a
complete line of speakers built to sound great in any system in any home—and to look really good in
any room.

Our Proficient Protege Cabinet Loudspeakers have a smooth, stealthy matte black look that blends
with any decor. Every model features the best combination of drivers we’ve ever assembled: precise,
powerful graphite woofers paired with exceptionally accurate silk dome tweeters.

Our top-of-the-line Floor Standing speakers sound amazing with or without a subwoofer. Dual 6″
graphite woofers in a carefully tuned floor standing enclosure deliver pounding bass powerful enough
for rock, R&B and the most intense action movies. The smooth midrange of the ultra-light,
ultra-rigid graphite cones combines with the sweet sound of a 1″ silk dome tweeter to keep
everything from female vocals to flutes sounding airy and natural, like they’re right there in the
room with you. The LFS6 has a matte black finish and removable black grille with neo-magnets. Add
the LDA5 speaker to turn the LFS6 into an immersive sound system compatible with Dolby Atmos and
DTS:X.

# 8″ Dual-Drive Powered Sub w/ 200W Amp – Black

No music or movie experience is complete without bass, but in many cases there’s just no room for a
subwoofer. Well, not for an average subwoofer—but the FS8 is no average subwoofer. With an 8-inch
driver, an 8-inch passive radiator and a 200-watt amp, this tiny sub puts out serious couch-shaking
power.

## Description

Big boom for small rooms.
The FS8 is the perfect subwoofer for places where you never thought you could use a subwoofer. Like
bedrooms, designer living rooms and home offices. At less than 14 inches on its longest side, the
FS8 can easily hide behind couches, sit under end tables or nestle in a corner.

Yet there’s nothing tiny about the FS8’s performance. We gave it an 8-inch composite driver with an
extra-wide surround to increase the cone excursion, which dramatically increases deep bass power. We
powered the driver with a 200-watt Class D amp, and added an 8-inch passive radiator to reinforce
the deepest bass notes. The result is a minisub with serious slam—and a fast, musical sound that’ll
thrill both audiophiles and action-movie fans.

# 10″ Dual-Drive Powered Sub w/ 250W Amp – Black

Use the FS10 where you want serious bass but can’t take up a lot of space. With a longest dimension
just over 15 inches, the FS10 can tuck under most end tables. But with its 10-inch driver, 10-inch
passive radiator and 250-watt Class D amp, it’s powerful enough to anchor a large home theater.

## Description

Mid-sized, maximum muscle.
We know a lot of people want great bass but don’t want to spoil the look of their living room with a
big subwoofer. That’s why we built the FS10. It’s got enough muscle to shake the floor, and enough
finesse to please demanding audiophiles, yet it’s so small it can go unnoticed even in most
bedrooms.

We started with a 10-inch driver that has an extra-wide surround that increases the cone
excursion—which means it moves a lot more air and makes a lot more deep bass. A 250-watt RMS Class D
amp powers the driver, and a 10-inch passive radiator reinforces the lowest notes. The result is a
10-inch sub with more than +10 dB extra deep bass output than our previous model.

Protege FS12

# 12″ Dual-Drive Powered Sub w/ 300W Amp – Black

The FS12 is built to blow you away. It’s the best, most powerful free-standing subwoofer we’ve ever
made, with a 300-watt RMS Class D digital amplifier, a seriously beefed-up 12-inch composite cone
woofer and a 12-inch passive radiator to beef up the low bass notes. It’s the perfect sub for
state-of-the-art home theaters.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Features ][25]
* [ Specifications ][26]
* [ Other Specifications ][27]

## Description

Pure muscle in a compact design.
When we designed the FS12, we wanted it to beat every sub we’ve ever made—and not just by a few dB.
We’re confident that when you hear how the FS12 can shake the couch with deep bottom end, while also
pulling out every little bass detail in even the most delicate music recordings, you’ll be totally
blown away.

How’d we do it? Sheer muscle. The FS12 has a 12-inch composite driver with an extra-wide surround
that lets the cone move further and produce more output. It’s driven by a 300-watt Class D amp—and
that’s RMS, not the “peak power” rating many subs use. A passive radiator reinforces the deep bass
and keeps the size down to less than 17 inches on the sub’s longest side.

Phase Switch: 0 – 180 °

Crossover: 50Hz – 150Hz; Bypass
Protection: Anti-Clipping Circuitry
Power On/Off: Auto Sensing

Black Wood Grain with Dampened Rubber Feet

The Protege C635 elevates in-ceiling sound to a higher level! It’s our first speaker to combine
aluminum and titanium. An 6½-inch aluminum cone woofer provides powerful, punchy deep bass, while a
1-inch titanium dome tweeter delivers some of the clearest, crispest highs you’ve ever heard. All
covered with a stealthy low-profile grille.

## Description

Aluminum + titanium = awesome sound. For the first time, Proficient combines aluminum and titanium
in the same speaker—and the result is musical magic! The Protege C635 mates the powerhouse deep bass
of a 6-1/2 inch aluminum cone with the crystalline highs of a 1-inch titanium dome tweeter.
Together, they deliver dynamic, detailed sound you never expected from a ceiling speaker. The C635
packs all the installation-friendly features you expect from Proficient. With 92 dB sensitivity and
100-watt power handling, it plays loud and clean from practically any amp. With bass to 40 Hz and

# 5″ Bookshelf Speakers – Dolby Atmos Ready

With the increasing adoption of object-based audio systems – including Dolby Atmos®,DTS:X® and Auro
3D® – the new Proficient line includes a speaker specifically designed to deliver the realistic,
immersive and “overhead” or “height” effects associated with these systems. Our solution sits right
on top of the LFS6 floor standing speaker or LB62 bookshelf speaker, and for added installation
flexibility, can even be mounted on the wall next to the ceiling to deliver the “height” effects.

Our Dolby Atmos enabled loudspeakers reflect sound off the ceiling for immersive Dolby Atmos and
DTS:X surround sound. Features a slanted speaker baffle, 5″ graphite woofers, 1″ silk dome tweeters
and 60 watt power handling. The LDA5 features a matte black finish, removable black grilles with
neo-magnets and integrated flush mounted single-slot wall mounts. Designed to sit on top of the LFS6
or LB62, or mount on the wall below the ceiling.

# In-Wall LCR Speaker with Dual 6-1/2″ Graphite Woofers and Pivoting 1″ Soft-Dome Tweeter

Graphite woofers make the IW630 a truly great-sounding speaker. We designed it to deliver excellent
sound quality whether mounted horizontally or vertically. It even fits horizontally between
16-inch-on-center studs, so it doesn’t require complicated installation. Serious home theater fans
looking for maximum bang for the buck will love the IW630.

## Description

There’s something special about graphite woofers. They’re ultra-stiff for low distortion and maximum
power handling, and they sound great. Dual 6½-inch graphite woofers give the IW630 incredible
dynamics, while the soft-dome tweeter sings out with sweet, smooth treble. Placing the tweeter at an
angle to the woofers gives the IW630 great sound whether oriented horizontally or vertically.

You can flip the IW630 any which way you want and it’ll still fit between standard 16-inch-on-center
studs. The pivoting tweeter lets you aim the sound where you need it, and ±3 dB bass and treble
switches fine-tune the sound. High 90 dB sensitivity assures the IW630 will get great sound even
from an inexpensive receiver. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# 6½” Dual Voice Coil Polypropylene Woofer & Two 1/2″ Hard Dome Tweeters

C625TT Ceiling Speaker
The C625TT is the most affordable way to get Proficient-quality stereo sound. With a dual-voice-coil
woofer and dual tweeters, the C625TT reproduces both left and right stereo channels in a single,
easy-to-install in-ceiling speaker. Super-high sensitivity makes the C625TT compatible even with
inexpensive, low-powered amplifiers.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

Stereo doesn’t get any simpler.
The C625TT gives you stereo sound where mounting two speakers is impractical, such as in a hallway
or bathroom. Its 6½-inch polypropylene woofer has dual voice coils so it can reproduce left and
right stereo channels. Dual 1/2″ hard dome tweeters handle the high frequencies. Careful tuning from
our team of devoted audio enthusiast/engineers makes the C625TT a sweet-sounding little speaker.

You can use the C625TT with any amplifier, thanks to its high 92 dB sensitivity. A typical speaker
requires three times as much power! It’s easy to install, too, thanks to a sturdy dogleg mounting
system. All of our 6½-inch ceiling speakers use the same mounting template so you never have to
worry about cutting the wrong size hole. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# 8″ Dual Voice Coil Graphite Woofer & Two Pivoting 1″ Aluminum Dome Tweeter

C825TT Ceiling Speaker
A stiff graphite-cone woofer makes the C825TT one of the world’s best-sounding single-point stereo
speakers. Because it reproduces both left and right channels of stereo sound, one C825TT can replace
two conventional stereo speakers. It’s an ideal choice for places where you don’t have the space or
need for two speakers.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

Superb stereo sound made simple.
With the C825TT in-ceiling speakers, you get truly great stereo sound even in tight spaces. It uses
a dual-voice-coil 8-inch woofer with the same graphite cone material found in many of our better
in-wall and in-ceiling speakers. The stiffness of the graphite gives you much less distortion,
extremely clear sound and a deep bass response down to 28 Hz.

The C825TT’s low-distortion 1-inch aluminum tweeters pivot so you can adjust the stereo effect.
Power handling of 150 watts means the C825TT can really crank out the sound for parties, while its
high sensitivity of 92 dB means it needs just one-third the power of a typical speaker. Tone
switches let you boost bass and/or treble by 3 dB. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

The W672 offers an affordable way to get good sound in a budget installation. With satisfying deep
bass down to 36 Hz, high sensitivity for strong output from low-powered amplifiers, and a pivoting

Building a cost-effective speaker like the W672 demands that we make all the right choices. Starting
with our sweet-sounding silk-dome tweeter, which pivots so you can get a little extra kick of treble
wherever you need it. To provide the lows, we chose a 6-1/2-inch polypropylene-cone woofer to
deliver deep, low-distortion bass down to 36Hz.

We know you might want to use the W672 with an inexpensive amplifier, so we make the most of every
watt. With 91 dB sensitivity, the W672 delivers 100 dB with only 8 watts of power! Its 8-ohm
impedance makes it easy to drive. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# In-Wall Speaker with 8″ Graphite Woofer, 1″ Pivoting Aluminum Tweeter and Tone Switches

The W802 sounds so great you won’t believe it’s an in-wall speaker. It combines a stiff, light
graphite-cone woofer with an outstanding aluminum-dome tweeter. The result is incredible bass
response—and a speaker you can drive to loud levels with any amplifier. The W802 makes an ideal
choice for demanding music listeners.

The W802’s super-stiff 8-inch graphite woofer gives you incredible deep bass response down to 28 Hz,
half an octave below the lowest note on an upright bass. Our 1-inch, low-distortion aluminum-dome
tweeter makes for a perfect match with the big woofer. Switches behind the grille boost the bass
and/or treble by +3 dB for fine-tuning.

With 150-watt power handling, the W802 is capable of volumes over 110 dB. Give it all the power
you’ve got and it won’t even flinch. And 92 dB sensitivity means the W802 gives you more than 100 dB
from just a 10-watt amplifier! A sturdy dogleg mechanism clamps the W802 into a wall with a turn of
a few screws. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# Ceiling Speaker with 5-1/4″ Woofer and -1/2″ Pivoting Hard-Dome Polyamide Tweeter

Here’s the ideal ceiling speaker for places where space is tight. The C501’s compact size lets it
fit almost anywhere—even in hallways and walk-in closets—yet its pivoting tweeter and high-quality
5¼-inch woofer assure excellent sound quality. High sensitivity gives you satisfying sound even from
small amplifiers.

* [ Specifications ][25]

## Description

Compact, affordable and powerful.
The C501 squeezes into tight spaces where other ceiling speakers can’t fit. Its small size gives it
a discreet look ideal for elegant interiors and narrow hallways —and you can also use more C501s to
spread the sound out better. The 5 ¼-inch woofer delivers surprisingly deep 40 Hz bass, while a
pivoting ½-inch polyamide hard dome tweeter produces clear highs.

Any amp or receiver can easily drive the C501. Its 8-ohm nominal impedance and unusually high 90 dB
sensitivity give you plenty of volume even with a low-powered multiroom amplifier. For small rooms,
hallways, kitchens, and even the surround channels of a compact media room home theater system, the
C501 is tough to beat. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# In-Wall Subwoofer with 10-inch Neodymium-Magnet Driver and 250 Watts Power Handling

The IWS105 adds powerful bass to in-wall systems without taking up a single square inch of floor
space. By putting the neodymium magnet inside the speaker cone, we slimmed the woofer so the IWS105
fits flush in a wall. It sounds like a conventional sub, but it’s practically invisible. Add the M3
amplifier to complete your in-wall subwoofer system.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

Subwoofers. We love what they do for movies and music but hate the way they look. Proficient has the
answer: the IWS105 in-wall subwoofer. The IWS105 mounts flush like an in-wall speaker. How can we
get its big 10-inch pulp-fiber woofer to fit in a 3½-inch-deep wall cavity? By moving the powerful
neodymium magnet to the front.

To power the IWS105, use our M3 subwoofer amp. The M3 goes in your equipment rack and connects with
in-wall speaker cable. To get tighter bass and minimize transmission of sound into other rooms, add
the BB-IWS10 back box. No matter how you set it up, the IWS-10’s 36 Hz response and 250-watt power
handling ensure you’ll get great bass. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

that’s stiffer than paper or polypropylene. You get clearer sound with lower distortion, all the way
down to 45 Hz! A sweet-sounding, pivoting 1-inch silk-dome tweeter perfectly complements the

# Ceiling speaker with 6-1/2″ Graphite woofer, 1″ Pivoting Aluminum Tweeter and Tone Switches

Bass and treble boost switches give the C641 an extra kick in the lows or highs—or both! A stiff
graphite-cone woofer plays deep bass notes with very low distortion, and it delivers a super-smooth
midrange, too. A top-quality aluminum-dome tweeter produces clear, extended treble response.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

The ceiling speaker with extra kick.
The C641’s grille conceals tone switches that let you boost the bass and/or treble by 3 decibels.
With the flick of a switch, you can kick up the lows or highs to suit your taste. No matter how you
set the switches, you’ll love the C641’s sound, thanks to its low-distortion graphite woofer and

The C791 is our most affordable way to build an in-ceiling sound system with big bass. Its 8-inch
polypropylene-cone woofer belts out the deep notes, and a soft-dome tweeter delivers

An 8-inch polypropylene woofer gives the C791 shockingly powerful bass for the price—all the way
down to 36 Hz, which is even deeper than the lowest note on an upright bass! The C791’s soft-dome
tweeter pivots so you can direct the treble anywhere you want. Thanks to careful tweaking from our

Hook up a pair of C791s to even a little 10-watt amp and you will be totally blown away. Thanks to
its high 92 dB sensitivity, the C791 needs only about one-third as much power as a typical speaker.
And the impedance is 8 ohms, which means any amp will have enough juice to drive it. Includes
Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# Ceiling speaker with 8″ graphite woofer, 1″ pivoting aluminum tweeter and tone switches

With its ultra-stiff graphite-cone woofer, the C801 is one fantastic-sounding ceiling speaker. The
big 8-inch woofer pumps out awesome bass, and the pivoting tweeter delivers clear highs wherever you
want them. Bass and treble boost switches hidden behind the grille let you fine-tune the sound in
seconds.

## Description

Refined sound with raw power.
The graphite material used in the C801’s woofer cone is far stiffer than almost any other cone
material you can find. That means it produces low distortion and very clear sound. To keep up with
the high-powered woofer, we gave the C801 a low-distortion aluminum tweeter. The tweeter pivots so
you can direct the sound wherever you want.

You can boost bass and/or treble by 3 dB using the tone switches behind the grille. A high
sensitivity of 92 dB lets the C801 hit 100 dB with just 8 watts of power. With 28 Hz bass extension
and 150-watt power handling, this speaker cranks out more than enough oomph for any party anywhere!
Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

Protege C661

# Ceiling LCR Speaker with 6-1/2″ Graphite Woofer and 1″ Pivoting Aluminum Tweeter

Graphite is one of our favorite woofer materials, and it’s part of what makes the C661 so good. The
C661’s graphite woofer and aluminum dome tweeter are mounted at a 15-degree angle, making this
speaker ideal for the front left, center and right channels in a home theater systems—and even for
the surround channels, too!
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

Small never sounded so sweet.
The great sound of a 6½-inch graphite woofer makes the C661 our best-sounding compact ceiling LCR
speaker. The ultra-stiff woofer cone contributes to the immense power handling, the deep bass and
the natural-sounding midrange. A 1-inch silk dome tweeter blends perfectly with the woofer, thanks
to careful tweaking from our team of dedicated audiophiles.

We set the C661’s woofer and tweeter at a 15-degree angle, so you can mount the speaker above a TV
and point it at the listeners. You get sound imaging very similar to what you’d get with a
conventional home theater system. The 92 dB sensitivity and 125-watt power handling assure that the
C661 will work great in any system. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# In-wall LCR speaker with dual 5¼” graphite woofers and pivoting 1″ aluminum tweeter

You’ll be blown away when you hear how good this compact in-wall LCR sounds—and even more blown away
when you see how little it costs. Dual 5¼-inch graphite woofers give the IW530 a natural and
powerful sound, and our thoughtful design lets you mount the speaker either vertically or
horizontally in the wall.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

Home theater enthusiasts want the dynamics of a big speaker system, but don’t always have the space
for one. The IW530 is perfect for them. Its stiff 5¼-inch graphite woofers have a punchy, dynamic
yet amazingly natural sound. The low-distortion aluminum tweeter pivots so you can direct the sound
where you need it.

Whether you mount it vertically or horizontally, the IW530 fits easily into a standard stud bay.
Tone switches give you ±3 dB adjustment of bass and treble—an extremely useful feature you don’t
usually see at this price point. There’s no easier or more affordable way to build a world-class yet
visually inconspicuous home theater sound system. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

Protege C606

# Ceiling Speaker with 6-1/2″ Polypropylene Woofer and -3/4″ Fixed Soft-Dome Tweeter

The C606 is our most affordable 6½-inch ceiling speaker. It’s a perfect choice for applications
where good sound is desired but cost is a major factor. The C606 offers a great combination of sound
quality and ease of installation. High sensitivity makes the C606 easy for any amplifier to drive.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

Bigger bass, smaller price.
You’ll be amazed when you hear how much sound our most affordable 6½-inch ceiling speaker puts out.
Its sturdy polypropylene woofer is the same type found in many high-quality bookshelf speakers. And
its ¾-inch soft-dome tweeter sounds surprisingly sweet—no surprise when you learn it was engineered
by the same team that designed our top in-wall, on-wall and bookshelf speakers.

The C606’s 90 dB sensitivity delivers high output even with low-powered multiroom audio amplifiers,
so you can get the same volume with about half the power. The C606’s forgiving 8-ohm impedance makes
it easy to drive with any amplifier. It also fits into the same cutout as all of our other 6½-inch
ceiling speakers do, so it’s easy to install. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# Ceiling Speaker with 6-1/2″ Polypropylene Woofer and 1″ Pivoting Soft-Dome Tweeter

The C612 delivers surprisingly good sound quality for its modest price. A pivoting soft-dome tweeter
handles the highs, and a 6½-inch polypropylene-cone woofer dishes out plenty of powerful bottom-end
bass. High sensitivity makes this speaker easy to drive even with low-powered amps.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]

## Description

The sweet spot for affordable sound.
The C612 delivers way beyond what you’d expect from such an affordable speaker. Its 6-1/2-inch
polypropylene woofer puts out deep bass down to 45Hz, while its 1-inch pivoting soft-dome tweeter
sings out with smoother treble than you’d expect from such an affordable speaker. You get true
party-level sound without a subwoofer!

With super-high 91 dB sensitivity, the C612 works great with any amplifier. Just 8 watts will get
this speaker up to 100 dB! The C612 also has an 8-ohm nominal impedance, so it’s an easy load for
any amplifier to drive. And for simpler installation, it uses the same mounting template as all of
Proficient Audio’s 6-1/2-inch ceiling speakers. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

want to use. For your convenience, it uses the same cutout template and sturdy dogleg mounting

# Outdoor Speakers with 6½” Polypropylene Woofers and 1″ Pivoting Supernil Tweeters – Black

For those who like to rock out but don’t like big speakers, the 11-inch-high AW650 is practically
built to order. The AW650’s 6½-inch woofer plays down to 37 Hz, which is even lower than the deepest
note on a double bass. Its tough, weatherproof ABS cabinet and high power handling assure years of
reliable service.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

This compact outdoor speaker delivers party-level sound even in large backyards. A tough, waterproof
6½-inch polypropylene woofer and ported cabinet give the AW650 much more powerful bass than most
small speakers can muster. The pivoting 1-inch tweeter is made from Supernil synthetic fabric, which
resists moisture and mold and also produces clear, detailed treble.

A rugged ABS cabinet protects the AW650 against years of rain, snow and sun. The rustproof
powder-coated aluminum grille protects the drivers from damage even if a stray football happens to
hit the speaker. Each speaker comes with a swiveling mount, so you can mount it horizontally or
vertically, then twist it in any direction.

# Indoor/outdoor single-point stereo speaker with 6½” woofer and two 1″ tweeters – White

The AW600TT is one of our most versatile speakers. Just one AW600TT delivers full stereo sound. The
speaker’s high efficiency and the impressive bass response of its 6½-inch polypropylene woofer give
satisfying performance from practically any amplifier. And because it’s weatherproof, you can use it
in the garage or even in the backyard!
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

All you need is one AW600TT to reproduce both the left and right channels from a stereo system. The
dual Supernil synthetic tweeters give you a spacious sound, and you can pivot them to make the sound
more focused or more diffused. The 6½-inch polypropylene woofer uses dual voice coils to reproduce
both stereo channels into a single driver, and deliver powerful bass down to 50 Hz.

Thanks to its rugged ABS molded enclosure and rustproof, powder-coated aluminum grille, the AW600TT
survives practically any hazards of the backyard: rain, snow, dust, heat, cold and even an
off-target football. Each speaker includes a swivel-mount bracket that can be attached to a wall,
under an eave or on a fence post.

# About Us

Falls are the leading cause of injuries and hospital admittances. Expensive hospital stays and
rehabilitation can keep you out of your home for months. To help protect and keep you independent,
Prime Medical Alert is pleased to provide you with 24/7 medical alert monitoring for that “just in
case” situation. With the push of a button, live help is immediately available.

## Prime Medical Alert always offers:
* Free Shipping
* No Contracts
* Lifetime Warranty
* No Hidden Fees
* Easy Setup
* Unlimited Usage

## How the Prime Medical Alert service works

**1. Summon Help**
Press your emergency help button any time to connect to our triple redundant, UL certified
monitoring facility. You can have unlimited emergency contacts, health information, and any other
additional information on file.

**2. Speak to an EMT Certified Emergency Operator**
Once you are connected with our monitoring center, a live EMT (emergency medical technician) will
assist you by either contacting your emergency contacts or directly dispatching a first responder.
Emergency contacts are always notified in the event of a dispatch.

**3. Press the Button and Help is on the Way**
Depending on your instructions, we will notify emergency services, family, friends, neighbors, or
anyone else on your list of emergency contacts. The operator stays on the line until help arrives.

Whether it’s our [high quality equipment][15], multiple options, or [low prices][16], we look
forward to providing you with the same peace-of-mind thousands already enjoy. Call now at
(800)-723-6442.

## About the Prime Medical Alert Product Line

[Medical-Alert-Product-Picture][Medical-Alert-Product-Picture]

Prime Medical Alert offers many different medical alert product solutions to meet your needs.
Whether you are looking for a simple product that comes in the form of a necklace or bracelet and
automatically tests daily, or a cellular medical alert product where you can get help wherever you
happen to be, Prime Medical Alert offers tailored solutions. All of our personal medical alert
products are backed by 24/7 certified EMT monitoring.

The individuals answering the calls are based in the United States and are accent neutral which is
extremely important during emergency situations. They are trained specifically to answer medical
alert product distress calls and can follow a customized protocol.

Some people prefer their contacts notified first before the emergency responders in the event they
can’t respond while others prefer an immediate dispatch with their contacts notified after. For all
of Prime Medical Alert’s products we keep relevant medical information on file to assist the first
responders during an emergency.

All of the products we offer are water resistant. This means they can be used in the shower, while
bathing, while doing the dishes, or doing any other activities that involve water. Even though the
eResponder is a truly cellular product, our other products can be retrofitted to work without a
phone line.

If you don’t have a phone line or are thinking of getting rid of your phone line, mention this to a
Prime Medical Alert product representative and they can ensure delivery of the appropriate medical
alert product.

# About Us

Falls are the leading cause of injuries and hospital admittances. Expensive hospital stays and
rehabilitation can keep you out of your home for months. To help protect and keep you independent,
Prime Medical Alert is pleased to provide you with 24/7 medical alert monitoring for that “just in
case” situation. With the push of a button, live help is immediately available.

## Prime Medical Alert always offers:
* Free Shipping
* No Contracts
* Lifetime Warranty
* No Hidden Fees
* Easy Setup
* Unlimited Usage

## How the Prime Medical Alert service works

**1. Summon Help**
Press your emergency help button any time to connect to our triple redundant, UL certified
monitoring facility. You can have unlimited emergency contacts, health information, and any other
additional information on file.

**2. Speak to an EMT Certified Emergency Operator**
Once you are connected with our monitoring center, a live EMT (emergency medical technician) will
assist you by either contacting your emergency contacts or directly dispatching a first responder.
Emergency contacts are always notified in the event of a dispatch.

**3. Press the Button and Help is on the Way**
Depending on your instructions, we will notify emergency services, family, friends, neighbors, or
anyone else on your list of emergency contacts. The operator stays on the line until help arrives.

Whether it’s our [high quality equipment][15], multiple options, or [low prices][16], we look
forward to providing you with the same peace-of-mind thousands already enjoy. Call now at
(800)-723-6442.

# Emergency Medical Alert Company Servicing North America

Since 1985, SafeGuard has been providing cutting edge personal emergency response systems, medical
alert products, and medical monitoring services designed for seniors and individuals with medical
conditions in an effort to promote health, wellness, and personal security.

We are a customer focused medical alert company with employees that are dedicated to providing
personalized and responsive customer service, 24 hours a day/7 days a week. Our knowledgeable
SafeGuard team members provide an uncompromising commitment to customer satisfaction and service.

For over 30 years, SafeGuard has upheld a positive reputation in the medical industry. We are known
for providing prompt, responsive, and superior quality products and services. We provide the latest
personal emergency response systems and medical monitoring and security services available in the
medical industry today. Our company trained installation experts are available to assist with the
installation of our medical alert products for our customers.

By owning and operating our own medical monitoring center, our team can provide unsurpassed around
the clock medical monitoring services. Our medical monitoring center uses state of the art
technology to ensure our qualified and experienced care center specialists are available at all
times of the day to aid and send the proper help when it is needed most. Our Emergency Medical
Monitoring Center is fully equipped with anti-failure protection features including an automatic
emergency generator that indefinitely supplies a continuous source of electricity and a fully
redundant database center that provides complete backup for disaster recovery.

Through the use of our emergency medical alert systems, our highly trained and certified response
specialists will be available to monitor your loved ones’ urgent and non-urgent needs every second
of the day. When emergency medical assistance is required, our team follows personal emergency
response protocols to take action immediately and to deliver care accordingly with the needs of our
customers.

#### Our medical alert systems, monitoring services, and proactive health management solutions
#### continue to provide the opportunity for seniors and vulnerable individuals to enjoy the
#### activities of daily living and to maintain an independent lifestyle while staying safe at home
#### and beyond the home.

# Emergency Medical Alert Company Servicing North America

Since 1985, SafeGuard has been providing cutting edge personal emergency response systems, medical
alert products, and medical monitoring services designed for seniors and individuals with medical
conditions in an effort to promote health, wellness, and personal security.

We are a customer focused medical alert company with employees that are dedicated to providing
personalized and responsive customer service, 24 hours a day/7 days a week. Our knowledgeable
SafeGuard team members provide an uncompromising commitment to customer satisfaction and service.

For over 30 years, SafeGuard has upheld a positive reputation in the medical industry. We are known
for providing prompt, responsive, and superior quality products and services. We provide the latest
personal emergency response systems and medical monitoring and security services available in the
medical industry today. Our company trained installation experts are available to assist with the
installation of our medical alert products for our customers.

By owning and operating our own medical monitoring center, our team can provide unsurpassed around
the clock medical monitoring services. Our medical monitoring center uses state of the art
technology to ensure our qualified and experienced care center specialists are available at all
times of the day to aid and send the proper help when it is needed most. Our Emergency Medical
Monitoring Center is fully equipped with anti-failure protection features including an automatic
emergency generator that indefinitely supplies a continuous source of electricity and a fully
redundant database center that provides complete backup for disaster recovery.

Through the use of our emergency medical alert systems, our highly trained and certified response
specialists will be available to monitor your loved ones’ urgent and non-urgent needs every second
of the day. When emergency medical assistance is required, our team follows personal emergency
response protocols to take action immediately and to deliver care accordingly with the needs of our
customers.

#### Our medical alert systems, monitoring services, and proactive health management solutions
#### continue to provide the opportunity for seniors and vulnerable individuals to enjoy the
#### activities of daily living and to maintain an independent lifestyle while staying safe at home

# Home Link: Affordable Landline Medical Alert System for the Bay Area

The most affordable medical alert system in our lineup. Less than $1 a day. Starting at $26.95/mo.

[Home Link affordable landline medical alert system base station and wearable help button for Bay
Area seniors]

## Affordable At-Home Protection Using Your Landline

The **Home Link** is Vital Link’s most affordable medical alert system, designed for Bay Area
seniors who still have an active landline telephone. This landline medical alert system connects
through your existing phone line with no special wiring, no internet, and no monthly equipment fees.
Press your wearable help button from anywhere in or around your home, and you are connected to our
24/7 monitoring center in seconds.

A local Vital Link technician will come to your home in Oakland, San Francisco, San Jose, or
anywhere across the Greater Bay Area to install the system, test every component, and make sure you
feel confident before leaving. Simple by design. No charging, no touchscreens, no apps.

## How the Home Link Works
1. **Press your help button** from anywhere in or around your home (up to 600 to 1,000 feet from the
base station).
2. **Speak directly** with a trained emergency operator through the base station’s two-way speaker.
3. **Help is dispatched** based on your personalized Emergency Care Plan, including calls to your
family, neighbors, or emergency services.

If you cannot respond after pressing the button, our operators follow your care plan automatically.
They will call your home, then dispatch help and begin contacting your emergency contacts.

* All necessary cords and connections

* **[Fall detection button][69]** (+$10/mo): Automatically alerts our center if it detects a heavy
fall, even if you cannot press the button yourself.
* **Wall-mounted button:** Place a stationary help button in high-risk areas like the bathroom or
hallway.
* **Additional wrist or neck buttons:** For a second person in the same household (one-time fee of
$40). No additional monthly monitoring charge.

never will.

### Still Have a Landline? It May Be Your Most Affordable Option

If you have a working landline in your home, the Home Link is the most affordable medical alert
system in our product lineup. It connects directly through your phone line, so there is no cellular
signal to worry about and no additional connectivity costs. The 80-hour backup battery is the
longest we offer, keeping you protected through extended power outages.

If you no longer have a landline or plan to cancel yours, our [Cellular Home Link][71] provides the
same at-home protection using a built-in cellular connection instead.

## Why Bay Area Families Choose Vital Link

Vital Link has served the Northern California community since 1981. We are a family-owned company
based in Oakland, not a national chain shipping boxes from a warehouse. Every installation is
handled by a local technician who stays in your home until you are comfortable and confident with
the system.

We work closely with [hospitals, discharge planners, and case managers][72] throughout Alameda,
Contra Costa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Marin, Napa, Solano, Sonoma, and Santa Cruz
counties. If your loved one is transitioning home after a hospital stay, we coordinate directly with
their care team to ensure protection is in place before they walk through the door.

All equipment is covered by a lifetime replacement warranty at no extra cost. We also ship
replacement batteries for free. If something breaks, we fix it.

## Is the Home Link Right for You?

This affordable landline medical alert system is the best fit if you:
* Have an active landline phone in your home
* Spend most of your time at home and want reliable around-the-clock protection
* Want the most affordable medical alert system available with professional installation
* Want a local technician to install and test the system in your home
* Prefer a wearable button you never have to charge (8 to 10 year battery life)

If you also need protection while away from home, consider pairing this system with our [Mobile
Link][73] GPS device. Or [compare all Vital Link products][74] to find the right combination.

### 1. Contact Us

Call us or contact us through our website or via a referral from your healthcare provider, social
worker, or discharge planner.

### 2. Local Installation

We schedule a convenient time for a Bay Area technician to set up and test the system in your home.

### 3. 24/7 Protection

Your Home Link is active, monitored, and backed by a local team that knows the Bay Area.

## Protect Your Independence

Ready to secure your home with an affordable landline medical alert system installed and supported
by a local Bay Area team? Call our Oakland office for a free consultation or to schedule an
installation.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What happens if I press the button but cannot speak?

Our operators will try to reach you by phone. If they cannot make contact, they immediately dispatch
emergency services and begin calling your emergency contacts based on your personalized care plan.

### Will the system work during a power outage?

Yes. The Home Link has an 80-hour backup battery. It also sends a low-battery signal to our
monitoring center so we can alert you proactively.

### Will this affect my phone service?

No. The Home Link has no effect on your regular phone service. It only uses the line briefly to dial
during emergencies and testing. These calls are toll-free, so you will not be charged.

### Can two people use the same system?

Yes. A second person in the same household can use the system with an additional wearable button
(one-time $40 fee). There is no extra monthly monitoring charge.

### Is the help button waterproof?

Yes. The wearable button is fully waterproof and should be worn in the bath or shower, where falls
are most common.

### What if my button breaks or the battery dies?

All equipment is covered by a lifetime replacement warranty. We replace buttons and ship batteries
at no cost to you. The button battery typically lasts 8 to 10 years.

### How large is the help button?

The pendant is a little bigger than a quarter and weighs about an ounce. It can be worn as a
necklace, on the wrist, or clipped to your clothing.

### What if I press the button by mistake?

Just tell the operator it was an accident and that you are fine. There is no penalty for accidental
presses.

### Can I take the system with me if I move?

Yes. The Home Link is portable. If you relocate within our Bay Area service area, we will reinstall
it at your new home, If you move out of the area your system will work but you will need to
reconnect it at the new location yourself.

Fall detection, GPS tracking, and two-way voice in a device you wear like a watch. Starting at

## Discreet Fall Detection You Wear on Your Wrist

The **Mobile W** is a medical alert watch with fall detection that looks and feels like a modern
wristwatch. If it senses a heavy fall, it automatically contacts our monitoring center, even if you
are unable to press the button yourself. It works at home in Oakland, on a walk through San
Francisco, or anywhere in the United States with cellular coverage.

Many seniors avoid traditional medical alert pendants because they feel bulky or clinical. This
medical alert watch with fall detection solves that problem. It sits comfortably on your wrist,
blends in with everyday clothing, and provides the same 24/7 protection as a pendant-style device. A
local Vital Link technician will deliver it to your home, fit the wristband, and walk you through

speaker.
3. **Help is dispatched** to your GPS location based on your personalized Emergency Care Plan,
including calls to family, neighbors, or emergency services.

If you cannot respond after a fall or button press, our operators use GPS to locate you and follow
your care plan automatically. They dispatch help and begin contacting your emergency contacts
immediately. If a false fall is detected, simply tell the operator you are fine or cancel the alert
on the device.

### Mission & Vision

[Bay Area Vital Link][68] is a trusted leader in the medical alert systems industry, serving seniors
and families across California with reliable, locally supported solutions. Our mission is to help
older adults and individuals with disabilities live safely, confidently, and independently in their
own homes.

We believe peace of mind comes from dependable technology paired with real human support. That is
why Bay Area Vital Link focuses on high-quality medical alert systems, responsive emergency
monitoring, and personalized service delivered by a dedicated local team.

Our vision is to set the standard for compassionate care in the medical alert industry by treating
every client, family member, and partner with honesty, dignity, and respect. We are committed to
long-term relationships built on trust, transparency, and service excellence.

#### Core Values

## What We Stand For

#### Commitment to You

As a Bay Area medical alert company, we are fair, honest, respectful, courteous, compassionate, and
professional in every interaction. Our commitment to seniors and families comes first in everything
we do.

#### Building Community

As a locally owned Bay Area medical alert provider, we do what we say we will do. We actively
support the communities we serve and build long term relationships with seniors, caregivers, and
local partners.

#### Integrity

Integrity guides every decision we make as a trusted Bay Area medical alert company. We hold
ourselves to the highest standards while contributing positively to the communities we serve.

#### Bay Area Vital Link Link proudly supports community based senior programs across the Bay Area,

### Letter from CEO

It wasn’t long after I started Vital Link Medical Alert Systems back in 1981 that I began to
understand how we made a difference in people’s lives and how working with our clients began to
affect mine.

Back then, I assembled the equipment, handled the sales, installations, administration and made sure
that all our clients were comfortable with using Vital Link.

In the early days I was notified by our monitoring center on every emergency. Many times I would
receive multiple calls throughout the night to make sure that everything went as planned. As we
grew, I couldn’t do that for everyone, but I wanted to keep that personal touch alive. We are still
one of the few medical alert companies that does in home installations and checks up on our clients
to see how they’re after they have used our service.

#### [Read More][71]

Since I took part in all aspects of our business from the start, I’ve always felt very connected to
our clients and felt quite strongly how important Vital Link was to helping them keep their
independence while providing peace of mind to them and their families.

Since 1981, I’ve listened and learned from our clients’ stories and the reasons why they needed our
service. Many have told me how they had fallen and weren’t able to get help as they laid on the
floor all night. My heart went out to them, and I was honored to be able to present a solution to
keep them living safely and independently in their homes.

I always wanted to create a business that took care of people and focused on service and making a
positive impact on our community rather than concentrating on growth and profits. We have always
made a priority of supporting compassionate causes rather than spending resources on marketing and
advertising. We reduce our rates for low income clients, Meals on Wheels recipients and veterans as
a way to give back to those in need. Being President of the Board for Meals on Wheels of Alameda
County allowed me to serve many of our frail, homebound seniors on a volunteer basis. I started
providing pro bono service for our local Holocaust survivors after some of them shared their stories
with my son’s middle school class. I wanted to show him the importance of giving back to our
community and for him to hear the survivor’s experiences while we brought our systems into their
homes.

As a true family business, it’s very rewarding being able to work side by side with my son Asher who
grew up in our business and is now our Director of Operations. Over the years my wife, daughter,
sister, niece and close friends have been and are involved in our company.

In the early days I was able to provide Vital Link services and protect my grandparents and their
peers, then my parents and their friends and now my contemporaries. Even I relied on our service
when both of my hips were replaced and I had limited mobility.

Our goal is to make the entire process courteous, professional and seamless for our clients and
their families. We are here to provide solutions while communicating in a warm and personal way.
When you call us, you will always speak to one of our caring staff directly. There’s no pushing one
for this department or two for that department. Openness, honesty, integrity and respect are at our
core.

You can always be assured that we are going to treat you and yours like family and do exactly what
we say we are going to do. We work hard to go beyond and exceed our client’s expectations. We’re
here to make your life easier and provide you with security and peace of mind.

On behalf of our hardworking staff, I’d like to thank you for the trust you have placed in Vital
Link Medical Alert Systems.

Sincerely,

Arthur Hoffman,

CEO and Founder

# Mobile X: GPS Medical Alert with Fall Detection for Bay Area Seniors

Built-in fall detection, GPS tracking, two-way voice, and optional caregiver app. Starting at
$40.95/mo.

[Mobile X GPS medical alert with fall detection device held in hand]

## Automatic Fall Detection That Travels with You

The **Mobile X** is a GPS medical alert with fall detection built directly into the device. If it
senses a heavy fall, it automatically contacts our monitoring center, even if you are unable to
press the button yourself. Whether you are at home in Oakland, visiting friends in San Jose, or
traveling anywhere in the United States, this device keeps you protected around the clock.

For Bay Area seniors and their families, the Mobile X offers something most at-home systems cannot:
portable fall detection combined with real-time GPS tracking. If you or a loved one has experienced
a fall before, or if falling is a concern, this GPS medical alert with fall detection provides an
extra layer of safety that does not depend on being near a base station.

## How the Mobile X Works
1. **A fall is detected automatically** by sensors built into the device, or you press the help
button manually from anywhere in the United States.
2. **Speak directly** with a trained emergency operator through the device’s built-in two-way
speaker.
3. **Help is dispatched** to your GPS location based on your personalized Emergency Care Plan,
including calls to family, neighbors, or emergency services.

If you cannot respond after a fall or button press, our operators use GPS to locate you and follow
your care plan automatically. They dispatch help and begin contacting your emergency contacts
immediately.

## Optional Caregiver App (+$10/mo)

For families who want extra visibility, the Mobile X offers an optional caregiver app for an
additional $10 per month. The app gives authorized family members and caregivers:
* Real-time GPS location of the device
* Device status at a glance without needing to call

For adult children managing a parent’s safety from across the Bay Area or across the country, the
caregiver app provides peace of mind between visits and phone calls.

## Why Bay Area Families Choose Vital Link

Vital Link has served the Northern California community since 1981. We are a family-owned company
based in Oakland, not a national chain shipping boxes from a warehouse. Even though the Mobile X
works anywhere in the United States, every device is set up in person by a local technician who
makes sure you are comfortable before leaving.

We work closely with [hospitals, discharge planners, and case managers][71] throughout Alameda,
Contra Costa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Marin, Napa, Solano, Sonoma, and Santa Cruz
counties. If your loved one is transitioning home after a hospital stay, we coordinate directly with
their care team to ensure protection is in place before they walk through the door.

All equipment is covered by a lifetime replacement warranty at no extra cost. We also ship
replacement charging cradles for free. If something breaks, we fix it.

## Is the Mobile X Right for You?

This GPS medical alert with fall detection is the best fit if you:
* Have experienced a fall or are at higher risk of falling
* Want automatic fall detection that works both at home and on the go
* Want GPS tracking so emergency responders can find you quickly
* Leave the house regularly for errands, walks, appointments, or social activities
* Want a professional to set up the device and train you in person

Also consider our [Mobile W][72] if you prefer fall detection in a wristwatch form factor. Or
[compare all Vital Link products][73] to find the right combination.

## Get Started in Three Steps

### 1. Contact Us

Call our Oakland office or [reach out through our website][74]. Many clients are referred by a
healthcare provider, social worker, or discharge planner.

### 2. Local Setup

We schedule a convenient time for a Bay Area technician to deliver, set up, and demonstrate the
device in your home.

### 3. 24/7 Protection

Your Mobile X is active, monitored, and backed by a local team that knows the Bay Area.

## Protect Your Independence with Built-In Fall Detection

Ready to stay protected at home and on the go with a GPS medical alert with fall detection,
installed and supported by a local Bay Area team? Call our Oakland office for a free consultation.

and Santa Cruz Counties.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How does fall detection work?

The Mobile X uses built-in sensors to detect sudden changes in motion and impact consistent with a
fall. If a fall is detected, the device automatically contacts our monitoring center. You do not
need to press the button.

### What if the device detects a fall that did not happen?

If the device triggers a false alert, simply tell the operator you are fine. There is no penalty.
The sensors are tuned to minimize false alerts while still detecting real falls.

### Does the Mobile X work outside the Bay Area?

Yes. The device works anywhere in the United States with cellular coverage. Many clients take it
when traveling or visiting family in other states.

### How often do I need to charge it?

The battery lasts up to 5 days on a single charge. Simply place the device in the included charging
cradle when the battery gets low. Low-battery alerts are sent to you and your responder list via
email and text automatically.

### Can I wear it in the shower?

The Mobile X is water resistant and shower-ready. It should not be fully submerged in water such as
in a bath or pool.

### What happens if I press the button but cannot speak?

Our operators use GPS to locate you and follow your Emergency Care Plan automatically. They dispatch
help and begin calling your emergency contacts.

### Who can use the caregiver app?

The caregiver app is an optional add-on for $10 per month. Any family member or caregiver you
authorize can access the app for real-time GPS location and device status.

### Do I need a phone line or internet?

No. The Mobile X uses its own built-in LTE cellular connection. It does not require a landline,
internet, or Wi-Fi.

### What if the device breaks?

All equipment is covered by a lifetime replacement warranty at no cost to you.

Our vision is to set the standard for compassionate care in the medical alert industry by treating
every client, family member, and partner with honesty, dignity, and respect. We are committed to
long-term relationships built on trust, transparency, and service excellence.

### Letter from CEO

It wasn’t long after I started Vital Link Medical Alert Systems back in 1981 that I began to
understand how we made a difference in people’s lives and how working with our clients began to
affect mine.

Back then, I assembled the equipment, handled the sales, installations, administration and made sure
that all our clients were comfortable with using Vital Link.

In the early days I was notified by our monitoring center on every emergency. Many times I would
receive multiple calls throughout the night to make sure that everything went as planned. As we
grew, I couldn’t do that for everyone, but I wanted to keep that personal touch alive. We are still
one of the few medical alert companies that does in home installations and checks up on our clients
to see how they’re after they have used our service.

#### [Read More][71]

Since I took part in all aspects of our business from the start, I’ve always felt very connected to
our clients and felt quite strongly how important Vital Link was to helping them keep their
independence while providing peace of mind to them and their families.

Since 1981, I’ve listened and learned from our clients’ stories and the reasons why they needed our
service. Many have told me how they had fallen and weren’t able to get help as they laid on the
floor all night. My heart went out to them, and I was honored to be able to present a solution to
keep them living safely and independently in their homes.

I always wanted to create a business that took care of people and focused on service and making a
positive impact on our community rather than concentrating on growth and profits. We have always
made a priority of supporting compassionate causes rather than spending resources on marketing and
advertising. We reduce our rates for low income clients, Meals on Wheels recipients and veterans as
a way to give back to those in need. Being President of the Board for Meals on Wheels of Alameda
County allowed me to serve many of our frail, homebound seniors on a volunteer basis. I started
providing pro bono service for our local Holocaust survivors after some of them shared their stories
with my son’s middle school class. I wanted to show him the importance of giving back to our
community and for him to hear the survivor’s experiences while we brought our systems into their
homes.

As a true family business, it’s very rewarding being able to work side by side with my son Asher who
grew up in our business and is now our Director of Operations. Over the years my wife, daughter,
sister, niece and close friends have been and are involved in our company.

In the early days I was able to provide Vital Link services and protect my grandparents and their
peers, then my parents and their friends and now my contemporaries. Even I relied on our service
when both of my hips were replaced and I had limited mobility.

Our goal is to make the entire process courteous, professional and seamless for our clients and
their families. We are here to provide solutions while communicating in a warm and personal way.
When you call us, you will always speak to one of our caring staff directly. There’s no pushing one
for this department or two for that department. Openness, honesty, integrity and respect are at our
core.

You can always be assured that we are going to treat you and yours like family and do exactly what
we say we are going to do. We work hard to go beyond and exceed our client’s expectations. We’re
here to make your life easier and provide you with security and peace of mind.

On behalf of our hardworking staff, I’d like to thank you for the trust you have placed in Vital
Link Medical Alert Systems.

Sincerely,

Arthur Hoffman,

CEO and Founder
Vital Link Medical Alert Systems

FAQs

What health conditions can Vitalis devices help monitor?

Vitalis devices monitor vital signs relevant to chronic conditions like hypertension, diabetes, heart disease, and respiratory issues. Our tools offer real-time insights into blood pressure, oxygen levels, glucose, and heart rate.

How does the SOS button work during emergencies?

The SOS button on your Vitalis wearable sends an instant alert to your designated emergency contacts or caregiver through our mobile app. GPS tracking is also activated for rapid location sharing.

Is Vitalis compatible with smartphones and apps?

Yes! All Vitalis devices sync with our easy-to-use mobile app, available on both iOS and Android.

Can I use Vitalis if I’m still active and independent?

Absolutely. Vitalis is built for active seniors who want peace of mind while maintaining independence.

Is there help available for setting up my device?

Yes, we offer full support! You can contact us for step-by-step setup assistance via phone or email, and our team will walk you through installation, usage, and troubleshooting.

## Safer and Smarter Senior Living with Remote Health Monitoring

Remote patient monitoring (RPM) has emerged as a transformative healthcare solution in today’s
digital era.
At Vitalis, we bridge the gap between healthcare providers and patients, enabling continuous
monitoring of vital health metrics beyond traditional clinical settings.
We empower healthcare organizations to deliver proactive, personalized care while patients maintain
their independence and comfort at home.

Vitalis was born to transform aging in place through intelligent and connected care.
Make your home the safest place to grow older.

## Our Story

### “How can we care better for the people who once cared for us?”

That question was our starting point.

After analyzing the overwhelmed traditional healthcare system for aging people, we realized the hard
challenges millions of families face when balancing independence and safety.

It was then that we decided to upgrade healthcare for seniors.
Vitalis was created to combine empathy, innovation, and real-time insights to support families and
caregivers.

FAQs

What health conditions can Vitalis devices help monitor?

Vitalis devices monitor vital signs relevant to chronic conditions like hypertension, diabetes, heart disease, and respiratory issues. Our tools offer real-time insights into blood pressure, oxygen levels, glucose, and heart rate.

How does the SOS button work during emergencies?

The SOS button on your Vitalis wearable sends an instant alert to your designated emergency contacts or caregiver through our mobile app. GPS tracking is also activated for rapid location sharing.

Is Vitalis compatible with smartphones and apps?

Yes! All Vitalis devices sync with our easy-to-use mobile app, available on both iOS and Android.

Can I use Vitalis if I’m still active and independent?

Absolutely. Vitalis is built for active seniors who want peace of mind while maintaining independence.

Is there help available for setting up my device?

Yes, we offer full support! You can contact us for step-by-step setup assistance via phone or email, and our team will walk you through installation, usage, and troubleshooting.

## Safer and Smarter Senior Living with Remote Health Monitoring

Remote patient monitoring (RPM) has emerged as a transformative healthcare solution in today’s
digital era.
At Vitalis, we bridge the gap between healthcare providers and patients, enabling continuous
monitoring of vital health metrics beyond traditional clinical settings.
We empower healthcare organizations to deliver proactive, personalized care while patients maintain
their independence and comfort at home.

Vitalis was born to transform aging in place through intelligent and connected care.
Make your home the safest place to grow older.

## Our Story

### “How can we care better for the people who once cared for us?”

That question was our starting point.

After analyzing the overwhelmed traditional healthcare system for aging people, we realized the hard
challenges millions of families face when balancing independence and safety.

It was then that we decided to upgrade healthcare for seniors.
Vitalis was created to combine empathy, innovation, and real-time insights to support families and
caregivers.

## Common Safety Challenges in Elderly Care

Elderly care providers, Telecare brands, and system integrators need more than a basic smartwatch.
They need wearable safety devices that can support real emergency scenarios, long-term use, remote
monitoring, and integration with care platforms.
[Comparison between traditional high false alarm fall sensors and WellCare professional nursing home
solutions.]
Fall Risks

Falls can happen at home, in care facilities, or during outdoor activities. When the wearer cannot
press a button manually, automatic fall detection can provide an additional layer of protection.

Emergency Response Delays

In elderly care, every minute matters. A wearable SOS device helps seniors send an alert quickly to
family members, caregivers, monitoring centers, or connected care platforms.

Wandering and Location Loss

For seniors with memory issues or independent living needs, GPS tracking and geo-fencing help
caregivers know where the wearer is and receive alerts when they leave a predefined safe area.

Platform and Deployment Complexity

Telecare projects often require device management, alert routing, firmware support, SDK/API
integration, and stable bulk delivery. Consumer-grade smartwatches are usually not designed for
these requirements.

## Common Safety Challenges in Elderly Care

Elderly care providers, Telecare brands, and system integrators need more than a basic smartwatch.
They need wearable safety devices that can support real emergency scenarios, long-term use, remote
monitoring, and integration with care platforms.
[Comparison between traditional high false alarm fall sensors and WellCare professional nursing home
solutions.]
Fall Risks

Falls can happen at home, in care facilities, or during outdoor activities. When the wearer cannot
press a button manually, automatic fall detection can provide an additional layer of protection.

Emergency Response Delays

In elderly care, every minute matters. A wearable SOS device helps seniors send an alert quickly to
family members, caregivers, monitoring centers, or connected care platforms.

Wandering and Location Loss

For seniors with memory issues or independent living needs, GPS tracking and geo-fencing help
caregivers know where the wearer is and receive alerts when they leave a predefined safe area.

Platform and Deployment Complexity

Telecare projects often require device management, alert routing, firmware support, SDK/API
integration, and stable bulk delivery. Consumer-grade smartwatches are usually not designed for
these requirements.

watches, fall detection watches, and Telecare wearables. Our devices are designed for senior safety,
remote care, and platform-connected monitoring scenarios.

Support independent living, home care, assisted living, senior care facilities, and memory care

with ODM development, platform integration, and manufacturing support.

# About Us

## About AlertLink

**We build reliable, easy-to-use emergency medical alert devices**—right here in the UK. From
all-day watches to discreet pendants, our products combine 4G connectivity, GPS location, one-touch
SOS and intelligent fall detection to keep people safe at home and on the move.

## Our mission

To give people the confidence to live independently, and to give families and care providers the
reassurance that help is only a button-press away. We believe safety tech should be simple,
dependable and genuinely helpful in real life—not complicated or fragile.

## What we make
* **Medical Alert Watch** – All-day wearable protection with 4G calls, GPS, automatic fall alerts,
water resistance and long battery life.
* **Medical Alert Pendant** – Lightweight, waterproof and discreet with one-touch SOS, 4G
connectivity and fall detection.
* **Coming next** – A growing range of bases, sensors and accessories designed to work seamlessly
with our wearables.

> *Note: Fall detection is designed to assist, but no system can detect every fall or replace
> professional medical care.*

## Who we serve

**Independent users & families** – Straightforward devices that are comfortable to wear and simple
to charge and manage.

**Care providers & monitoring centres** – Fleet-ready hardware built for deployment at scale, with
options for 24/7 monitoring and integration into existing workflows.

**Lone workers & community teams** – Discreet personal protection that supports duty-of-care
policies in the field.

## Sustainability & service

### Good engineering lasts. We prioritise durability, repair-friendly design, firmware support and
### responsible end-of-life recycling. If something goes wrong, our UK helpdesk, warranty and
### straightforward returns process keep you moving.

### Quality & compliance

We follow rigorous testing, documentation and traceability across our range. Where specific
certification or conformity is required for a product, we’ll state it clearly and provide the
paperwork to match.

## Our story

AlertLink began with a simple idea: make safety technology that families actually trust and
professionals are proud to deploy. We started with a watch that could genuinely handle daily life.
Then came a pendant that’s so light people forget they’re wearing it. Today, we’re expanding the
range so you can protect more people in more places—with the same reliability at the core.

## Our values
* **Dependability** – If it isn’t reliable, it isn’t finished.
* **Clarity** – Plain English, clear choices, honest claims.
* **Dignity** – Technology that supports independence without getting in the way.
* **Care** – Real people on the other end when you need help.

## Work with us

Whether you’re choosing a device for a loved one, planning a rollout across a housing scheme, or
looking for a UK manufacturing partner, we’d love to help. Ask us about demos, pilot schemes,
wholesale pricing and integration options.

**AlertLink** – Protection you can wear. Confidence you can feel.

##### OUR PRODUCTS

###### AlertLink Watch

The AlertLink Watch is an all-day wearable designed to keep you protected wherever you are. With
one-touch SOS, built-in GPS location and intelligent fall detection, it connects over 4G to alert
family, carers or a monitoring centre quickly and clearly. The screen is easy to read, the buttons
are tactile, and the water-resistant casing is built for real life—walks in the rain, busy routines
and everything in between. A comfortable strap and simple, magnetic charging make it effortless to
wear and keep powered.

###### AlertLink Pendant

The AlertLink Pendant delivers powerful protection in a compact, discreet form. A single press sends
an SOS over 4G while sharing GPS location, and its advanced motion sensors can trigger an alert
automatically if a fall is detected. Lightweight, comfortable and water-resistant, it’s designed to
be worn all day—under a cardigan, on a lanyard, or clipped where it’s easiest—so help is never far
away. Charging is quick and fuss-free with a magnetic dock.

# About Us

## About AlertLink

**We build reliable, easy-to-use emergency medical alert devices**—right here in the UK. From
all-day watches to discreet pendants, our products combine 4G connectivity, GPS location, one-touch
SOS and intelligent fall detection to keep people safe at home and on the move.

## Our mission

To give people the confidence to live independently, and to give families and care providers the
reassurance that help is only a button-press away. We believe safety tech should be simple,
dependable and genuinely helpful in real life—not complicated or fragile.

## What we make
* **Medical Alert Watch** – All-day wearable protection with 4G calls, GPS, automatic fall alerts,
water resistance and long battery life.
* **Medical Alert Pendant** – Lightweight, waterproof and discreet with one-touch SOS, 4G
connectivity and fall detection.
* **Coming next** – A growing range of bases, sensors and accessories designed to work seamlessly
with our wearables.

> *Note: Fall detection is designed to assist, but no system can detect every fall or replace
> professional medical care.*

## Who we serve

**Independent users & families** – Straightforward devices that are comfortable to wear and simple
to charge and manage.

**Care providers & monitoring centres** – Fleet-ready hardware built for deployment at scale, with
options for 24/7 monitoring and integration into existing workflows.

**Lone workers & community teams** – Discreet personal protection that supports duty-of-care
policies in the field.

## Sustainability & service

### Good engineering lasts. We prioritise durability, repair-friendly design, firmware support and
### responsible end-of-life recycling. If something goes wrong, our UK helpdesk, warranty and
### straightforward returns process keep you moving.

### Quality & compliance

We follow rigorous testing, documentation and traceability across our range. Where specific
certification or conformity is required for a product, we’ll state it clearly and provide the
paperwork to match.

## Our story

AlertLink began with a simple idea: make safety technology that families actually trust and
professionals are proud to deploy. We started with a watch that could genuinely handle daily life.
Then came a pendant that’s so light people forget they’re wearing it. Today, we’re expanding the
range so you can protect more people in more places—with the same reliability at the core.

## Our values
* **Dependability** – If it isn’t reliable, it isn’t finished.
* **Clarity** – Plain English, clear choices, honest claims.
* **Dignity** – Technology that supports independence without getting in the way.
* **Care** – Real people on the other end when you need help.

## Work with us

Whether you’re choosing a device for a loved one, planning a rollout across a housing scheme, or
looking for a UK manufacturing partner, we’d love to help. Ask us about demos, pilot schemes,
wholesale pricing and integration options.

**AlertLink** – Protection you can wear. Confidence you can feel.

##### OUR PRODUCTS

###### AlertLink Watch

The AlertLink Watch is an all-day wearable designed to keep you protected wherever you are. With
one-touch SOS, built-in GPS location and intelligent fall detection, it connects over 4G to alert
family, carers or a monitoring centre quickly and clearly. The screen is easy to read, the buttons
are tactile, and the water-resistant casing is built for real life—walks in the rain, busy routines
and everything in between. A comfortable strap and simple, magnetic charging make it effortless to
wear and keep powered.

###### AlertLink Pendant

The AlertLink Pendant delivers powerful protection in a compact, discreet form. A single press sends
an SOS over 4G while sharing GPS location, and its advanced motion sensors can trigger an alert
automatically if a fall is detected. Lightweight, comfortable and water-resistant, it’s designed to
be worn all day—under a cardigan, on a lanyard, or clipped where it’s easiest—so help is never far
away. Charging is quick and fuss-free with a magnetic dock.

Alert Watch and AlertLink Pendant

FAQs

What types of devices does Assured Independence offer?

The homepage already highlights On-The-Go medical alert devices , In-Home safety alert systems , and Medication management solutions .

What does the medication management solution do?

The Smart Pill Box section explains that medication reminders help users remember pills and provide audible and visual cues to improve healthier, more independent lives.

How does fall detection work?

The Fall Detection Ready section states the system detects when a fall occurs and will automatically send emergency response teams to help.

What devices will get the emergency alerts?

Emergency alerts are sent through Assured Independence medical alert devices, including wearable help buttons, mobile alert devices, and in-home systems connected to a base unit.

What is the highest rated medical alert system for seniors?

Highly rated medical alert systems are those that offer reliable emergency response, long battery life, strong signal range, fall detection, and certified monitoringsupport—features emphasized by Assured Independence solutions.

What is the best medical alert system available?

The best medical alert system is one that matches an individual’s lifestyle, offers dependable emergency response, and provides features such as mobility support, fall detection, and ease of use.

## FAQs

How do I call for help?

**Should you ever need help, simply press and hold the Call Button until the light around it turns
solid blue**. After a short delay, you will hear a voice message and then tones or ringing. Once you
are connected to one of our highly-certified emergency operators, you can then speak with an
operator directly through the device and request emergency services or a member of your Care Circle
to come help you.

I lead an independent lifestyle. I don't need a device.

While you may not be concerned about your safety now, accidents and other unexpected health concerns
become increasingly likely as we get older. For example, each year 1 in 4 people age 65 or older
suffers a fall. After you've fallen once, your chance of falling again unfortunately doubles.
Additionally, throwing out your back, unexpected bouts of vertigo, and other accidents are all
reasons why having a medical alert system can ensure your safety.

The good news is that 90% of older adults who get help within one hour will be able to return home
and resume their lives. Being proactive ensures that if an accident does happen again, the help you
need is on the way.

Will if fit my lifestyle?

Medical Guardian devices are designed with all lifestyles in mind. Whether you're relaxing at home,
working out at the gym, or visiting your doctor, we have an option to suit your needs.

Please visit our Buying Advice page

It's too expensive.

Cost is an understandable concern. However, the cost of not investing in a medical alert device can
be more devastating than investing in one. Experts refer to the first hour after a fall occurs as
the "golden hour." Receiving medical attention during this critical time has been shown to
dramatically decrease medical costs and increase survival rates. After the first hour, treatment
becomes riskier and is more likely to result in the need for rehabilitation and costly long-term
care. For about $1 a day, you and your loved ones can feel the peace of mind that comes with 24-hour
emergency response at the push of a button.

I am older, but I'm not at risk.

Your risk of falling increases with age. However, medical alert devices are helpful for
non-emergency uses, as well. You can use Medical Guardian's non-emergency dispatch services at any
time. Simply press the button on your medical alert device and connect with our 24/7 monitoring
center. This is helpful if you're not feeling well, get stuck and need assistance, have flare-ups of
a medical condition, endure an allergic reaction to food or medication, or if something is making
you uneasy and you need someone to talk to.

## FAQs

Will the Home 2.0 protect me in my entire home?

**Yes.**
Home 2.0 keeps you protected both in and around your home, so whether you experience an accident in
the shower or while going about your daily routine, you will always be able to contact our
monitoring center using your Interchangeable Help Button.

Can I speak to an emergency operator through my emergency alert necklace or wristband?

**No.**
You can only speak to an operator through the base station's 2-way speaker system. The
Interchangeable Help Button simply allows you to contact our monitoring center up to 1,400 feet in
every direction of the base station. If you are unable to speak with our operators, they send
emergency services to your home right away.

Are there any additional fees to pay for the Home 2.0 using AT&T's service?

**No.**
You never have to worry about any additional fees for when the Home 2.0 contacts our monitoring
center using AT&T's cellular network. Plus, you don't even need to use AT&T in order to be protected
in your home.

I live with my spouse. Can he/she be protected as well?

**Yes.**
Multiple Interchangeable Help Buttons can be synced with your Home 2.0 base station so you and your
spouse, or another family member, can be protected in and around your home.
