## A solution for every med schedule

The Smart Pillbox system can be modified to fit your needs. Depending on the number of times per day
you take medication there is a setup option based on your med schedule.

## 1 med time: Single device setup

For once a day med schedules we recommend a single device setup.

Device will be set to dispense meds once per day and will need to be refilled every two weeks.

The green med strip is used to label the med slots of once a day devices.

## 2 med times: Single device setup

For twice a day med schedules we recommend a single device setup.

Device will be set to dispense meds twice per day and will need to be refilled every week.

The orange and purple med strip is used to label the med slots of twice a day devices.

## 3 med times: Two device setup

For three times a day med schedules we recommend a two device setup.

One device will be set to dispense meds once a day. The other will dispense meds twice a day.

The once/day device will use a 7-slot tray. The twice/day device will use a 14 slot tray. This will
allow both devices to be on the same weekly refill schedule.

## 4 med times: Two device setup

For individuals that take medication four times per day we recommend a two device setup.

Both devices will be set up to dispense meds twice a day.

Both devices will use the orange and purple tray inserts to label the slots and will need to be
refilled weekly.

## NEW! 7-Slot Tray

The 7-slot tray is designed for people who take a lot of pills, or many large vitamins, at one
time.The tray fits in the same device but doubles the size of each compartment, allowing you to fit
more medications in each slot.

## Portable

The small and 3-4 day battery life make it easy to travel with the device. Each compartment fits a
large number of medications. For example: 7 multivitamins, 12 acetaminophen gel caps, 3 fish oils,
or 22 aspiring size tablets.

## Easy to Set Up

The on-screen guide walks through a simple setup process, so staring services is easy. We also offer
24/7 support and free over the phone setups if needed.

## No Wi-Fi Needed

The Smart Pillbox does not need Wi-Fi to operate. The 4G LTE cellular chip allows it to stay
connected and send live notications.

## Easy to Fill

The on-screen animation shows how to correctly fill medications in each compartment. To make
refilling easier, we also provide extra trays (at no extra cost). Trays can be pre-filled and easily
swapped into the Smart Pillbox when a refill is needed.

## Secure

Secure the lid with the included security screw set. Medications will dispense like normal even when
locked. Notifications can be sent to alert caregivers if the lid is removed when it should not be,
indicating possible medication confusion or abuse.

## Easy to Dispense

Taking pills is easy as flipping the pillbox into your hand or a cup. An adaptive flipping device is
available when picking up and flipping the device is difficult.

## Notifications

The Smart Pillbox can let caregivers know if medications are not being remembered or taken as
directed. It can send notifications via phone call, text message, or email.

## Adaptive Equipment

We provide adaptive equipment to ensure the Dose Flip can be accessible for everyone. We live by the
motto “we don’t know what we don’t know, so tell us”. Meaning, if you ever feel our services can
improve in any way, please let us know. We welcome and appreciate all feedback!

flashing light from the screen is easier to see

The adaptive flipper can make it easier to dispense medications. This can be used for anyone who may
struggle to pick up and flip the device on their own.

The refiling disk clicks onto the tray of the Smart Pillbox to expand the filling surface, making it
easier to double check medications as they are filled.

## Getting help has never been easier!

Press the Help Button to speak to our 24/7 Emergency Monitors. Optional Fall Detection can also
automatically call for you.

## Request AnyType of Help

We can dispatch the police, fire department, EMTs, mental health services, or even a member of your
*Care Circle *on your behalf.

## Fast, Reliable, Peace of Mind

You are not alone. 4G means our strongest-ever signal keeps you connected until the right kind of
help arrives.

## Embrace Voice Assist Technology

Activate self-testing and spoken reports about your device status with the simple press of a button.
Smarti serves as a 1-stop hub for essential device information.

## Enjoy Our Fastest Speed Yet

Mobile 2.0 is connected anywhere with cellular service. It even features advanced location
monitoring that uses 4G LTE, WiFi & GPS to ensure our best-ever connection speed.

## Wear It Your Way

Clip the device to your clothing, place it in your bag or attach it to a lanyard and wear it around
your neck.

## Aditional Features

## Connect Your Care Circle

Build a network of emergency contacts in CareHub 365 that are instantly reachable in times of need.
Your Care Circle can even view your hourly location and/or activity, if desired.

## Reliable Multi-Day Battery

1 full charge lasts between 3-5 days so that you can have peace of mind on-the-go. Mobile 2.0 is a
reliably connected companion for extended weekends, excursions and more!

## Experience Care on Call

Our attentive, 24/7 Monitoring Center has your back in times of need. We keep essential information
instantly accessible while safeguarding your privacy.

## Reclaim Your Shower Time

Shower in relaxation, knowing you have water-resistant protection. Your Mobile 2.0 suite can be worn
in the shower.

## Forget You're Wearing It

Mobile 2.0 is one of our most lightweight designs weighing in at 1.7 ounces. A comparable mobile
device is typically 2.5 ounces.

## Illuminating LEDs

Your base device is armed with 4 LED indicator lights to communicate charging status, cellular
connectivity, battery life, and more.

Your package will come with a handy *User Manual *in addition to the following:

CareHub 365 helps manage all aspects of your account and build your own network to communicate with

## FAQs

Does the Mobile 2.0 have location tracking?

Yes, the Mobile 2.0 has advanced hourly location monitoring backed by GPS, Wi-Fi and 4G LTE.

How far can I be away from the Mobile 2.0 base unit for accessories to sync?

Your paired accessories have a range of up to 500 ft. from your Mobile 2.0 device. That is larger
than the length of an entire football field!

How do I know when the battery is running low on my Mobile 2.0?

You can press Smarti Voice Assist to hear your battery level. If your device is running very low,
the light on the device will blink red every 3 seconds.

Can I wear the Mobile 2.0 in the shower?

Your Mobile 2.0 buttons are waterproof and can be worn in the shower. Your base device is
water-resistant, but if it becomes fully submerged for more than 30 minutes, pat it down and leave
it out to dry.

Can I cancel the alarm if accidentally pressed and activated?

Press and hold the help button on your device or wristband or necklace for 5 seconds until the
device says “Alarm Cancelled.” Wait until you hear the prompt to release.

any equipment. Enjoy peace of mind knowing we will protect your equipment.

*Button replacement does not apply to SmartWatch

## FAQs

Will I be protected in my entire home with the In Home Landline?

**Yes.**
The In Home Landline provides the largest range of any in-home medical alert system, ensuring your
safety both in and around your home. So whether you experience an accident while relaxing at home,
getting the mail, or showering, you will always be able to receive immediate help.

Can I speak to an emergency operator through my emergency alert necklace or wristband?

**No.**
You can only speak to an operator through the base station. The wearable button simply allows you to
call for help up to 1,300 feet in every direction of the base station. If you are unable to speak
with our emergency operators, they immediately dispatch local emergency personnel to your home.

I live with my spouse. Can he/she be protected as well?

**Yes.**
The base station is compatible with multiple medical alert buttons so you and your spouse, or
another family member, can each be protected in your home.

How does a medical alert button with fall detection work?

With the In Home Landline, you have the option of purchasing a water-resistant fall alert pendant.
When the pendant detects a fall, it sends a wireless signal to the base station, which then connects
you to our monitoring center using your landline telephone. For just $10/month, you can enjoy the
added peace of mind knowing that you will always get help in an emergency.

*Fall Detection does not detect 100% of falls. If Customer is able, Customer should press the help
button in the event of an emergency. The 911 emergency services line is an alternative to the System
and the Services. Fall Detection must be worn around the neck to allow for adequate detection of
falls.

Is the In Home Landline portable?

The Assured Protection Plan offers unlimited technical support, equipment repairs, and discounts on
any equipment. Enjoy peace of mind knowing we will protect your equipment.

damage is a result of any of the following:
* Accidental damage from drops or spills
* Normal Wear and Tear
* Heat, Humidity and dust
* Manufacturing defects
* Electrical Power surges
* AND – lifetime battery replacement(s)

*Button replacement does not apply to SmartWatch

Belle Medical Alerts Catalog

Belle Medical Alerts delivers peace of mind beyond the home with sleek, mobile emergency devices built for real life on the move. Powered by ResponseNow and backed by reliable 4G LTE coverage nationwide, Belle blends simplicity, style, and fast human response into wearable protection you can trust anywhere.

Top Belle Medical Alerts

Belle Medical Alerts – Belle

The Belle mobile pendant offers straightforward, nationwide 4G LTE emergency coverage with a long‑lasting battery and easy one‑button access to live help.

Check Price

Belle Medical Alerts – Belle+

The Belle+ builds on the classic model with automatic fall detection and GPS/WiFi location tracking for enhanced protection during daily activities.

Check Price

Belle Medical Alerts – In‑Home Option

The Belle In‑Home system brings dependable, stationary emergency support for users who spend most of their time at home while still benefiting from 24/7 professional monitoring.

Check Price

Belle Medical Alerts brings confidence and freedom together with simple, reliable mobile emergency solutions built for everyday independence.

Product Categories
Belle
This standard mobile pendant focuses on simplicity and reliability, offering one-button access to live operators, nationwide 4G LTE coverage, and an impressive battery life of up to 30 days for worry-free daily use.
Belle+
This enhanced option adds automatic fall detection and precise GPS/WiFi location tracking, making it ideal for more active users who want extra protection, even though it requires more frequent charging.
In-Home Options
Designed for those who spend most of their time indoors, these stationary systems provide dependable emergency access at home while maintaining the same 24/7 professional monitoring support.
Michael Thompson
I purchased the Belle pendant for my father after he decided to continue living on his own, and it has been a game changer for our family. The battery lasts nearly a full month, so we’re not constantly reminding him to charge it, and he finds the button easy to press even with arthritis. We tested the system together, and the operator answered quickly and clearly, which instantly eased his anxiety and mine. He now wears it every day without complaint, even in the shower, and says it makes him feel secure without feeling “monitored.”
Linda Martinez
After a minor fall last year, I chose the Belle+ because of the fall detection feature, and I’m very glad I did. The device is lightweight and comfortable around my neck, and when I tripped in my backyard, the system automatically connected me to an operator who stayed on the line until help arrived. The GPS worked accurately, and my daughter was notified right away. Charging every few days is a small tradeoff for the peace of mind I feel when I’m walking, shopping, or gardening alone.
Robert Jenkins
I use one of the in-home Belle systems for my apartment, and it has proven to be reliable and straightforward. Setup was simple, and I didn’t need a landline or complicated equipment. When I accidentally pressed the button during the first week, the response team was polite, calm, and reassuring, which showed me they truly care about their users. Knowing that help is just a button press away has made living alone far less stressful.

Belle FAQ

What networks do Belle Medical Alerts devices use?
Belle Medical Alerts devices operate on AT&T or Verizon 4G LTE networks, providing nationwide coverage without the need for a landline or base station.
How long does the battery last on each device?
The standard Belle pendant can last up to 30 days, Belle+ typically requires charging every 5–6 days, and wrist or in-home models have varying battery life depending on usage.
Is fall detection included with all models?
No, automatic fall detection is only included with Belle+ and optional for some wrist-worn models; the basic Belle pendant does not have this feature.
Can I wear the device in the shower or bath?
Devices are shower-safe but not fully submersible, so they can be worn while showering but should not be worn while swimming or bathing.
Do I need a landline to use Belle Medical Alerts?
No landline is required; all devices connect directly to emergency operators through cellular networks.
How quickly will an operator respond in an emergency?
Response times typically range from 30 to 60 seconds, connecting users directly to trained operators who can dispatch help immediately.
Are there long-term contracts or hidden fees?
No long-term contracts are required, and equipment is free with options for monthly, quarterly, or annual plans.
Belle X | ResponseNow Medical Alert
﻿ ﻿

## About us

EMRI GREEN HEALTH SERVICES ((formerly known as GVK EMRI)) is a pioneer in Emergency Management
Services in India. As a not – for – profit professional organization operating in the Public-Private
Partnership (PPP) mode, EMRI GREEN HEALTH SERVICES is the largest professional Emergency Service
Provider in India today.

April 2005 was the turning point for emergency medical services in India. The organization was
incepted with the objective of delivering comprehensive, speedy, reliable and quality Emergency Care
Services. This has been done by establishing an Emergency Response System that coordinates every
emergency through a toll free number 108/112 which when called in an emergency ensures prompt
communication and activation of a response that includes, assessment of the emergency, dispatch of
the ambulances, along with a well trained Emergency Medical Technician to render quality
pre-hospital care and transport of the patient to the appropriate health care facility.

Today, 108 is synonymous with the best-in-class emergency service and has been acknowledged as the
most efficient, speedy, reliable, and caring service provider in its category.

## About us

EMRI GREEN HEALTH SERVICES ((formerly known as GVK EMRI)) is a pioneer in Emergency Management
Services in India. As a not – for – profit professional organization operating in the Public-Private
Partnership (PPP) mode, EMRI GREEN HEALTH SERVICES is the largest professional Emergency Service
Provider in India today.

April 2005 was the turning point for emergency medical services in India. The organization was
incepted with the objective of delivering comprehensive, speedy, reliable and quality Emergency Care
Services. This has been done by establishing an Emergency Response System that coordinates every
emergency through a toll free number 108/112 which when called in an emergency ensures prompt
communication and activation of a response that includes, assessment of the emergency, dispatch of
the ambulances, along with a well trained Emergency Medical Technician to render quality
pre-hospital care and transport of the patient to the appropriate health care facility.

Today, 108 is synonymous with the best-in-class emergency service and has been acknowledged as the
most efficient, speedy, reliable, and caring service provider in its category.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Is the Belle+ device really free?
Yes — the Belle+ pendant comes free with our $29.95/month monitoring subscription. There are no
upfront device costs, no activation fees, and no contracts. You can cancel anytime.
Does it work without a home phone or WiFi?
Yes. The Belle+ has a built-in Verizon 4G LTE SIM and works anywhere there is cellular coverage in
the United States — no landline, internet, or smartphone required.
How does fall detection work?
The pendant uses motion sensors and an algorithm to detect sudden drops or impacts consistent with a
fall. When triggered, it automatically connects to a 24/7 care specialist who will check on the user
and dispatch help if needed — no button press required.
Can it be worn in the shower?
Yes. The Belle+ is rated IP67 — showerproof and water-resistant. We recommend wearing it 24/7 since
the bathroom is the most common location for senior falls.
What happens when the button is pressed?
The pendant immediately calls our US-based 24/7 monitoring center over 4G LTE. A care specialist
speaks with the user through the pendant's speaker, locates them via GPS/WiFi, and dispatches
emergency services or contacts family members based on the situation and the user's medical profile
on file.
What if the device gets damaged?
We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee and one free replacement if the device is found defective.
After that, replacement devices are available for $129.95.
How long does shipping take?
Free shipping arrives in 2–5 business days. The device comes pre-activated with a Verizon SIM card
already installed — just charge it and put it on.

### FAQ's

Find quick answers to common questions about setting up and using the Family1st GPS Tracker. This
section covers everything from device features to monitoring and alerts, helping you maximize the
effectiveness of your GPS tracking experience.

How can I track my vehicle or teen driver using the Family1st GPS Tracker?

You can monitor your vehicle or teen driver in real-time using the Family1st Pro app. This app
allows you to view trip & travel history, driving habits, and get instant alerts on your device.

What are Geofences and how do they work?

Geofences are virtual boundaries that you can set up around a certain location. When you opt to
receive Geofence alerts and create virtual boundaries, you will receive alerts whenever the GPS
tracker enters or quits these predefined areas, helping you to monitor movements more effectively.

Can I monitor driving behaviors with the Family1st GPS Tracker?

Yes, our GPS tracker provides a detailed, customizable trip report, which can be downloaded as well.
These insights can help you identify the route taken.

What is included in the Track history?

The Track History displays the route taken and the speed at which the vehicle was driven. The
history for this report does not exceed 30 days.

What alerts and notifications will I get?

You can customize and set up various alerts such as battery level, function key and geofence
directly through the Family1st Pro app. The process is user-friendly and can be tailored to meet
your specific monitoring needs.

What app is used for this tracker? How do I get a username and password?

You will have to download the “Family1st Pro” app on your iOS and Android devices. The username and
password will be the same used at the time of activation.

What support options are available if I need help with my Family1st GPS Tracker?

Family1st offers 24/7 email customer support at [sup][10][port.gps@family1st.io][11] along with a
comprehensive knowledge base and FAQ section on our website. For phone support, you can call between
Monday and Friday, 9:00 a.m. and 5 p.m. PT, at [+1 855-462-7819][12].

### FAQ's

Find quick answers to common questions about setting up and using the Family1st GPS Tracker. This
section covers everything from device features to monitoring and alerts, helping you maximize the
effectiveness of your GPS tracking experience.

How can I track my vehicle or teen driver using the Family1st GPS Tracker?

You can monitor your vehicle or teen driver in real-time using the Family1st Pro app. This app
allows you to view trip & travel history, driving habits, and get instant alerts on your device.

What are Geofences and how do they work?

Geofences are virtual boundaries that you can set up around a certain location. When you opt to
receive Geofence alerts and create virtual boundaries, you will receive alerts whenever the GPS
tracker enters or quits these predefined areas, helping you to monitor movements more effectively.

Can I monitor driving behaviors with the Family1st GPS Tracker?

Yes, our GPS tracker provides a detailed, customizable trip report, which can be downloaded as well.
These insights can help you identify the route taken.

What is included in the Track history?

The Track History displays the route taken and the speed at which the vehicle was driven. The
history for this report does not exceed 30 days.

What alerts and notifications will I get?

You can customize and set up various alerts such as battery level, function key and geofence
directly through the Family1st Pro app. The process is user-friendly and can be tailored to meet
your specific monitoring needs.

What app is used for this tracker? How do I get a username and password?

You will have to download the “Family1st Pro” app on your iOS and Android devices. The username and
password will be the same used at the time of activation.

What support options are available if I need help with my Family1st GPS Tracker?

Family1st offers 24/7 email customer support at [sup][10][port.gps@family1st.io][11] along with a
comprehensive knowledge base and FAQ section on our website. For phone support, you can call between
Monday and Friday, 9:00 a.m. and 5 p.m. PT, at [+1 855-462-7819][12].

Introducing The

Tranquil GPS Watch

This best-in-class device supports the elderly and people with dementia to live more independently. Rest easy knowing they’re safe, with its SOS call button and 24/7 GPS tracking. The watch also has two-way calling with auto-answer, so you can reach them any time.

Know where they are

anytime, anywhere.

The Tranquil GPS watch connects to a mobile app, so you can check that your loved one is somewhere safe, and get alerted if they’re not.

Prevent wandering with safe zone alerts

The Tranquil watch connects to a beacon in your loved one’s home, and can alert you as soon as they leave the house.

You can also create safe zones, and receive an alert when they leave or enter these areas.

Instant Alerts when they leave home or any safe area

Never Miss An Emergency be notified by call, app or email

Custom Size ‘Safe Zones’ with boundaries adjustable to your needs

Customized Names of each location (e.g. home, day center)

Beautifully designed,

available in 3 styles

The Tranquil watch blends function with fashion. The slim, elegant design is streamlined and modern, with colors to suit every taste.

It has a comfortable and durable leather strap, with the clock face edged in stainless steel.

To the untrained eye, it’s a beautiful watch. But to you, it’s the gift of freedom and security .

FREE Locking strap,

The Tranquil watch includes a free tamper-proof locking strap that can only be removed with a special key.

This reduces the concern your loved one may lose or discard the watch, saving money on unnecessary replacements.

Speak with them any time they're lost, in danger or disoriented

The Tranquil watch’s SOS button with two-way speakerphone and auto-answer means they can call you, or you can call them any time.

This means they can reach out in an emergency, or you can guide them back to safety and offer comfort until help arrives.

Bath, shower or swim
with no worries

The Tranquil watch is protected from being submerged in water up to 3.2ft (1m) for up to 30 minutes.

This means you don’t need to worry about the watch being water damaged day to day.

An extra long battery life removes the stress of daily charging and the worry that the watch will stop working when you need it most.

Our incredible battery technology means that the Tranquil watch lasts up to 28x longer than any other GPS tracker for the elderly on the market.

This means you can safely and conveniently schedule device charging during family or caregiver visits.

I highly recommend this product and service to anyone who has a loved one that wanders. It’s potentially life saving.”

This company have created a reliable gps tracking device that will be the difference between home and safe or not. i knew when i looked at their website that this company was different.”

“

There for you when you need us

We know that caring for an older relative doesn’t stop on the weekends, that’s why our customer support team is available 7 days a week.

Need help? Call 1-800-467-1494

Still have questions?

Do I need a smartphone?

The wearer of the Tranquil GPS watch does not need a smartphone . The watch has its own built-in cellular connection.
A smartphone is only required to use our mobile app, allowing you to see the wearer’s location, receive safety alerts and more!

Can I return it?

You certainly can!
We’re so confident that the Tranquil Watch will deliver the care and peace of mind that you’re looking for, you can try it for 30 days and return it for FREE with a full refund if it’s not right for you!

How does the subscription work?

GPS watches with call functions need to access cellular data to work correctly.
Like your cell phone needs credit or a data plan, your subscription fee covers the cost of a network connection.
The subscription also includes unlimited, lightning-fast tech support and customer service that’s available 7 days a week.
You can choose from a monthly or annual subscription plan above, which can be cancelled any time!

Do you offer support with setup?

Absolutely! Our setup videos are sent to your inbox and guide you through every step from getting started to daily use.
Our expert team is on hand 7 days a week to assist with any queries you have after your purchase. We’re here to help.

How long does the battery last?

Unlike other GPS trackers for seniors, the tranquil watch uses state-of-the-art technology that means it will last an average of a week without needing a recharge .
The device updates its location every 2 minutes when moving and has an ’emergency tracking mode’ where it updates every 30 seconds, for if they ever go missing.
This is based on normal daily use, with the wearer going out of the home for a few hours per day.

What’s the range?

The Tranquil GPS watch can be tracked from anywhere in the world , as long as your smartphone has an internet connection.
The watch will work anywhere in the USA wherever there is cell coverage.

Is it waterproof?

Yes, the Tranquil GPS watch is IP67 level waterproof meaning it can be completely submerged in up to 1m (3.2ft) of water for up to 30 minutes.
It doesn’t have to be removed for showering, bathing or swimming.

How do I charge it?

Your Tranquil watch includes a charging cradle. Simply plug this into a wall outlet and rest the watch on the cradle to charge.
A light will let you know that it is charging. It takes less than 2 hours for the battery to fully recharge.

Why is it more expensive than other GPS trackers?

The quality, performance and design is far better than anything else on the market.
Battery Life: Lasting 7 days vs 1 day means you can relax without the worry the battery will die when you need it most.
Waterproofness: It can be worn in the bath, shower or pool with no worries about damage.
Design: The sleek look and feel means your loved one is much more likely to be happy wearing it.
There is a 30 day risk-free trial, so why not give it a try? You have nothing to lose !

Can you afford to wait?

Have you been worried about your loved one while browsing this site?

Try the Tranquil watch risk-free and start enjoying the peace of mind that comes with knowing that they’re safe.

# About SafeElderCare

## Who We Are

safeeldercare.com is an independent comparison and review site for senior safety devices, run by
Lawrence Tan. Lawrence spent months researching medical alert systems, fall detection watches, and
GPS trackers after an elderly parent experienced a fall at home. He discovered how overwhelming,
confusing, and time-consuming that research process can be for adult children and caregivers who are
already managing a stressful situation.

What started as a personal spreadsheet of device comparisons became safeeldercare.com: a resource
designed to save other families from going through the same struggle.

## Our Mission

Our mission is simple: **help adult children and caregivers find the right safety device for their
elderly parent, without spending hours lost in technical specifications and marketing claims.**

We understand that when you are searching for a medical alert system or fall detection device, you
are worried about someone you love. You do not need more confusion. You need clear, honest guidance
that matches real situations to real solutions.

## What We Cover

safeeldercare.com covers four main product categories:
* **Medical alert systems** – wearable pendants and home units that connect seniors to emergency
monitoring services around the clock
* **Fall detection watches** – smartwatches and wristbands with automatic fall detection sensors
that can call for help without the wearer pressing a button
* **Automatic pill dispensers** – devices that manage medication schedules and remind seniors to
take the correct dose at the correct time
* **GPS watches for seniors** – location-tracking devices designed to help caregivers monitor the
whereabouts of seniors living with dementia or memory conditions

## Our Approach

We take a **scenario-first** approach to our recommendations. Rather than simply listing technical
specifications, we ask: what situation is this family actually dealing with?

A senior who lives alone in an apartment has different needs from one who lives on a rural property
and spends time outdoors. A family managing early-stage dementia needs different features from one
whose main concern is fall risk after a hip replacement. We match devices to those real-world
situations rather than simply ranking them by price or star rating.

Our reviews and comparisons are based on:
* Independent research into product features, pricing, and contract terms
* Analysis of publicly available customer reviews and feedback
* Caregiver-perspective evaluation – we ask whether we would trust this device for our own parent
* Ongoing monitoring of product updates, pricing changes, and service quality

## What We Are Not

We want to be completely transparent about what safeeldercare.com is and is not:
* We are **not** a manufacturer or retailer of any product we review
* We are **not** an insurance company or healthcare provider
* We are **not** affiliated with or employed by any brand we cover
* We are **purely** an independent review and comparison site

We earn revenue through affiliate commissions when readers click links and make purchases. This
allows us to keep the site free to use. These commissions do not influence our recommendations. See
our Affiliate Disclosure page for full details.

## Get in Touch

We would love to hear from you, whether you have a question about a product, a suggestion for a
review, or feedback on our content.

Contact us at: lawrence@safeeldercare.com

## Editorial Policies

SafeElderCare.com is accessible worldwide. Our product recommendations focus primarily on devices
and services available in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia. We note
regional availability within individual reviews where relevant.

We are committed to accuracy. If you believe any information on this site is incorrect, please
contact us at lawrence@safeeldercare.com with the subject line “Content Correction”. We aim to
review all factual correction requests within 48 hours and publish updates within 7 days where
warranted.

SafeElderCare does not currently offer a mobile app, but all reviews are fully mobile-optimised and
accessible on any device. We publish new product reviews within 2–4 weeks of a product launch and
update existing reviews quarterly to reflect pricing and specification changes. Pricing data on all
review pages is checked and updated monthly — affiliate links reflect current pricing at the time of
click.

We review and update our product comparisons on a rolling basis as new devices launch, pricing
changes, or service terms are updated. Our goal is to review each product category at minimum once
per quarter.

## About Us

# PROFESSIONAL AMBULANCE & MEDICAL EMERGENCY SERVICE PROVIDER IN INDIA
* [Home][30]
* [About Us][31]

## OUR STORY

In 2005, Ziqitza Health Care Limited was founded by a group of young professionals - as a result of
personal experiences.

The founders realised that the difference in EMS service in India and US was the availability and
accessibility of standardized emergency medical services providers. Ziqitza recognised the need of
organised and professional ambulance providers in the country, and thus began the journey to create
the best emergency response service in India that would be on par with 911 in the U.S. and 999 in
the U.K. We realised the urgency of an organised and networked ambulance service required for saving
those lives that would have been otherwise lost, for want of timely medical attention

## OUR VISION

ZHL’s vision is to assist in saving human lives by providing a leading network of fully equipped
Advanced and Basic Life Support Ambulances across the developing world.

Our vision is reflected in our commitment to meet International standards of quality in Emergency
Medical Services and be accessible to everyone regardless of their income bracket.

## OUR VALUES

Our core values are being ethical, being transparent and fostering teamwork. Ziqitza's focus has
always been on delivering top quality services that involve saving lives, minimising anguish and
aiding in improving the patient’s outcome.

## OUR STORY

In 2005, Ziqitza Health Care Limited was founded by a group of young professionals - as a result of
personal experiences.

The founders realised that the difference in EMS service in India and US was the availability and
accessibility of standardized emergency medical services providers. Ziqitza recognised the need of
organised and professional ambulance providers in the country, and thus began the journey to create
the best emergency response service in India that would be on par with 911 in the U.S. and 999 in
the U.K. We realised the urgency of an organised and networked ambulance service required for saving
those lives that would have been otherwise lost, for want of timely medical attention

## OUR VISION

ZHL’s vision is to assist in saving human lives by providing a leading network of fully equipped
Advanced and Basic Life Support Ambulances across the developing world.

Our vision is reflected in our commitment to meet International standards of quality in Emergency
Medical Services and be accessible to everyone regardless of their income bracket.

## OUR VALUES

Our core values are being ethical, being transparent and fostering teamwork. Ziqitza's focus has
always been on delivering top quality services that involve saving lives, minimising anguish and
aiding in improving the patient’s outcome.

For us every life matters and every second counts in saving a life. We believe that countless lives
can be saved and numerous casualties minimized, with adequate and quick medical transportation
facilities

[AMBULANCE & MEDICAL EMERGENCY SERVICES]

Medical emergency services now take the role of basic needs due to risky lifestyles. The emergency
time is the most crucial time of life. In such circumstances, a quick emergency response is needed.
We have been pioneering emergency response systems and patient transport services in India since
2005. In India, nearly 1.5 lakh people die in road accidents, which translates to 422 accidents
every day. Unfortunately, there is no specific response time for ambulances. On average, an
ambulance takes more than 45 minutes. Ziqitza assures swift response on one call. The service is
active across 60 cities.

With our international presence, we are taking our brand of commitment across the world. In India,
our footsteps are growing and we truly believe in making a positive difference in the public health
of the country. In emergency ambulance service there are ALS (Advanced Life Support), BLS (Basic
Life Support), and MICUs (Mobile Intensive Care Units) provided as per patients' criticality.
Advanced technology systems such as TMS are used for vehicles to be on track by TMS (Transport
Management System). We always look for the safety of both patients and our staff. Working for India,
providing service in every corner is our goal.

of the people of Amritsar who were affected by the train accident. The company deployed 11
ambulances which reached the spot within 12 minutes of the first call received from the sight, to
help reduce the impact of the disastrous catastrophe. The injured victims and others who were in
need of emergency help were promptly transported to the nearest hospitals.

# Championing Better Living at Any Age

## Over 5 million caregivers, older adults, and their loved ones rely on our research, reviews, and
## recommendations to guide their aging journey. Every insight we share is grounded in facts,
## hands-on testing, and a commitment to honesty.

Thank you for your inquiry

Someone will be in touch shortly

At SeniorLiving.org, our goal is for everyone to live their best life at every age! Whether you’re
exploring options for yourself, helping your partner plan for the years ahead, or caring for a
parent or loved one, one truth remains: you deserve clear, compassionate guidance that puts your
needs first.

We’re here to make that happen.

[Testing out an iPhone with my grandma][Testing out an iPhone with my grandma]

[Jeff Senior Living Testing][Jeff Senior Living Testing]

## Our Mission

SeniorLiving.org was built on a mission: to champion better living at any age. Not just through
advice, but through trustworthy, tested, and tailored information that helps you feel less uncertain
and more empowered. We help you turn confusing choices into confident living.

No more endless research. No more senior scams. Just expert-backed advice and resources created for
you.

## An Authority in the Senior Space

Our research, reviews, guides, and other resources have been featured in numerous noteworthy
publications, including:
* [“Medicare Price Hikes Would Push Majority of Seniors to Ditch Plans—Poll” – Business Insider][68]
* [“Five Ways to Ease Caregiver Stress” – Kiplinger][69]
* [This Little-noticed Update to Medicaid Rules Could Burden Seniors With Thousands in Medical Debt
– MarketWatch][70]
* [Schenectady Lawmakers Shine Light on National Caregivers Day – CBS 6 News][71]
* [Is an AARP Membership Worth It? AARP Benefits & Discounts Explained – AARP][72]

## Meet Our Team

Our professionally trained team has over 100 collective years of experience in senior care. With
their guidance and recommendations for all SeniorLiving.org content, readers can be assured that
they are receiving the best possible information and advice for seniors. Our team has hands-on
experience researching, reviewing, and testing everything from medical alert systems to senior
living options. It’s our goal to present the most unbiased, up-to-date, and useful senior resources
possible, and our team of experts plays a vital role in making that goal a reality.

### Contact Us

## Our Company

We have a passion for serving the aging community here at SeniorLiving.org. Our goal is to help
older adults and caregivers find the best senior living resources available. We’ve put everything in
one place for you; it’s never been easier to find what you’re looking for.

We know that aging comes with unique challenges. Thankfully, our compassionate [team of experts][68]
provides information on senior housing, all types of senior care facilities, and retirement
communities. We even go beyond senior housing and share all about money matters, health and care,
medical alert systems, technology for seniors, and more. We offer all of these resources free of
charge to our readers. You can learn more about our mission in the video below.

## Our People

Our company is made up of highly-qualified senior care experts. Our expert advisors are ready and
willing to help you find what you need. Now you or your loved one can live with greater independence
and peace of mind.
We’re only a phone call away! Talking with someone who truly cares about you and your situation can
make all the difference. That’s why more and more seniors and caregivers trust us to connect them
with the senior living resources that can improve their lives.

## Give Us Your Feedback!

If you liked (or didn’t like) something, feel free to let us know. We’re always trying to improve
our website to give you the best experience possible. You can call or write to us using the phone
number or email below. You can even send your feedback by snail mail! Our team is here to address
your questions, comments, or concerns. Whatever it is, we’re here to help.

**Types of Questions Our Website Can Answer:**
* Is senior housing right for me?
* How do I find senior housing in my city?
* Do any churches in my community offer senior care services?
* What does it cost to live in a retirement community in my state?
* How old do I need to be to move into a [senior apartment][69]?
* Are there any [nursing homes][70] that allow seniors to have pets?
* How do I get on a waiting list for [affordable senior housing][71] in my region?
* What do I need to do to move into a [memory care facility][72]?
* How should I [manage my finances][73] as I age?
* What are the best health insurance options for seniors?
* How can I find the [best medical alert system][74] for my needs?

And more!

## Contact Us

#### By Phone

Get in touch with us at [855-241-1699][75]. Don’t worry, it’s a toll-free senior helpline. You will
never be asked to pay for this free service that our experts provide. We’ll connect you with the
right resources without asking for anything in return. Our senior helpline is available daily from 4
am to 8 pm Pacific Daylight Time.

#### By Email

Send an email to [help@seniorliving.org][76], or fill out the form on this page.

#### By Mail

Send your letters to:
501 E. Las Olas Blvd
Ft. Lauderdale, FL 33301

Whether you call our senior hotline, email us, or send a letter in the mail, all of your information
will be kept confidential.

Please note [SeniorLiving.org][77] specializes in information regarding senior living resources. We
provide company profiles, contact details, and reviews of senior housing and senior care facilities
in the US. We do not offer medical, legal, financial, or emergency information. If you have a
medical emergency, contact 911.

[Alexandra Gavrilescu_-3][Alexandra Gavrilescu_-3]

### Alexandra Gavrilescu

Alexandra Gavrilescu has taken care of both of her grandparents on her mom's side as well as her
grandpa and has a lot of experience that can help others in the same situations. She enjoys giving
advice on Wizerlist to help others.

**Why are you giving advice on Wizerlist?**

I have experience in living and taking care of seniors because I have taken care of both my
grandparents from my mother's side. I took care of my grandpa till he died at the age of 82. It was
hard but I felt it was my duty. Now, with the support and help of my mother, I'm also taking care of
my grandma. She's only 75, but she needs our attention and care 24/7 because of some health issues
and because of her high anxiety level.

Therefore, I know many useful things about caring for seniors and I want to help others find the
right methods to do the same without forgetting about themselves. You must first take care of
yourself to be able to care for others.

**What personal experience do you have with senior living?**

As I said, I took care of my grandpa. I took him to his many doctor appointments, purchased his
meds, and finally, in his last year with us, we had to put him in a retirement home because he
suffered from dementia and he needed assisted care and specialized and professional services. I paid
for all his bills which wasn't an easy period at all. We went to visit him often but once the
pandemic hit, the place was under lockdown, and we could only see him online, on a webcam. After a
couple of months, the people there announced to us that he got infected and developed some serious
lung infection. So, they transferred him to the hospital. We went there but he couldn't make it and
he passed away soon after that. It was terrible even though he was old.

Together with my mom, I'm currently caring for my grandma who's 75 years old. She suffers from
several health conditions, including her kidney infection and urinary tract infection. She's also
extremely anxious so she cannot live on her own. But, we don't want to and cannot afford to put her
in a home, especially since she's ok mentally, despite her high anxiety. So, I'm helping my mother
to take care of her as much as I can. It's quite hard and complicated and it gets me down at times
to see how harsh old age is with people.

**If you could give people one piece of advice about living as a senior, what would it be?**

Patience and empathy are key when it comes to dealing with seniors. As they grow older, their
behavior becomes similar to the ones children have. Obviously, in the most fortunate cases, some
seniors are totally fine and they can take care of themselves, but, the majority of older
individuals need special care and attention. Also, try not to argue with them or contradict them too
much because they already have their habits well-imprinted and they cannot be changed now. Finally,
you should check their meds and make sure they take them, communicate with them, take them out for
walks, and, if you can afford it and you feel overwhelmed, you should also hire help.

[John Hughes_][John Hughes_]

### John Hughes

John Hughes thinks about the future a lot and has a lot of information to share with people. While
he might not be a senior yet, he knows it is coming and wants to prepare. Everything he learns, he
shares with the readers of Wizer List.

**Why are you giving advice on Wizer List?**

We might be young now, but old age is inevitable and it comes with its fair share of challenges.
People experience old age differently, with some maintaining good health, proper finances, and
thriving lives but it is not always this way. However, navigating through this phase of life is much
better for the people and those around them if they have the information needed to improve their
lives. This is what motivates me to give advice on Wizerlist as I try to empower seniors and those
approaching this stage of life to understand what it takes to lead a comfortable life.

**What personal experience do you have with senior living?**

I've grown up with different seniors in my life, and coincidentally they were at extreme ends of the
scale. One was thriving while another was not doing very well. As such, this stark contrast was so
bare and evident that it prompted me to find out why this was the case yet both of them seemed to

lives.

# About Tech-enhanced Life

## Why This Work Exists

Understanding how aging actually unfolds, and how technology fits into that process, takes time.
Assumptions change as experience accumulates. What seems promising at first may prove disappointing,
while other ideas reveal value only after sustained use.

Tech-enhanced Life and the Longevity Explorers exist to explore these questions thoughtfully, over
time. We focus on lived experience, reflection, and synthesis, and on sharing not just conclusions,
but how and why our thinking evolves.

## Who We Are

> We are a (virtual) community of older adults, their friends, families, and caregivers — called the
> **Longevity Explorers**. We are exploring the future of aging, and the intersection of aging and
> technology.

Our mission is to **improve the quality of life of older adults and their families.**

## What We Do
* We create **insights for older adults** (published on this website and in our Newsletter) — with
an emphasis on pushing off the day at which getting older gets in the way of living life to the
full.
* We enable, and lead the [**Longevity Explorers**][241]: a unique sharing, evaluation, and ideation
community— made up of older adults (in their 60’s, 70’s, 80’s and 90’s), and their
friends, families, and caregivers.
* Sometimes, the community of Longevity Explorers also provide **advisory services for companies** —
who want to develop products and services that older adults actually want, need, and will pay a
premium for.

### The Underlying Idea

We believe that there is huge potential for development of clever new products and services that
will greatly improve the quality of life of all of us as we age.

**Unfortunately, all too often the people who understand the problems, and the people who could
solve those problems, inhabit different worlds.**

We wanted to bring these groups together and work collaboratively to identify and / or help create
new solutions to the challenge of living longer, with higher functionality — at costs that are
affordable to individuals and to nations.

# Get Advice: How to Proceed

We are happy to chat about whatever you would like.

If you would like to ask questions, or get a call scheduled with to discuss whatever you are working
on, go ahead and fill out the short set of questions, including your contact details, by clicking on
the link below.

[Fill out your details.][243]

### Some Guidelines

If all you want is some free advice, that is fine. But if that is what you want, please just say so.

If you want to learn more about what we do so you can decide if we can help your company, that is
fine too.

If you want to brainstorm about a specific project, and get to know how we think and approach
things, we love that sort of stuff.

**If you just want to pitch your product, but are not clear why, that is not so interesting.**

**The more specific you can be about what sort of help you are hoping for, the more likely we are to
have a productive interaction.**

# Archives: Solutions

Solution or potential solution to a "problem"

## [Reading Light for Vision Problems][241]

A chairside floor lamp with a long adjustable gooseneck including a handheld remote with brightness
and warmness for bright white to warm yellow light is a good solution for reading when you have
vision imperfections.

## [The Senior Moment Alexa Skill can remember this for your mother][242]

[ [The Senior Moment Alexa Skill can remember this for your mother] ][243]

One of the great things about Alexa is that she never gets tired of answering the same question. The
Alexa SkillSenior Moment may be the perfect fit for your mother's ATM location question. You can ask
the Skill to remember the perfect answer to that question. Then all your mother has to say
is, ***"Alexa, open Senior Moment."***

## [My Calls: an Alexa Skill for Coordinating Calls][244]

This Alexa skill helps your family members plan their calls so they reach you at times that are
convenient for you.

## [Instant Remote Music Playing][245]

Here is another solution that keeps your Alexa account and that of your parents separate, but still
allows you to start music in the house / room of a person with dementia when you want.

## [Using Alexa Routines to Translate the “How Long” Request][246]

This solution shows how to use Alexa Routines to answer the “Alexa, how long until lunch?” type
questions.

## [Remote Control for the Smoke Alarm][247]

If you, or your remote loved one, is capable of handling a mobile phone app under stressful
conditions, some smoke alarm providers such as Nest allow you to use the app to silence it.

IF… you can find your phone, unlock it, and open the app all during this stressful time.

## [Remote Control of the Other Person’s Camera for Video Call][248]

Don’t you wish you could adjust their camera so they don’t move out of the field of view during Zoom
calls? Well, you can.

## [Alexa Helps Me Recover My Memories][249]

As we age, we tend to forget not only where we leave physical items or upcoming events, but also
important memories such as names, past events, and locations. I found ways Alexa can help with that.

# About Us

## **Who We Are**

Since 2009 Medical Alert Advice has helped thousands of people make informed decisions for
themselves and the ones they love by providing clear, accurate, and easy to read information about
medical alert systems. Since we’ve been reviewing medical alert systems for so many years, we have
the experience and knowledge that you can only gain over time.

As we look back over our decade plus years, we’ve seen the medical alert industry evolve from simple
push-button pendant systems that required a telephone landline, to the introduction of early fall

# About Us

## **Who We Are**

Since 2009 Medical Alert Advice has helped thousands of people make informed decisions for
themselves and the ones they love by providing clear, accurate, and easy to read information about
medical alert systems. Since we’ve been reviewing medical alert systems for so many years, we have
the experience and knowledge that you can only gain over time.

As we look back over our decade plus years, we’ve seen the medical alert industry evolve from simple
push-button pendant systems that required a telephone landline, to the introduction of early fall
detection systems, and finally to today’s GPS smart-watch based devices with telehealth technologies
and GPS location services built right in.

## *“If you are interested and/or in need of purchasing a medical alert device system for yourself
## or a family member, check out the legitimate companies ratings/reviews
## at **medicalalertadvice.com.”*

**Bucks County PA Consumer Protection** August 7, 2018 *Trouble Shooter: Medical Alert Scam
Targeting Bucks County Seniors* [Bucks County Currier Times – phillyburbs.com][15]

During our first few years, we found that it would be difficult for the average person to get all
the facts needed to make an informed decision on such an important service. There was really only
one company back in 2009, [LifeStation][16], that had pricing and online ordering right on their
website.

That meant that they had to have fixed pricing and had to provide quite a bit of transparency. That
was refreshing since most other companies required you to call to get information and you had to
know what to ask and what the correct answer would be in order know you were being told the truth.
Knowing what to ask made all the difference and that’s what made Medical Alert Advice different than
the few other sites you could have come across. You were almost always dealing with high-pressure
commission-based sales people that only had one goal in mind – to sell you a medical alert system.

Today, not only have the systems themselves evolved, but so has the sales process. Most companies
now provide fixed pricing with online ordering. But with the complexity of today’s systems, it’s
actually best to call to be sure you’re getting what you really need. Many phone reps are still
commissioned based, but they typically provide good information and can many times give you extras
like waive activation fees, provide free lock boxes, and free shipping.

## Our Team Members

### Noelle Greenway

[Noelle Greenway Headshot]Our content and social media manager, [Noelle Greenway][17], comes with a
specialty in the health, wellness and senior care industries.

She had been working with Medical Alert Advice since 2013, so she has years of experience evaluating
and writing [medical alert system reviews][18] and has personally researched dozens of medical alert
systems. Noelle graduated from Florida State University with a degree in Psychology.

After helping start-up medical brand [DentalPlans.com][19] grow into an industry leader, she
branched out on her own and started her own business. Since then, she has helped several health and
wellness companies build their brands online such as Queen City Elder Care, Doctor Aromas and The
Yoga Sanctuary.

### Haley Burress

[Haley Burress Headshot] With more than 10 years of experience working in national and local
leadership positions in senior living communities, [Haley Burress][20] is more than just a
knowledgeable writer. Haley currently writes full-time for organizations that serve older adults,
professional and family caregivers, and other vulnerable populations and has been working with
Medical Alert Advice since 2019.

Haley has worked in all levels of senior care: independent living, assisted living, memory care, and
skilled nursing. Once she began writing full-time, she has been able to publish resource books for
senior living professionals as well as to write content and training curriculum for vulnerable
populations and the caregivers who serve them. Haley has a B.S. in Public Health Care Administration
and a Master in Recreation Therapy Administration.

Who better to edit our content than long-time industry veterans from the life safety and electronic
security industry like [Pat Shepherd][21] and others. Their experience in the design and support of
fire, panic, and burglar alarm systems along with working with in-house and outsourced monitoring
centers gives us a unique perspective not had by other sites.

So rest assured that we intimately understand what central station receivers are and how they
operate, what languages (Contact ID and SIA) your medical alert system “speaks” when communicating
to the monitoring center, the difference between fully redundant monitoring centers and back-up only
centers, how signals are transmitted from your medical alert device through a cellular network as
compared to landline phone service, and so much more.

## Our Review Guidelines

To learn more about how we rank medical alert providers and our star rating system, please see [Our
Review Guidelines][22] to learn more.

We sincerely hope you find our reviews, product comparisons, and tips helpful, as thousands of
others have through the years, and we would [love to hear][23] how Medical Alert Advice has helped
you in your decision process. *The Medical Alert Advice Team*

# Contact Us

## If you would like to contact Medical Alert Advice, please us the form below.

### We’d love to know if our website has helped you in your search for medical alert monitoring
### services!

Before you contact us, please understand that **we are *not* a medical alert company**, only a
website that reviews medical alert systems, so we *cannot* help you with things like:
1. Service issues
2. Service Cancellations
3. Billing issues
4. Marketing calls (we don’t make outbound phone calls)

### If you have any of the above issues please contact your service provider directly by calling the
### number on your invoice, the number on your device, or the number on your original paperwork that
### came with your system. You can also find [contact information][15] for medical alert companies
### in our [FAQ section][16].

For questions about whether Medicare, Medicaid, or private health insurance will cover a medical
alert system, please see this resource [Will Medicare/Medicaid Pay for a Medical Alert Device][17]
and contact the [medical alert companies][18] you are most interested in *directly* for more
information.

## **Best-in-Class** Protection. Everyday Peace of Mind.

Our members say the best thing about MedicAlert is knowing we have their back in an emergency. See
how we go above and beyond to keep you safe when the unexpected happens.

[ Get Started ][93]

### 24/7 Emergency Protection

Our US-based team is **always here** to work with first responders to get you the best possible
care.

### Comprehensive Health Record

To provide a full picture of you, we **securely store vital health info** - beyond what’s engraved
on your ID.

### Family Notification

We personally **call your loved ones in an emergency**, so they can be there when you need them
most.

### Store Important Documents

Quick access to **things that matter to you** like your treatment plan, DNR or advanced directives,
living will & more.

### Safe & Found™

If your loved one wanders due to autism or dementia, **we work with local authorities** to get them
home safely.

### Most Recognized Medical ID

First responders are trained to look for MedicAlert IDs. We’re **known and trusted** by emergency
professionals worldwide.

[Everyday Hero]

## Honor Our Everyday Heroes

The Everyday Heroes initiative is a tribute to the selfless courage and swift actions of first
responders who work tirelessly to protect and save lives. Learn how MedicAlert supports first
responders and the vital role they play in emergencies.

Join the movement and share your story.
[Learn More ][94]

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Medicalert is a nonprofit organization dedicated to enhancing safety and health outcomes through its range of medical identification products and services. Offering a variety of medical IDs, including bracelets, necklaces, and QR code IDs, the company caters to diverse needs across different demographics, including women, men, and children. With a commitment to providing 24/7 emergency response and support, Medicalert aims to ensure that individuals with medical conditions receive prompt and accurate care in emergencies.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Medscope, a division of Medical Guardian, specializes in providing Personal Emergency Response Systems (PERS) and Engagement Services tailored for Medicaid partners and their members. The company offers a range of innovative products, including wearable devices, mobile units, and home-based systems, designed to enhance safety and support for older adults, individuals with chronic conditions, and people with disabilities. With a focus on delivering discreet protection and reliable emergency assistance, Medscope is committed to improving the quality of life for its target markets through advanced technology and dedicated services.

Wrist Wearable PERS

###### CATCH FALLS AS THEY HAPPEN****

**Mobile PERS** (Necklace or Belt Clip)

Whether indoors or out, at home or away, this “go anywhere” device with enhanced GPS and Fall
Detection can summon help to your location anywhere in the United States. Pressing the alert button
on this small, lightweight, device activates clear, two-way voice communication with our 24/7
monitoring center. The self-contained, 1.3 oz. device is worn as a pendant or clipped to a belt.

For use indoors or out, at home or away

Up to 6 days of battery life

Fall detection capabilities

Water-resistant for use in the shower

[Home Device][Home Device]

###### SAFE & SECURE IN YOUR HOME****

**Home PERS** (with Wearable Help Button)

Our home-based PERS devices connect using a cellular connection or a traditional landline phone jack
and electrical outlet. Pressing the pendant or wristband alert button initiates an emergency call to
our 24/7/365 monitoring center. Our 9-1-1 certified response operators establish two-way voice
communication, then assess the emergency and notify appropriate responders.

Activation range of 1,400 feet through walls, doors and windows

32-hour battery backup in case of power outage

Your choice of pendant, wristband or Fall Detection help button

Water-resistant help buttons for the shower

###### SAFETY NEVER LOOKED SO SMART****

**Smartwatch PERS**

Meet the MG**Move** smartwatch, our latest innovation designed to keep you safe and connected
wherever you go. Effortlessly plan your day with real-time weather updates and stay active with
intuitive step-counting features. Set your goals, track your progress, and embrace every moment with
confidence and ease.

For use indoors or out, at home or away

Local, real-time weather updates

Fall detection capabilities

Water-resistant for use in the shower

**Who We Are**

**MedScope** is a division of **Medical Guardian** dedicated to serving Medicaid partners and their
members. We pride ourselves on being the leading provider of Personal Emergency Response Systems &
Engagement Services for Long-Term Services & Support (LTSS) and Home-Based Community Services
(HBCS). With over 25 years of experience across 47 states, our dedicated team tailors every solution
to meet the unique needs of each organization while upholding the highest standards of quality care.

Our commitment to excellence is evident in our diverse device selection and proactive approach. We
keep care managers connected at every stage—from initial installation and real-time monitoring to
ongoing support—empowering them to deliver exceptional, personalized care that helps members remain
safe and independent at home.

**Benefits to Our Partners & Their Members**

**Faster Installations & Response Times**

90% of members are set up within 5 days, with 95% of emergency calls answered in under 3 seconds—the
fastest in the industry, providing peace of mind.

**Best-in-Class Device Selection**

GPS-enabled fall detection, mobile PERS, and the latest MG**Mini** Lite and MG**Move** wearables
(with a 7-day battery) ensure members have access to the best safety technology.

**Zero Hidden Fees**

Partners benefit from transparent pricing, $0 installation, and free device replacements, ensuring
predictable costs for programs and no unexpected fees for members.

**Advanced Compliance & Security**

One of the only PERS providers meeting HIPAA, SOC 2, and PCI standards, ensuring partners stay
compliant while protecting sensitive member data.

**Care Manager Portal**

Real-time referral tracking and reporting simplifies case management, making Medicaid program
oversight easier and more efficient for partners.

**Multilingual Support**

200+ languages covered, helping partners serve diverse member populations while ensuring every
member gets clear, accessible communication.

###### PROTECTION EVERYWHERE YOU GO****

Wrist Wearable PERS

Designed with the wearer in mind, the Mini Lite is our lightest, smallest, and most comfortable

fall detection capabilities, keeping you covered at-home or on-the-go!

For use indoors or out, at home or away

Fall detection capabilities

[START YOUR ONLINE MEMBER REFERRAL][16]

###### CATCH FALLS AS THEY HAPPEN****

**Mobile PERS** (Necklace or Belt Clip)

Whether indoors or out, at home or away, this “go anywhere” device with enhanced GPS and Fall
Detection can summon help to your location anywhere in the United States. Pressing the alert button
on this small, lightweight, device activates clear, two-way voice communication with our 24/7
monitoring center. The self-contained, 1.3 oz. device is worn as a pendant or clipped to a belt.

For use indoors or out, at home or away

Up to 6 days of battery life

Fall detection capabilities

Water-resistant for use in the shower

[Home Device][Home Device]

###### SAFE & SECURE IN YOUR HOME****

**Home PERS** (with Wearable Help Button)

Our home-based PERS devices connect using a cellular connection or a traditional landline phone jack
and electrical outlet. Pressing the pendant or wristband alert button initiates an emergency call to
our 24/7/365 monitoring center. Our 9-1-1 certified response operators establish two-way voice
communication, then assess the emergency and notify appropriate responders.

Activation range of 1,400 feet through walls, doors and windows

32-hour battery backup in case of power outage

Your choice of pendant, wristband or Fall Detection help button

Water-resistant help buttons for the shower

###### SAFETY NEVER LOOKED SO SMART****

**Smartwatch PERS**

Meet the MG**Move** smartwatch, our latest innovation designed to keep you safe and connected
wherever you go. Effortlessly plan your day with real-time weather updates and stay active with
intuitive step-counting features. Set your goals, track your progress, and embrace every moment with
confidence and ease.

For use indoors or out, at home or away

Local, real-time weather updates

Fall detection capabilities

Water-resistant for use in the shower

**Who We Are**

**MedScope** is a division of **Medical Guardian** dedicated to serving Medicaid partners and their
members. We pride ourselves on being the leading provider of Personal Emergency Response Systems &
Engagement Services for Long-Term Services & Support (LTSS) and Home-Based Community Services
(HBCS). With over 25 years of experience across 47 states, our dedicated team tailors every solution
to meet the unique needs of each organization while upholding the highest standards of quality care.

Our commitment to excellence is evident in our diverse device selection and proactive approach. We
keep care managers connected at every stage—from initial installation and real-time monitoring to
ongoing support—empowering them to deliver exceptional, personalized care that helps members remain
safe and independent at home.

**Benefits to Our Partners & Their Members**

**Faster Installations & Response Times**

90% of members are set up within 5 days, with 95% of emergency calls answered in under 3 seconds—the
fastest in the industry, providing peace of mind.

**Best-in-Class Device Selection**

GPS-enabled fall detection, mobile PERS, and the latest MG**Mini** Lite and MG**Move** wearables
(with a 7-day battery) ensure members have access to the best safety technology.

**Zero Hidden Fees**

Partners benefit from transparent pricing, $0 installation, and free device replacements, ensuring
predictable costs for programs and no unexpected fees for members.

**Advanced Compliance & Security**

One of the only PERS providers meeting HIPAA, SOC 2, and PCI standards, ensuring partners stay
compliant while protecting sensitive member data.

**Care Manager Portal**

Real-time referral tracking and reporting simplifies case management, making Medicaid program
oversight easier and more efficient for partners.

**Multilingual Support**

200+ languages covered, helping partners serve diverse member populations while ensuring every
member gets clear, accessible communication.

# About SafeHome.org

Learn About Our Goals, Our Vision, and Our Mission

[Page Hero Image]

## Your Trusted Authority on Home and Personal Security

Learning about home and personal safety doesn’t have to be complicated. At SafeHome.org, we simplify
the search for safety products by providing people with comprehensive comparisons and easy-to-read
research on the latest technologies and tools available. With over 50 years of combined experience,
our experts spend countless hours compiling safety data so that you can choose security solutions
confidently and decisively.

Featured In
[Section Content Image 18447]

## Easily Accessible Information

We always strive to streamline this safety information and share our findings honestly and
objectively. Our commitment is to provide you with convenient and reasonable recommendations.
Whether you’re searching for smart home security systems, video doorbells, or identity theft
protection, we know these products and services inside out. Let us research and recommend a home or
personal safety solution for you, so you can rest assured knowing your family can sleep safe and
sound.

Learning about the latest security products and trends just got a whole lot easier.
[Section Content Image 17866]

## Our History

Our company launched in 2016 after both founders nearly fell victim to home burglaries. We felt
vulnerable and defenseless, and we wanted our families to feel safe again. At that point, searching
for home security systems online only yielded disorganized information from inexperienced
enthusiasts. In our experience, door-to-door security salespeople pushed expensive packages that
didn’t match our needs. We believed there was a better way to learn about home security trends,
products, and services, so we set out to create it ourselves.

Equipped with detailed spreadsheets, product comparisons, and other insightful resources, we built a
website focused on in-depth research and honest advice from security experts. Our mission is clear:
help everyday people navigate the overwhelming world of home security. We utilized new technologies
to originate innovative tools that make finding the right security and safety options simple. We
even developed a proprietary scoring system called [SecureScore™][63] and expanded SafeHome.org into
other safety and security categories. Overall, our vision is to become the premier source for
reliable and trustworthy advice on security and safety.

## A Little About Me

Hi there! My name is Rob Gabriele, and I’m the in-house home security and safety expert for
SafeHome.org.

I hold a Master’s of Science degree, and I’ve been working in home security for a half decade now. I

alert systems.

# About

## What We Do

SENIORS BULLETIN was created on the straightforward notion that it is feasible to give great
solution as well as great care to all those who want to keep living life simply and stress-free.
SENIORS BULLETIN provides information to seniors and caregivers with the intent for them to make the
best informed decision. We are dedicated in giving best-in-class solutions. SENIORS BULLETIN is
constantly available and also happy to answer any kind of questions or concerns. To learn more, call
us.

## Who We Are

SENIORS BULLETIN is a diversified health and well-being affiliate company focused on improving
people’s lives through meaningful innovation in the area of healthcare and personal care via medical
alert systems.

SENIORS BULLETIN serves many subscribers, and continues to help customers obtain meaningful and
advanced healthcare and personal care solutions. We help individuals and families lead a more
comfortable, confident life. That is our mission.

# About SeniorsList

## Our Mission

SeniorsList exists to help older adults and their families make confident, informed decisions about
the products and services that affect their daily lives. We believe every senior deserves access to
clear, honest, and expert-vetted information — free from hidden agendas.

From medical alert systems and hearing aids to Medicare plans and home care providers, we research,
test, and review the options that matter most so you don't have to sift through marketing hype on
your own.

## What Sets Us Apart

Too many review sites accept pay-for-placement deals or rehash manufacturer spec sheets. We take a
different approach:
* **Independent editorial:** Affiliate partnerships never influence our ratings or which products we
recommend.
* **Hands-on testing:** Every product review is based on real-world use, not just specification
sheets.
* **Expert credentials:** Our writers hold certifications in senior care, health technology, and
gerontology.

## Our Team

SeniorsList is built by a small, dedicated team of writers, researchers, and advocates who are
passionate about improving the lives of older adults.

### Sarah Mitchell

Editor-in-Chief

Sarah brings over 15 years of experience in senior care advocacy and editorial leadership. A
Certified Senior Advisor (CSA) and former family caregiver, she ensures every piece of content meets
the highest standards of accuracy and compassion.

### David Chen

Senior Writer

David specializes in health technology and insurance topics. With a background in health sciences
research, he helps readers navigate complex decisions about medical devices, coverage options, and
emerging tech for older adults.

### Rachel Torres

Product Reviewer

Rachel personally purchases and tests every product we review, from medical alert systems to hearing
aids. Her hands-on approach and gerontology training ensure our recommendations reflect real-world
performance.

Have a question or want to get in touch? Visit our [contact page][16] or read our [editorial
guidelines][17] to learn more about how we work.

# When Seconds Matter, Bay Alarm Medical Delivers

Bay Alarm Medical is committed to providing fast and reliable 24/7 emergency response services to
help seniors and families stay safe and independent. We promise to be there in any crisis and aim to
turn emergencies into manageable moments of care and support.

[Image][Image]
[Image][Image]
Mission, Vision & Core Values

## Our Commitment to You

#### Our Mission

Delivering peace of mind to families and their loved ones at every stage of aging.

#### Our Vision

Helping families love longer, laugh longer, live longer.

#### Our Core Values

Commitment to our customers: To always C.A.R.E. (Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Ethics)
and to give our customers everything they need and none of the extra gimmicks that they don’t.

To ensure that all of our services and policies are designed to protect our customers and to treat
our customers as if they were our own loved ones. To protect customer data and personal information,
and to make our customer’s well being and safety a top priority.

Commitment to our company: To employ caring and ethical individuals who treat our business as though
it is their own. To roll up our sleeves and work hard to support the company initiatives and to
embrace change. To support company growth without compromising integrity and to always deliver more
than expected.

Commitment to our employees: To maintain an open-door policy and to always be honest. To be
supportive of our employee’s growth and career paths. To be respectful and to invest in our
employees so they can be successful here and hopefully in all areas of life.

Company History

## How We Got Started

Founded in 1946 by Marj and Everett Westphal (pictured), Bay Alarm had a straightforward goal: work
diligently, maintain honesty, treat everyone like family, and provide top-notch service. Throughout
the decades, the Westphal family has stayed dedicated to nurturing Bay Alarm and it’s subsidaries,
caring for its workforce, and safeguarding its clients. Now, their grandson Matt Westphal leads Bay
Alarm Medical as its owner and CEO.

[Image][Image]
OUR LEGACY

The Westphal family launches a dedicated medical alert company.
