# Compact Response Unit (CRU)

The BluePoint **Compact Response Unit ****(CRU)** is a customizable, pre-fabricated emergency
activation system designed to provide instant alerts and faster response times. Engineered for
flexibility, this unit offers tailored aesthetics to meet the unique safety needs of any
environment. With **one-touch activation**, the full power of Command & Control (C2) is unleashed.

[CONTACT US TO LEARN MORE][28]

**BluePoint Strobe:**

Notifies all occupants of a building to take precautions through strobe lights and audio messaging.

**BluePoint Command & Control (C2):**

Includes 2-way communication portal, building floorplan, and live security camera access.

**BluePoint Police Alert Pull Station:**

Automatically alerts building admin and police, relaying critical emergency details.

**BluePoint Medical Alert Pull Station:**

Automatically alerts building admin and medical first responders of an emergency.

## Smaller Size. Maximum Impact. Faster Response.

**Compact Response Units (CRU)** provides immediate, automatic and simultaneous notification to
stakeholders and first responders, significantly reducing the time it takes to get first responders
on site.

#### Familiar + Intuitive

Similar in appearance and function to the universal pull station, the BluePoint system is simple and
intuitive to activate

#### Fast + Reliable

Automated, reliable rapid response system notifies building occupants and first responders within
life-saving seconds

#### Versatile + Dynamic

The BluePoint system can be customized to fit each building's needs and provides real-time, two-way
communication

## CRU Features

Discover how BluePoint's Custom Response Units empower you to design an emergency alert system
**tailored to your facility's unique safety needs** - because one size never fits all.

#### Customization

Colors and labeling can be customized to align with your facility's style and branding needs.

#### Quick & Cost Effective

Panel arrives pre-fabricated for simple installation.

#### Configuration

Response units can be configured with different activation and notification devices to best suit
your requirements.

#### Uptime Reliability

Battery backup and dual communication pathway included ot maximize uptime during outages.

## Customize Your Response

BluePoint's new Compact Response Unit is fully customizable, allowing organizations to tailor
**aesthetics, activation methods, and emergency response protocols** to fit your unique safety
needs.

#### Various Pull Stations

Whether you require security alerts for threats, medical alerts for rapid first aid response, or any
other emergency, each pull station can be fully customized in functionality, labeling, and
aesthetics. With options for single or multi-trigger activation, color customization, and
integration with existing security systems, you can create a seamless and intuitive emergency
response solution for your facility.

## Learn more about senior living and senior care

There are multiple types of care and communities available, so it's
important to know which is the best fit for your needs.

Assisted living

At costs ranging from $1,200 to $8,000 per month, [assisted living][122] communities are a great
choice for someone who needs help with activities of daily living, such as eating, grooming and
bathing. Many also offer respite care (short-term stays).

[Learn More][123]

Memory care

[Memory care][124] communities are specially designed living environments for people with
Alzheimer's or other dementias. You can expect that staff members have extra training to help people
with memory loss. Costs are $3,000 per month and up. Some also provide respite care.

[Learn More][125]

In-home care

For help with driving, getting around the house, meal preparation, companionship, and light
housekeeping, hire a professional caregiver through an [in-home care][126] agency. Caregivers can be
hired on a one-time basis or a regular monthly schedule. Rates usually range from $20 to $40 per
hour.

[Learn More][127]

Independent living

[Independent living][128] communities are great for residents who want to enjoy the perks of
community living, but who don't need regular assistance with activities of daily living. Costs range
from $1,000 to $4,000 per month.

[Learn More][129]

Nursing homes

Also called skilled nursing facilities (SNFs), [nursing homes][130] are staffed by skilled medical
professionals who can provide 24-hour support. Some also offer short-term stays for someone who is
transferring from the hospital but not yet ready to go home.

[Learn More][131]

Hospice

[Hospice care][132] helps provide comfort to your loved one in their last days. Care teams
specialize in keeping pain and suffering to a minimum. This care is often provided at home, but care
teams can also go to a hospital or other care facility to provide relief.

[Learn More][133]

Here is a list of FAQs. If you don’t find an answer to your questions, please do not hesitate to

What is the cost of an emergency button?

With a subscription, the monthly cost of a panic button is around $25 to $35 on average, but this
should be taken with a grain of salt! The reality is that several factors influence the cost of a
panic button.

For example, taking out a subscription generally reduces the equipment and activation costs, in
exchange for an agreement of a few months. Conversely, a panic button without a subscription costs
more upfront but gives you complete freedom with the service provider. 

Since prices vary depending on the model of device and the type of service it provides, we recommend
that you compare several customized offers to get a fair price.  

How do I determine which package is right for me?

Simply based on your needs. You can choose a panic button with a subscription, without a
subscription, connected to a central monitoring station, or simply connected to a smart app. 

Besides, emergency bracelets are extremely versatile and customizable devices. Some have a fall
detector, some have a GPS chip, and most have a two-way communication feature. Many models now
combine all these features!

Again, the specific needs of the user should guide the decision. One thing is certain, packages that
include a fall detector and 24/7 central monitoring service are highly recommended for people in
vulnerable situations.

Can I wear an alarm button with a pacemaker?

In theory, yes! But be careful… Some personal emergency devices produce an electromagnetic field
that can actually cause interference with the pacemaker. 

Most alarm button manufacturers claim that their products do not cause interference and that they
can be worn safely by people with pacemakers. 

With that said, it is highly recommended that you check with the manufacturer to see if their
product is compatible with a pacemaker. And in any case, it is also essential to seek the advice of
a medical professional if you find yourself in such a situation.

## About us

Welcome to Cloudtheapp, where we set the standard in the industry with AI-Powered Extreme
Configurability and leading-edge solutions for Digital Transformation. Specializing in Quality,
Safety, and Compliance, Cloudtheapp offers a comprehensive suite of essential solutions tailored for
diverse industries.

Our robust offerings include Enterprise Quality Management (EQMS), Food Safety Management (FSMS),
Supplier Quality Management (SQM), Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), Regulatory Information
Management (RIM), Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), Laboratory Management (LMS), Manufacturing
Execution (MES), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and Data Analytics.

Cloudtheapp pioneers Innovative Enterprise Software Development, delivering scalable solutions on
Enterprise Cloud-Native Software Platforms. Built by industry veterans with experience spanning over
3 decades, our AI-driven approach ensures unmatched configurability, facilitating seamless
adaptation and optimization of processes across sectors such as pharmaceuticals, med-device,
biotech, food & beverage, healthcare, manufacturing, and beyond.

Cloudtheapp supports Digital Transformation initiatives by optimizing workflows, enhancing
productivity, and ensuring regulatory compliance effortlessly. Our platforms are validated according
to FDA guidelines and include features necessary for organizations to comply with standards and
regulations such as 21 CFR Part 11 and ISO 13485. This empowers companies in the Life Sciences
industry to use Cloudtheapp confidently, knowing they meet stringent regulatory requirements.

Harnessing the power of AI and unmatched No-Code drag/drop designer tools, Cloudtheapp enables
organizations to rapidly build sophisticated applications in minutes by translating user
requirements from natural language, thereby streamlining development processes and accelerating
time-to-value.

Cloudtheapp also empowers collaboration both internally within the organization and with external
parties such as suppliers, customers, product consumers, and more. This seamless connectivity
enhances communication, improves feedback loops, and fosters a more integrated approach to quality
and compliance management.

Explore Cloudtheapp and discover how our AI-Powered solutions redefine industry standards, driving
efficiency, agility, and growth across your enterprise.

Everything needed to sell video successfully. Simple installation, smart analytics, 10X RMR
potential. One device connects the entire site. Works with most IP cameras. Reduces false alarms
while maximizing revenue.

Transform customer communications into actionable data. Every call tracked, every opportunity
captured. Not just an answering service, it's complete operational control that reduces attrition
and professionalizes your business.

Customer self-service that reduces false alarms and improves satisfaction. Mobile app included.
Customers can verify alarms, update contacts, and manage their system—reducing your workload and

# Experience isn’t just claimed, it’s proven.
# Especially when it’s critical.

From homes to critical infrastructure, CMS has been the trusted wholesale monitoring partner for
America’s most successful dealers since 1984.
[Find Out More][24]

## Decades of Innovation, One Consistent Promise.

In 1984, we began as Computerized Monitoring Services with a vision: bring enterprise-level
monitoring capabilities to security dealers of all sizes. Four decades later, we’ve grown to three
redundant monitoring centers, pioneered hosted monitoring services, and invested millions in
cutting-edge technology. What hasn’t changed? Our commitment to being the partner dealers can count
on when reliability matters most.
[Learn More today][25]

## Monitoring Infrastructure for Critical Systems

* Load balancing across all centers
* Cloud-based infrastructure
* Zero downtime deployments

* 7.5 million alarms processed annually

Industry Standards

## We’ve been first for 40 years so you can be first in your market.

With the resources of a multi-billion-dollar parent company, CMS delivers enterprise-grade IT
infrastructure, and financial stability is a dealer’s need for long-term success.

This backing means continuous innovation, unmatched resources, and a partner you can count on for
decades to come.

# How Health and
# Home Connect

We envision a world where **everyone** is empowered to age gracefully and well at home. Our
next-generation connective care platform makes that possible.

[How Health and Home Connect]

## Smarter Response. Better Outcomes.

Connect America elevates traditional personal emergency response systems (PERS) with clinical
intelligence and data-driven insights. Our solution integrates connected devices with clinical
triage, analytics and insights, and a 24/7 response center.

Every alert presents an opportunity to guide vulnerable individuals to the most appropriate level of
care in the moment of need, helping to reduce unnecessary emergency department visits. Meanwhile,
CareSage, our robust analytics engine, provides health plans with visibility into critical changes
and trends in healthcare utilization.

[Drive Better Health Outcomes]

## Our Connective Care Solution

[[Connected Devices]][11]

### [Connected Devices][12]

Innovative health and safety devices and wearables that connect to critical emergency and
non-emergency services.

[[Concierge Call Center]][13]

### [Concierge Call Center][14]

Trained specialists answer in seconds at the press of a button and provide critical support
services.

[[Analytics and Insights]][15]

### [Analytics and Insights][16]

Actionable data that enhances health insights and results in better care at lower costs.

[[Medication Management]][17]

### [Medication Management][18]

Help ensure medication adherence and reduce adverse events related to prescription medications.

## Improving Healthcare Outcomes and Experiences

Connect America’s connective care solution enables vulnerable populations to live safely and
independently at home. Our connected devices and tech-enabled services help improve care and
outcomes while reducing unnecessary hospitalizations and healthcare costs.

[Let's Talk][19]
[CareSage Analytics Engine]

## Actionable Insights from CareSage

CareSage is our data analytics platform that ingests data from across the CA Home platform and turns
it into actionable information and insights. We identify patterns in your data to provide insights
on:
* Activity and mobility levels
* Engagement with the plan
* Assistance and monitoring away from home
* Fall management
* Hospitalization prediction

This real-time reporting enables earlier intervention by supporting proactive care for your member
and patient populations.

[Learn More][20]

## Simple to Start. Easy to Use.

We tear down the barriers to adoption by creating a simple solution that’s intuitive for all users.

For individuals and their caregivers, we offer push-button products ready to use out of the box
without complex setup or configuration. If help is ever needed, a virtual health assistant is just a
text message away.

We offer end-to-end implementation support to allow healthcare providers staff get their connective
care program up and running without overtaxing their staff. Our goal is to serve as an extension of
your staff, increasing your bandwidth so you can focus on your care population.

## [Home][37] > [Support][38] > About Us

About Us

With an entrepreneurial spirit, beginning in 1954 as a custom engineering house, Monroe Electronics
was founded by Robert E. Vosteen, who specialized in designing and manufacturing instrumentation &
systems for local industries. By the late 1950s, he had invented a reliable, precise, drift-free
method for non-contact measurement of static electricity and his feedback electrostatic measurement
technique became the international standard for measurements utilized in photocopier R&D, industrial
monitoring, sensitive electronic assembly, bio-electric research, lightning warning among many other
applications. In the late 1960s timed & remote control were advancing and the company developed a
series of high-speed cue-tone decoders. The company designed and manufactured cue tone control
devices for a variety of circuits having an audio path – pioneering work in the early days of Cable
Television (CATV) industry led to developing a cue-tone switching for the fledgling Home Box Office
(HBO) movie service where the signals could be switched under unattended control. It was in this
same time period the company developed the first emergency override system for CATV. In 2003 Digital
Alert Systems' founders Bruce Robertson and Tom Wood determined that there were three important
issues surrounding Emergency Alerting Systems (EAS); The original scope of EAS was expanding –
becoming more important and critical to government agencies, the current equipment available was not
up to task and needed significant technological improvements, and a blended approach leveraging
preeminent information processing technology with network-centric thinking better served the
customer with a more relevant EAS platform that incorporated simplified and upgradable software to
ensure long-term viability. The result of this market-understanding and innovative thinking was the
DASDEC™ EAS Encoder-Decoder product line. Which, when certified by the FCC in 2004, revolutionized
the industry. Both company leaders identified the collective benefits to its customers and in 2005
Digital Alert Systems entered exclusive manufacturing and licensing agreements with Monroe
Electronics to manufacture and market the DASDEC for the Cable, IPTV, and Campus communications
industries under the One-Net™ brand. In late 2009 Digital Alert Systems and Monroe Electronics took
their partnership to a new level by merging operations, manufacturing and worldwide support under
one primary organization. Under this new chapter, Digital Alert Systems became a division of Monroe
Electronics. The combined Digital Alert Systems and Monroe Electronics organization maintained its
customer-centric focus while becoming the foremost market leader with units sold into the cable,
telecommunications, IPTV, and campuses throughout the world. In 2018, the company's focus emphasized
its commitment to the emergency messaging market and divested the electrostatic product line, and
with it the Monroe Electronics corporate name, formally making the enduring organization Digital
Alert Systems, Inc. At Digital Alert Systems, we remain dedicated to the company's initial vision -
create innovative improvements for emergency messaging products, with hardware, software, and
service, to address changing needs, leveraging superior technologies with a network-centric
approach, and providing customers with exceptional sales, service, and support.

## [Home][37] > [Support][38] > About Us

About Us

With an entrepreneurial spirit, beginning in 1954 as a custom engineering house, Monroe Electronics
was founded by Robert E. Vosteen, who specialized in designing and manufacturing instrumentation &
systems for local industries. By the late 1950s, he had invented a reliable, precise, drift-free
method for non-contact measurement of static electricity and his feedback electrostatic measurement
technique became the international standard for measurements utilized in photocopier R&D, industrial
monitoring, sensitive electronic assembly, bio-electric research, lightning warning among many other
applications. In the late 1960s timed & remote control were advancing and the company developed a
series of high-speed cue-tone decoders. The company designed and manufactured cue tone control
devices for a variety of circuits having an audio path – pioneering work in the early days of Cable
Television (CATV) industry led to developing a cue-tone switching for the fledgling Home Box Office
(HBO) movie service where the signals could be switched under unattended control. It was in this
same time period the company developed the first emergency override system for CATV. In 2003 Digital
Alert Systems' founders Bruce Robertson and Tom Wood determined that there were three important
issues surrounding Emergency Alerting Systems (EAS); The original scope of EAS was expanding –
becoming more important and critical to government agencies, the current equipment available was not
up to task and needed significant technological improvements, and a blended approach leveraging
preeminent information processing technology with network-centric thinking better served the
customer with a more relevant EAS platform that incorporated simplified and upgradable software to
ensure long-term viability. The result of this market-understanding and innovative thinking was the
DASDEC™ EAS Encoder-Decoder product line. Which, when certified by the FCC in 2004, revolutionized
the industry. Both company leaders identified the collective benefits to its customers and in 2005
Digital Alert Systems entered exclusive manufacturing and licensing agreements with Monroe
Electronics to manufacture and market the DASDEC for the Cable, IPTV, and Campus communications
industries under the One-Net™ brand. In late 2009 Digital Alert Systems and Monroe Electronics took
their partnership to a new level by merging operations, manufacturing and worldwide support under
one primary organization. Under this new chapter, Digital Alert Systems became a division of Monroe
Electronics. The combined Digital Alert Systems and Monroe Electronics organization maintained its
customer-centric focus while becoming the foremost market leader with units sold into the cable,
telecommunications, IPTV, and campuses throughout the world. In 2018, the company's focus emphasized
its commitment to the emergency messaging market and divested the electrostatic product line, and
with it the Monroe Electronics corporate name, formally making the enduring organization Digital
Alert Systems, Inc. At Digital Alert Systems, we remain dedicated to the company's initial vision -
create innovative improvements for emergency messaging products, with hardware, software, and
service, to address changing needs, leveraging superior technologies with a network-centric
approach, and providing customers with exceptional sales, service, and support.

# Compliance Management

Working in the most heavily regulated industries, Drips stays at the forefront of compliance best
practices. Our attorneys at McDermott are thought leaders in TCPA and experts in compliance,
specifically around state and federal telemarketing laws. Because of their expertise, we get
compliance updates in real-time.

But we don't stop there. We leverage this expertise and our experience to offer our clients
proprietary compliance management technology with every campaign we deliver.
[Compliance Features][58]
PROPRIETARY COMPLIANCE SOLUTION

## Drips Rules Engine (DRE)

The Drips Rules Engine (DRE, for short) is our secret for robust and responsive compliance
management. DRE uses a database of rules, regulations, and best practices that Drips uses for
drafting conversational scripts at scale. These include state level regulations, FCC rules,
industry-specific requirements, proven Drips best practices and much, much more. This technology
empowers our clients to engage while adhering to the necessary rules and standards.

## Cadence

Determining when and how often we can and should reach out.

## Channel

Identifying where and to whom we can communicate.

## Content

Defining any essential verbiage or effective conversational logic to be included.

## Knowledge

Incorporating a library of tactical standpoints and software functionality that will be used on a
client program.

## Billions of Compliance Configurations

For texts and calls that require prior consent, consumers are generally allowed to revoke consent
(opt out) in any way that is clear and reasonable. The failure to honor these requests is one of the
most common theories of CPA liability that we see in court.”
Matthew Knowles

FAQS

## Get Your Questions Answered

### How do you help us prevent and manage global opt-out requests?

Because we're conversational in nature, we can handle what we call "conversational close-outs."
We're able to capture in greater detail the specific communication that people wish to stop
receiving. This can potentially mean that you can process a partial opt-out rather than treat their
message as a global revocation of consent.

### What impact can Drips have on the buyer journey?

It has never been harder to get the attention of your consumers. What's more, rules and regulations
around outreach are constantly changing, which makes engaging harder every year. Drips is your
partner in navigating this landscape. We are experts in "reaching the unreachable" with compliance
at the forefront.

### What are robocalls and robotexts?

These are calls and texts made, randomly or sequentially, to phone numbers using an “automatic
telephone dialing system” or an artificial or prerecorded voice. Under the Telephone Consumer
Protection Act (TCPA) and the FCC’s implementing rules, callers and texters must obtain “prior
express consent” or “prior express written consent,” depending on the call/text content, from
consumers to send such communications absent an applicable exemption.

# Who We Are

We’re rethinking how brands connect with their customers. As the pioneers of Conversations as a
Service (CaaS), we empower organizations to engage in authentic, human-like two-way dialogues at
scale through AI-driven conversational outreach. Explore our mission, values, and history to learn
how we’re shaping the future of customer engagement.
[Meet Our Leadership][58]
What Drives Us

## The Drips Identity

## **Mission**

Drips is the founder and premier provider of Conversations as a Service. With human-like AI
dialogue, we enable organizations to deliver real, authentic, two-way conversations with every
single customer at scale.

## Values

We drive our growth by centering everything we
do on six core values: Lean. Happy. Passion. Improve. Team. Curiosity.
Building Outreach Excellence

## Our History

Consumer preferences for communication have changed. People have stopped responding to one-way push
outreach, and brands are trying to figure out how to keep up. That's why Drips was born, and why
we’ve kept evolving.

**The Early Years*

# Who We Are

We’re rethinking how brands connect with their customers. As the pioneers of Conversations as a
Service (CaaS), we empower organizations to engage in authentic, human-like two-way dialogues at
scale through AI-driven conversational outreach. Explore our mission, values, and history to learn
how we’re shaping the future of customer engagement.
[Meet Our Leadership][58]
What Drives Us

## The Drips Identity

## **Mission**

Drips is the founder and premier provider of Conversations as a Service. With human-like AI
dialogue, we enable organizations to deliver real, authentic, two-way conversations with every
single customer at scale.

## Values

We drive our growth by centering everything we
do on six core values: Lean. Happy. Passion. Improve. Team. Curiosity.
Building Outreach Excellence

## Our History

Consumer preferences for communication have changed. People have stopped responding to one-way push
outreach, and brands are trying to figure out how to keep up. That's why Drips was born, and why
we’ve kept evolving.

**The Early Years**
Drips emerged from a partnership between founders Aaron Christopher "A.C." Evans and Anthony Greco,
culminating in the transformative addition of founder Tom Martindale in 2014, whose vision to
automate SMS led to a remarkable 50% improvement in lead-to-call rates.
2014
**Lead Follow Up Experts^{TM}**
Drips, founded on **January 19, 2016**, aimed to revolutionize customer engagement through AI and
NLP technologies, leading to rapid growth and recognition as the 20th Fastest Growing Company in
North America in 2019.
2016-19
**Founders In Conversational Texting^{TM}**
In 2020, Drips embraced remote work, fostering a dynamic environment, while 2021 marked a
breakthrough in healthcare, securing major clients and attracting strategic investments from
Accel-KKR and Blue Venture Fund.
2021
**It's all about how you say it^{TM}**
Drips refined its AI models, leading to more sophisticated and human-like interactions, while
doubling down on healthcare investments. In 2024, the launch of **Conversations as a Service**
drove improved outcomes across various industries.
2022-Today

# Your Success, Our Commitment

At Drips, excellence is not just a goal — it’s our commitment. We navigate with precision,
strategize with expertise, and ensure that every step we take is a deliberate move toward your
success.
[Request A Discovery Workshop][58]
Your journey

## **Client Success Process**

Our step-by-step process is designed to seamlessly guide you through every stage of your outreach
transformation. From initial discovery to launch to continuous improvement, we are committed to
delivering excellence at every turn.

## Discover

Begin your journey with a comprehensive audience and consent review, coupled with a strategic use
case assessment and performance benchmarking. It's the foundation that sets the stage for
personalized and effective engagement.

## Build

Our campaign build phase is all about creativity and compliance. We leverage statistically proven
campaign design and navigate confidently within the guardrails of compliance.

## Design

We meticulously craft integrations, develop robust solutions, and engage in thorough testing and
implementation. Our goal is a strong start that prepares the way for sustained success.

## Run

Where our strategies come to life. We monitor, deliver reports, and host quarterly briefings to
strive toward maximum deliverability, quality, and performance.

## Improve & Iterate

We deliver ongoing split testing, supervise machine learning, introduce new features, and stay ahead
of regulatory and compliance updates.
"The way you put together the proposal and journey was a core reason we moved forward. You made it
easy for us to understand the vision and value."
Vice President
Government Programs
FAQS

## Get Your Questions Answered

### What process does Drips follow in the campaign design phase?

Using the information gained during discovery about client goals, branding, and internal policies,
Drips creates a customized scripting package for your campaign. Once we have UX sign-off on
scripting, we proceed to set up and the final review phase. Prior to go-live, we have a formal
campaign review workshop where we review campaign designs for compliance and brand alignment. The
Drips UX team then designs the program experience based on all four aspects of our Drips Rules
Engine (DRE): Cadence, Channel, Content, and Knowledge.

### What is the Drips discovery process?

Drips is very hands-on during discovery to set the stage for a successful outreach campaign. Our
first priority is to establish strategic alignment. Then, we move into a series of workshops: use
case workshop, technical workshop, business case validation, and scope validation.

### What support does Drips offer during implementation and after campaign launch?

During implementation your Drips team includes multiple outreach professionals who can help with
every aspect of setup and ongoing performance improvement. These include your account manager,
customer success manager, client insights manager, campaign coordination team, and the Drips
operations team.

# Security at Drips

Your trust in Drips is our top priority. Drips enables enterprises across industries to improve
their proactive outreach strategy. Protecting your data and ensuring high product reliability is
essential to helping our clients achieve their goals.
[Tell Us Your Security Needs][58]
Best In Class

## Security Procedures

Drips is ready and able to work with major enterprises in highly regulated industries that need
robust data security. From the foundations of our platform to our operational practices and
third-party testing and certifications, the security and privacy of client and customer data is
always our priority.

## Certified Secure

Drips maintains both ISO 27001 and HITRUST certifications. ISO/IEC 27001 is a widely known standard
for risk management in information security management systems (ISMS). The HITRUST CSF integrates
dozens of major security and privacy-related standards and regulations, including the HIPAA security
rule requirements.

## **Data Encryption
## **

Client data is protected with encryption at rest and in transit. Network traffic is secured by HTTPS
over public networks and continuously monitored for malicious traffic and network attacks.

## Access Controls

Drips provides controls to ensure data is only accessed by authorized persons. This includes 2FA and
IP whitelisting protection. We also offer role-based platform privileges to enforce
organization-wide data access policies.

## **Privacy
## **

Drips uses industry best practices to protect the privacy of our clients’ personal data. This
includes following the CCPA and other applicable legislation.

## Third-Party Penetration Testing

To ensure the security and privacy of client data, each year Drips employs third-party security
experts to perform a broad penetration test across Drips production applications and production
network.

## **Disaster Recovery
## **

The Drips disaster recovery (DR) program ensures that services remain available or are easily
recoverable in the case of a disaster with a robust technical environment, disaster recovery plans,
governance and oversight policies, and thorough testing.

## Built on Best-in-Class Technologies

The Drips platform provides clients with high performance and availability. Using best-in-class
technologies such as Azure, Drips can elastically scale to meet demand and leverage secure and
redundant data centers.

## Get Your Questions Answered

### Is Drips ISO 27001-certified?

Yes, Drips is ISO 27001 certified. ISO/IEC 27001 is the best-known standard for information security
management systems (ISMS). Meeting ISO 27001 requirements means that Drips has implemented a system
to manage risks related to the security of data we handle.

### What is data-driven marketing?

Data-driven marketing is a strategy that uses insights derived from customer information and
behavior to tailor marketing efforts. It involves collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to
understand customer preferences, segment audiences, and personalize campaigns. By leveraging data
from various sources like demographics, purchase history, and online interactions, marketers can
make informed decisions to optimize targeting, messaging, and timing of their marketing initiatives,
ultimately improving customer engagement and ROI.

### What is CCPA?

CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) is a state-level privacy law that regulates the collection,
use, and sharing of personal information by businesses operating in California. It grants consumers
rights regarding their data and imposes obligations on businesses to enhance data protection and
transparency. Like most state-level regulations, Drips carefully employs specific controls to help
empower your compliance with this law.

# Join the Drips Team

We empower some of the largest organizations in the world to engage consumers in real conversations
to drive better results. We do this with Conversations as a Service that includes human-like
AI-powered SMS, scheduled calling, and voicemail messages.
[See Open Roles][58]
WHERE WE STARTED

## Our Story

Drips started in Akron, Ohio with just three friends and a single PHP script written overnight.
Since then, we’ve evolved and iterated into an enterprise-grade technology solution trusted by top
organizations with household brand names. Our humble roots, work ethic, and unwavering core values
have guided us through the years as we’ve met every challenge head-on. If you like what you see, get
in touch and join us on the next leg of our journey.

## What We Stand For

## Team

We're a tight-knit team at Drips, and we care deeply about the success of each other and our
mission. We're looking for team members who take ownership of mistakes and growth opportunities, who
focus on what's right, not who's right, who seek insights from the team — and, most importantly, who
trust and support one another.

## Happiness

We're going to be spending a lot of time with one another, so it's important to make sure this is
the right place for you. Happiness is all about enjoying and supporting those around you in your
environment. Expressing and finding opportunities for practicing gratitude, assuming positive
intent, and always bringing solutions instead of complaints to the table.

## Lean

Being lean has allowed us to grow fast and profitably, leading us to be named one of the
fastest-growing companies in America by Deloitte. Demonstrating this core value means using your
time and resources efficiently, making data-driven decisions, focusing and executing against a
prioritized plan, and proving ideas with minimum viable products (MVP), so we can learn quickly and
iterate toward a long-term decision.

"work." You should have a desire for advancement, be thinking about solutions both during and
outside of your standard workday, and be leaning into your day.

## Improve

We encourage our team members to do their best today, then beat it tomorrow. You should constantly
be striving towards excellence in your craft, have a willingness to take constructive feedback and
adjust accordingly, show measurable improvement in your areas of focus, and be a lifelong learner,
seeking knowledge and asking questions.

# Voice of Customer

At Drips, we believe our clients should directly shape the future of our platform, services, and
strategy.

The Voice of the Customer (VoC) program is our commitment to listening deeply, acting decisively,
and driving shared success. Through structured, high-impact engagement like our Annual Business
Reviews (ABRs), we co-create objectives that guide how we serve and grow with our clients.

### Our Process

Each year, our VoC ABR series brings together our executive leadership, product teams, and top
clients for a two-part strategy and alignment session. These collaborative workshops result in
client-specific objectives and key results (OKRs) that drive:
* Product and service innovation
* Strategic roadmap alignment
* Measurable quality and growth outcomes

### What We’re Hearing

From our inaugural Q4/24 to Q1/25 Cycle, key themes emerged:
* Clients value transparency, velocity, and results
* Data integration & systems interoperability are top priorities
* When we have better data we drive better outcomes, especially for star ratings and care gap
closure.

### What's Next

The OKRs resulting from our Voice of the Customer client meetings are now shaping our internal
roadmap and cross-functional priorities. Starting in 2025, Drips is linking company goals and
performance incentives to these shared outcomes — ensuring every team is aligned around delivering
what matters most to our clients.

## The Executive Advisory Council

The Drips Executive Advisory Council (EAC) serves as a strategic forum where select customer
executives and Drips leadership collaborate to exchange insights, influence product direction, and
build deeper relationships.

This invitation-only group is designed to ensure that our most forward-thinking partners help guide
where Drips is headed — while gaining unique value and visibility in return.

## Member Benefits

### Industry
### Insights

Stay ahead of the curve with briefings on emerging trends, regulatory changes, and market dynamics.

### Executive
### Networking

Connect with senior leaders across the healthcare and payer landscape to share challenges,
successes, and ideas.

### Influence Product Strategy

Help shape the evolution of Drips’ platform—what we build, prioritize, and launch.

### Recognition & Visibility

Get acknowledged as a thought leader contributing to industry innovation.

### Exclusive
### Access

Preview new features, participate in early pilots, and offer feedback before full-scale rollouts.

### Professional Development

Grow your executive influence by engaging in strategic-level conversations that sharpen leadership
perspective.

## Benefits to Drips

### Strategic Insight

Gain direct input from customers navigating real-world challenges and opportunities.

### Customer Advocacy

Turn engaged EAC members into credible champions of Drips in the market.

### Co-Creation & Market Fit

Test ideas, validate solutions, and build confidence through collaborative development.

# Meet the Team

We’ve built a team dedicated to going beyond traditional outbound so you can achieve your toughest
outreach goals on a massive scale. Our people are the key to providing you with unrivaled AI
technology, meticulous attention to compliance, and a hands-on managed technology approach.

# Executive Leadership Team

### Aaron Christopher “A.C.” Evans

Founder & Executive Chairman

A.C. Evans is a pioneer in conversational marketing and Co-Founder and Executive Chairman of Drips.
A proven leader in the space with a passion for “Scaling the Unscalable,” A.C. continues to innovate
best practices for humanized, effective, and compliant outreach.

### Anthony Greco

Founder, Board Member, Technology Advisor

Anthony Greco is our Founder, Board Member, Technology Advisor. Anthony is a multi-time
entrepreneur, writing his first line of code at nine years old, and has built Drips to scale to over
half a billion conversations to date.

### Tom Martindale

Founder & Executive Chairman

As Founding Partner and Executive Chairman, Tom is involved key growth areas and aligning Drips to a
common goal of market definition and domination. He is also no stranger to building up businesses,
having founded over seven companies. A Veteran of the United States Navy, Tom served in Operation
Restore Hope, Somalia, from 1992-1993.

### Jim Cronin

Chief Executive Officer

Jim brings decades of experience leading large-scale payer operations and driving enterprise-wide
efficiencies. As a senior executive at UnitedHealthcare and Anthem, he led critical business
transformations, including mergers and new member engagement strategies.

### Shawn Mobley

President

Shawn brings deep experience building and scaling commercial teams in complex enterprise
environments, including leadership roles at United Healthcare, Rally Health, and most recently
TurningPoint Healthcare. His focus as President is driving clarity in our go-to-market approach and
strengthening accountability across execution.

### Michael Roche

Chief Operating Officer

Michael is our Chief Operating Officer. He has deep expertise in operations, customer success,
solution consulting, and professional services. His focus and passion sit squarely at the
intersection of customer service and practical AI, which Michael believes is the secret weapon for
building a thriving, customer-centric, and conversational platform.

### Deepak Suri

Chief Product and Technology Officer

As Chief Product and Technology Officer, Deepak leads Drips’ product and technology functions to
expand our scale, innovate AI capabilities, and introduce new product capabilities for our clients.
He previously led enterprise technology, data, information security and AI strategies as the CIO of
HealthMap Solutions and ArmadaHealth.

### Eric Grossman

Chief Transformation Officer

Eric is a health insurance authority in payer strategy, member activation, AI, and technology-driven
solutions that improve healthcare outcomes. He has led growth initiatives as CCO at Softheon, CEO
and founder of NextHealth, and in leadership roles at TriZetto and Connecture. Based in Denver, he
enjoys skiing and time with his family.

### Kathleen Faulk

Chief Strategy Officer

Kathleen Faulk brings over 30 years of leadership in healthcare, driving growth and innovation
across national, regional, and Blues payers. She’s led Medicare and Medicaid strategies at
HealthPartners, Cambia Health Solutions, and Humana—improving affordability, provider collaboration,
and member experience. With deep expertise in regulatory oversight, Kathleen ensures Drips delivers
compliant, high-performing engagement solutions that help payers connect with members and create
measurable value across all lines of business.

### Tim Dietrich

Chief Financial Officer

As CFO of Drips, Tim is responsible for the strategic financial direction of the company. Tim brings
a strong background helping privately owned companies scale their back-office operations for growth
as well as analyzing financial strengths and weaknesses to propose corrective actions.

## Senior Leadership Team

### David Dodge

VP of Strategic Finance

As VP of Strategic Finance, David brings a cross-functional perspective spanning finance,
operations, and strategy to help clients optimize the financial impact of Drips' programs. Starting
at Huron Consulting Group in revenue cycle management, he transitioned to the payer world where he
earned his designation as an Emeritus Fellow of the Society of Actuaries and led both Stars and
Operations functions at Cambia Health Solutions.

### Ryan Donohue

Senior Vice President of Sales

As Senior Vice President of Sales, Ryan drives growth beyond healthcare, expanding Drips’ presence
across insurance, financial services, education, and other regulated industries while scaling
go-to-market strategy and delivering measurable outcomes. He brings a proven track record of
building high-performing teams and accelerating growth in competitive B2B environments, with deep
expertise in revenue strategy, customer-centric engagement, and market expansion.

### Dan Fox

Managing Director of Healthcare

Managing Director of Healthcare Dan Fox helps healthcare enterprises successfully integrate
Conversations as a Service, leveraging 13 years of experience in conversational AI technology.

### Katie Howard

Senior People Operations Manager

Katie has devoted her career to working with fast-growing start-ups and has a passion for creating a
culture where Drips employees thrive. She currently supports the entire team and is always thinking
of new and innovative ways to invigorate our workplace.

### Melissa Jattne

Senior Vice President of Strategic Accounts

As Senior Vice President of Strategic Accounts, Melissa partners with enterprise customers to expand
and optimize how they use Drips, driving greater value and long-term growth across industries
including property & casualty and education. She focuses on aligning Drips’ conversational
engagement capabilities with evolving business needs, helping organizations scale their strategies
and maximize performance across the customer lifecycle.

### Chris Kanaley

Head of Corporate Development

Chris Kanaley is the Head of Corporate Development and a Board Observer for Drips. Previously, he
worked in senior roles at operationally intensive private equity firms focused on flexible
technology investments. Chris has helped to advise a number of start-up and late-stage companies
through advisory positions and boards.

### Jeff Maxwell

SVP of Healthcare Markets

As SVP of Healthcare Markets, Jeff Maxwell combines deep payer knowledge with proven expertise in
applying AI technology to help plans drive affordability, access, and improved member outcomes. Jeff
brings over 20 years of leadership and executive experience spanning health plans, healthcare
technology, and AI-driven engagement.

### Matt Robinson

VP of Implementations

Matt Robinson is a dedicated professional with a strong focus on process improvement, project
management, and client success. With a keen eye for detail and a passion for optimizing workflows,
Matt consistently drives projects to successful completion, ensuring client satisfaction and
operational efficiency.

### Chris Stevens

VP of Production

Chris Stevens serves as the VP of Production at Drips, where he oversees all operational activities
to ensure clients receive an unparalleled campaign experience. With his extensive background in
fintech and a proven track record in operational excellence within managed services, Chris drives
the internal operations that power Drips.

### Casey Sylvia

Chief of Staff

As Chief of Staff, Casey champions customer-centric transformation by turning insights into action.
She drives clarity and execution across the revenue organization, leads enterprise-level Voice of
Customer efforts, and helps scale a high-performing, insight-led growth engine.

### Vincent Tessier

VP of Engineering

Vincent Tessier joined Drips as VP of Engineering to scale the engineering department and streamline
processes. He has more than 20 years of experience in new software product development in
leading-edge technologies. In the IT industry, he built remote management solutions to help MSPs
with managing, automating, and protecting computers around the world.

### Monica Woller

SVP of User Experience

Monica is our SVP of User Experience, responsible for client operations and the success of our
clients' programs. As an expert in the Drips platform and communication strategy, Monica plays a key
role in leading our operations and production team, serving as a liaison between sales and client
success.

# Who We Are

We’re rethinking how brands connect with their customers. As the pioneers of Conversations as a
Service (CaaS), we empower organizations to engage in authentic, human-like two-way dialogues at
scale through AI-driven conversational outreach. Explore our mission, values, and history to learn
how we’re shaping the future of customer engagement.
[Meet Our Leadership][58]
What Drives Us

## The Drips Identity

## **Mission**

Drips is the founder and premier provider of Conversations as a Service. With human-like AI
dialogue, we enable organizations to deliver real, authentic, two-way conversations with every
single customer at scale.

## Values

We drive our growth by centering everything we
do on six core values: Lean. Happy. Passion. Improve. Team. Curiosity.
Building Outreach Excellence

## Our History

Consumer preferences for communication have changed. People have stopped responding to one-way push
outreach, and brands are trying to figure out how to keep up. That's why Drips was born, and why
we’ve kept evolving.

**The Early Years**
Drips emerged from a partnership between founders Aaron Christopher "A.C." Evans and Anthony Greco,
culminating in the transformative addition of founder Tom Martindale in 2014, whose vision to
automate SMS led to a remarkable 50% improvement in lead-to-call rates.
2014
**Lead Follow Up Experts^{TM}**
Drips, founded on **January 19, 2016**, aimed to revolutionize customer engagement through AI and
NLP technologies, leading to rapid growth and recognition as the 20th Fastest Growing Company in
North America in 2019.
2016-19
**Founders In Conversational Texting^{TM}**
In 2020, Drips embraced remote work, fostering a dynamic environment, while 2021 marked a
breakthrough in healthcare, securing major clients and attracting strategic investments from
Accel-KKR and Blue Venture Fund.
2021
**It's all about how you say it^{TM}**
Drips refined its AI models, leading to more sophisticated and human-like interactions, while
doubling down on healthcare investments. In 2024, the launch of **Conversations as a Service**
drove improved outcomes across various industries.
2022-Today

all_classified.company_summary: Drring is a leading provider of emergency alert systems designed to enhance the safety and well-being of seniors living independently in India. Their core product, a one-touch emergency device connected to a medical command center, offers 24/7 monitoring and rapid response services, ensuring that loved ones receive immediate assistance in critical situations. Trusted by families, hospitals, and maritime crews, Drring leverages advanced technology and compassionate support to provide peace of mind for caregivers and families alike.

# About ECAM

## Formerly Stealth Monitoring and ECAMSECURE

## Meet America’s Largest Video Security Provider

ECAM was formed through the joining of two industry leaders, Stealth Monitoring and ECAMSECURE,
bringing together best-in-class live video monitoring expertise and next-generation surveillance
innovation under one unified brand. Today, ECAM is a North American leader in AI-driven live
surveillance solutions, with the continent’s largest footprint of monitored permanent and mobile
surveillance units. Guided by a shared vision of Every Camera Always Monitored, ECAM combines
advanced surveillance technology with highly trained remote video monitoring operators to deliver
real-time protection with unmatched precision and vigilance.

From R&D to product development and platform innovation, ECAM fully owns and develops its entire
operation and technology stack, building proprietary technologies designed to address the most
common security challenges. This in-house approach ensures customers benefit from rapid innovation
and cutting-edge solutions tailored to their environments and security needs.

ECAM is a global champion business of [GardaWorld][108], an entrepreneurial-driven corporation that
builds global champions in security services, AI-enabled security technologies, integrated risk
management, and cash automation solutions.

## Our Leadership Team

ECAM is guided by seasoned leaders who prioritize innovation, act like owners and adhere to an
entrepreneurial and customer-centric mindset. They lead an ambitious and visionary team shaping the
future of intelligent video surveillance.

## Why ECAM Outperforms Every Alternative

### Fast Response & Support

ECAM owned and ECAM operated means you get faster service, stronger accountability, and dependable
support.

### Surveillance & Monitoring All in One

ECAM brings together advanced camera technology and human-in-the-loop monitoring for one complete
solution.

### The Most Advanced Technology

ECAM’s proprietary AI, built on Canada’s largest monitored camera network, sees what others can’t.

### Full-Service Security Solutions

As a GardaWorld Company, ECAM can provide full-service security, from advanced technology to on-site
guards.

[**Discover the ECAM Difference**][113]

## Our Service Areas

ECAM provides proactive live video surveillance solutions for businesses and properties in cities
all across North America. Our team is actively watching over 100,000 cameras and counting.

## FAQ

### **What happened to Stealth Monitoring?**

# About ECAM

## Formerly Stealth Monitoring and ECAMSECURE

## Meet America’s Largest Video Security Provider

ECAM was formed through the joining of two industry leaders, Stealth Monitoring and ECAMSECURE,
bringing together best-in-class live video monitoring expertise and next-generation surveillance
innovation under one unified brand. Today, ECAM is a North American leader in AI-driven live
surveillance solutions, with the continent’s largest footprint of monitored permanent and mobile
surveillance units. Guided by a shared vision of Every Camera Always Monitored, ECAM combines
advanced surveillance technology with highly trained remote video monitoring operators to deliver
real-time protection with unmatched precision and vigilance.

From R&D to product development and platform innovation, ECAM fully owns and develops its entire
operation and technology stack, building proprietary technologies designed to address the most
common security challenges. This in-house approach ensures customers benefit from rapid innovation
and cutting-edge solutions tailored to their environments and security needs.

ECAM is a global champion business of [GardaWorld][108], an entrepreneurial-driven corporation that
builds global champions in security services, AI-enabled security technologies, integrated risk
management, and cash automation solutions.

## Our Leadership Team

ECAM is guided by seasoned leaders who prioritize innovation, act like owners and adhere to an
entrepreneurial and customer-centric mindset. They lead an ambitious and visionary team shaping the
future of intelligent video surveillance.

# About ECAM

## Formerly Stealth Monitoring and ECAMSECURE

## Meet America’s Largest Video Security Provider

ECAM was formed through the joining of two industry leaders, Stealth Monitoring and ECAMSECURE,
bringing together best-in-class live video monitoring expertise and next-generation surveillance
innovation under one unified brand. Today, ECAM is a North American leader in AI-driven live
surveillance solutions, with the continent’s largest footprint of monitored permanent and mobile
surveillance units. Guided by a shared vision of Every Camera Always Monitored, ECAM combines
advanced surveillance technology with highly trained remote video monitoring operators to deliver
real-time protection with unmatched precision and vigilance.

From R&D to product development and platform innovation, ECAM fully owns and develops its entire
operation and technology stack, building proprietary technologies designed to address the most
common security challenges. This in-house approach ensures customers benefit from rapid innovation
and cutting-edge solutions tailored to their environments and security needs.

ECAM is a global champion business of [GardaWorld][108], an entrepreneurial-driven corporation that
builds global champions in security services, AI-enabled security technologies, integrated risk
management, and cash automation solutions.

## Our Leadership Team

ECAM is guided by seasoned leaders who prioritize innovation, act like owners and adhere to an
entrepreneurial and customer-centric mindset. They lead an ambitious and visionary team shaping the
future of intelligent video surveillance.

## Why ECAM Outperforms Every Alternative

### Fast Response & Support

ECAM owned and ECAM operated means you get faster service, stronger accountability, and dependable
support.

### Surveillance & Monitoring All in One

ECAM brings together advanced camera technology and human-in-the-loop monitoring for one complete
solution.

### The Most Advanced Technology

ECAM’s proprietary AI, built on Canada’s largest monitored camera network, sees what others can’t.

### Full-Service Security Solutions

As a GardaWorld Company, ECAM can provide full-service security, from advanced technology to on-site
guards.

[**Discover the ECAM Difference**][113]

## Our Service Areas

ECAM provides proactive live video surveillance solutions for businesses and properties in cities
all across North America. Our team is actively watching over 100,000 cameras and counting.

[See Our Service Areas][114]

## FAQ

### **What happened to Stealth Monitoring?**

Stealth Monitoring was acquired by GardaWorld in 2024 and later merged with ECAMSECURE in 2025 to
form ECAM. The combined organization brings together Stealth’s industry-leading live video
monitoring and ECAMSECURE’s pioneering mobile surveillance technology under one unified brand with
expanded capabilities.

### **What happened to ECAMSECURE?**

ECAMSECURE merged with Stealth Monitoring in 2025 to form ECAM. The rebrand reflects a unified
approach to security that integrates advanced AI, mobile surveillance units, and live video
monitoring under one organization backed by GardaWorld.

Caliber’s operations were acquired by Stealth Monitoring prior to the GardaWorld

# About Eirene

Guiding families through end-of-life planning with clarity and compassion.

## Our Story

Eirene was founded by Mallory Greene and Faisal Abid, tech entrepreneurs whose parents dedicated
their careers to helping families through end-of-life care. Over the past five years, we helped
thousands of families navigate funerals, and through this experience, we discovered a deeper need:
families were looking for more than just services – they needed guidance they could trust.

During times of loss, families need clear, reliable guidance more than support. That's why we
created Eirene.ca, a curated resource center that guides you through end-of-life planning and care
with clarity and compassion.

[Mallory Greene - Co-founder of Eirene]

### Mallory Greene

Co-founder

[Faisal Abid - Co-founder of Eirene]

### Faisal Abid

Co-founder

## Our Commitment

We understand that navigating end-of-life matters can feel overwhelming. Whether you're planning
ahead, facing an immediate need, or seeking support through grief, Eirene.ca is here to help. As we
guide you through this journey, we're equally committed to preserving the environment for future
generations.

Whether you're preparing for the future, arranging care for a loved one, understanding the options
you need, or seeking support through grief, Eirene.ca is here to help. As we guide you through this
journey, we're equally committed to preserving the environment for future generations.

## Our Values

### Compassion First

Every interaction is guided by empathy and understanding, recognizing the emotional complexity of
end-of-life planning.

### Trust & Transparency

We provide clear, honest information without hidden agendas, empowering families to make informed
decisions.

### Accessibility

Making end-of-life planning information accessible to everyone through clear language and thoughtful
guidance.

© 2025 Eirene

## Frequently Asked Questions

Is the Belle+ device really free?
Yes — the Belle+ pendant comes free with our $29.95/month monitoring subscription. There are no
upfront device costs, no activation fees, and no contracts. You can cancel anytime.
Does it work without a home phone or WiFi?
Yes. The Belle+ has a built-in Verizon 4G LTE SIM and works anywhere there is cellular coverage in
the United States — no landline, internet, or smartphone required.
How does fall detection work?
The pendant uses motion sensors and an algorithm to detect sudden drops or impacts consistent with a
fall. When triggered, it automatically connects to a 24/7 care specialist who will check on the user
and dispatch help if needed — no button press required.
Can it be worn in the shower?
Yes. The Belle+ is rated IP67 — showerproof and water-resistant. We recommend wearing it 24/7 since
the bathroom is the most common location for senior falls.
What happens when the button is pressed?
The pendant immediately calls our US-based 24/7 monitoring center over 4G LTE. A care specialist
speaks with the user through the pendant's speaker, locates them via GPS/WiFi, and dispatches
emergency services or contacts family members based on the situation and the user's medical profile
on file.
What if the device gets damaged?
We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee and one free replacement if the device is found defective.

How long does shipping take?
Free shipping arrives in 2–5 business days. The device comes pre-activated with a Verizon SIM card

How can I track my vehicle or teen driver using the Family1st GPS Tracker?

allows you to view trip & travel history, driving habits, and get instant alerts on your device.

What are Geofences and how do they work?

Geofences are virtual boundaries that you can set up around a certain location. When you opt to
receive Geofence alerts and create virtual boundaries, you will receive alerts whenever the GPS
tracker enters or quits these predefined areas, helping you to monitor movements more effectively.

Can I monitor driving behaviors with the Family1st GPS Tracker?

Yes, our GPS tracker provides a detailed, customizable trip report, which can be downloaded as well.
These insights can help you identify the route taken.

What is included in the Track history?

The Track History displays the route taken and the speed at which the vehicle was driven. The
history for this report does not exceed 30 days.

What alerts and notifications will I get?

directly through the Family1st Pro app. The process is user-friendly and can be tailored to meet
your specific monitoring needs.

What app is used for this tracker? How do I get a username and password?

password will be the same used at the time of activation.

Issue management is a normal executive activity, done according to schedule in office hours while

## **How does an issue become a crisis?**

A crisis poses a clear and present danger to a company’s brand and operations. Crises are sudden

An issue is when a pilot realises the plane’s undercarriage has a problem after take-off but there

Do I need a smartphone?

Can I return it?

We’re so confident that the Tranquil Watch will deliver the care and peace of mind that you’re looking for, you can try it for 30 days and return it for FREE with a full refund if it’s not right for you!

How does the subscription work?

GPS watches with call functions need to access cellular data to work correctly.
Like your cell phone needs credit or a data plan, your subscription fee covers the cost of a network connection.
The subscription also includes unlimited, lightning-fast tech support and customer service that’s available 7 days a week.
You can choose from a monthly or annual subscription plan above, which can be cancelled any time!

Do you offer support with setup?

Absolutely! Our setup videos are sent to your inbox and guide you through every step from getting started to daily use.
Our expert team is on hand 7 days a week to assist with any queries you have after your purchase. We’re here to help.

How long does the battery last?

Unlike other GPS trackers for seniors, the tranquil watch uses state-of-the-art technology that means it will last an average of a week without needing a recharge .
The device updates its location every 2 minutes when moving and has an ’emergency tracking mode’ where it updates every 30 seconds, for if they ever go missing.
This is based on normal daily use, with the wearer going out of the home for a few hours per day.

What’s the range?

The Tranquil GPS watch can be tracked from anywhere in the world , as long as your smartphone has an internet connection.
The watch will work anywhere in the USA wherever there is cell coverage.

Is it waterproof?

Yes, the Tranquil GPS watch is IP67 level waterproof meaning it can be completely submerged in up to 1m (3.2ft) of water for up to 30 minutes.
It doesn’t have to be removed for showering, bathing or swimming.

How do I charge it?

Your Tranquil watch includes a charging cradle. Simply plug this into a wall outlet and rest the watch on the cradle to charge.
A light will let you know that it is charging. It takes less than 2 hours for the battery to fully recharge.

Why is it more expensive than other GPS trackers?

The quality, performance and design is far better than anything else on the market.
Battery Life: Lasting 7 days vs 1 day means you can relax without the worry the battery will die when you need it most.
Waterproofness: It can be worn in the bath, shower or pool with no worries about damage.
Design: The sleek look and feel means your loved one is much more likely to be happy wearing it.
There is a 30 day risk-free trial, so why not give it a try? You have nothing to lose !

# About Galaxy Medical Alert Systems

## Galaxy Medical Alert Systems

> With over 25 years of expertise in the alarm and security industries, our company has become one
> of the leading providers of medical alert systems for seniors and at-risk individuals across North
> America. The safety and care of a loved one is something we take very seriously. We treat every
> customer as if they were part of our own family.

### What We Offer

##### Galaxy Medical Alert Systems offers a variety of medical alert systems to ageing and at-risk
##### individuals. Our company firmly believes that everyone should be able to enjoy the freedom of
##### independent living and that this can be achieved with the security and peace of mind of a
##### personal medical alert system.

### Why Galaxy Medical Alert Systems?

We value honesty, integrity, respect, and most of all trust.
* ##### First-rate 24/7 emergency medical monitoring services
* ##### Modern and reliable personal medical alert technology
* ##### Expertly trained and certified emergency medical technicians
* ##### Emergency medical support in over 150 languages
* ##### Galaxy Medical Alert Systems Response Center is a CSAA Five Diamond certified monitoring
##### center

### Medical Alert Systems Are Ideal For:
* ##### Individuals that live alone
* ##### Individuals that require special assistance
* ##### Ageing individuals that remain in their own homes
* ##### Individuals with medical conditions

# About Galaxy Medical Alert Systems

## Galaxy Medical Alert Systems

> With over 25 years of expertise in the alarm and security industries, our company has become one
> of the leading providers of medical alert systems for seniors and at-risk individuals across North
> America. The safety and care of a loved one is something we take very seriously. We treat every
> customer as if they were part of our own family.

### What We Offer

##### Galaxy Medical Alert Systems offers a variety of medical alert systems to ageing and at-risk
##### individuals. Our company firmly believes that everyone should be able to enjoy the freedom of
##### independent living and that this can be achieved with the security and peace of mind of a
##### personal medical alert system.

### Why Galaxy Medical Alert Systems?

We value honesty, integrity, respect, and most of all trust.
* ##### First-rate 24/7 emergency medical monitoring services
* ##### Modern and reliable personal medical alert technology
* ##### Expertly trained and certified emergency medical technicians
* ##### Emergency medical support in over 150 languages
* ##### Galaxy Medical Alert Systems Response Center is a CSAA Five Diamond certified monitoring
##### center

### Medical Alert Systems Are Ideal For:
* ##### Individuals that live alone
* ##### Individuals that require special assistance
* ##### Ageing individuals that remain in their own homes
* ##### Individuals with medical conditions

#### Home Cellular System:
* User-friendly and easy to install
* Uses 3G/4G/LTE technology
* Ideal for individuals who spend most of their time at home
* Protection during an emergency without a traditional phone line
* Offers increased speed, accuracy, reliability, and durability when contacting the Galaxy Medical
Alert Response Centre during an emergency
* Designed by experts to provide the highest quality sound and clearest live two-way voice
communication
* 24/7 medical monitoring

#### Other Features:
* Two-way speaker capability, ultra-sensitive microphone
* Bluetooth capability for connecting devices
* Backup battery – min. 24 hours of continuous operation
* Activity/inactivity timers
* Multi language vocal reminders
* LED indications for system status
* Pairing button to easily add system peripherals
* Emergency help button (pendant/necklace or bracelet)
* Lockbox included
* Paramedic Fridge Magnet

The weight and dimensions of the base unit are listed below.
**Weight:** 1.23lb. (0.56kg), including batteries
**Dimensions (H x W x D):** 153 x 153 x 72 mm (6 x 6 x 2.9 in)
**Mounting:** desktop

#### Voice Extender
* A great option for individuals with limited or no mobility, allowing caretakers or a monitoring
station to communicate easily with the resident through voice only
* Works by recognizing a specific spoken phrase and triggering an alarm
* Multiple communicators can be installed throughout the home
* The voice extender unit is available as a wall mount with a pull cord or a desk mount, and can
also be activated with a voice command of “Call911 Call911”.

#### Stationary Panic Button
* Secured, wireless emergency button permanently installed at a specific location
* Can be placed anywhere around the house (living room, bedroom, bathroom, etc.), avoid exposure to
water
* Install using mounting tape (double-sided adhesive) or with screws through the support holes in
the mounting-base

#### What’s in the Box:

The system has been fully tested to ensure it is ready to use right out of the box. Inside the box
will be:
* Home Cellular System unit
* Power pack connected to the main unit
* Personal help button
* 1 voice extender (desktop or wall mounted)
* Lockbox – code pre-setup and programmed
* Paramedic fridge magnet
* Installation guide
* Paperwork to be filled out and returned to Galaxy Medical Alert Systems

# Mobile System with GPS & Fall Detection

From: $49.95 / month

[[Mobile System with GPS & Fall Detection]][33]

#### Includes:
* Free Shipping
* Free Lock Box
* Free Paramedic Fridge Magnet
* Free Equipment

##### **Annual plans receive 2 months of service for free!**

[https://www.galaxymedicalalert.com/wp-content/uploads/Galaxy-Mobile-System-With-GPS-Fall-Detection.
mp4][34]

#### Mobile System with GPS & Fall Detection:
* Easy to use and install
* Attractive, lightweight help button that can be worn on a lanyard or belt
* ONE button activation and/or automatic fall detection
* Instant hands-free communication
* Ideal for individuals that spend the majority of their time on the go
* 4G LTE cellular technology
* Automated fall detection – designed to detect a fall as soon as it happens
* After just 10 seconds, if there is no movement or tilt from horizontal to vertical positioning
detected, an unconsciousness alarm will be sent for medical help
* Automatic GPS location or Wi-Fi location
* 24/7 medical monitoring services from virtually anywhere

#### Other Features:
* Two-way voice communication with the Galaxy Medical Alert Response Centre
* Widespread functioning – help button works virtually anywhere
* lightweight and easy to wear or carry with the included lanyard and belt clip
* Exceptional voice quality with adjustable speaker and dual noise-canceling microphones for clear
communication
* a simple charging cradle to make recharging easy
* 6-16 days per charge, depending on operating mode
* IP67 water-resistant but should not be submerged
* device tracking, A-GPS and WIFI location services
* Broad range cellular connectivity: 4G LTE
* Low battery notifications
* a “ring” device setting to help find a lost or misplaced pendant
* Bluetooth pairing capabilities
* Lockbox included
* Paramedic fridge magnet
* iOnMom add on available (allows caregivers to monitor daily activity)

#### Help Button Information:
* **Weight of Button:** 1.3oz (35g)
* **Button Dimensions (mm):** 69 x 35 x 14.5 mm
* **Button Dimensions (in):** 2.72 x 1.38 x 0.57”

**Note: ** The Fall Detection pendant will not detect 100% of all falls. Always press the button on
the pendant to get help as soon as possible. The Fall Detection pendant has been designed and
recommended by the manufacturer to be worn on the outside of clothing for proper fall detection use.

#### What’s in the Box:

The system has been fully tested to ensure it is ready to use right out of the box. Inside the box
will be:
* Mobile System with GPS & Fall Detection unit
* Personal help button
* Lockbox – code pre-setup and programmed
* Paramedic fridge magnet
* Installation guide
* Paperwork to be filled out and returned to Galaxy Medical Alert Systems

[Download the Installation Guide][35]

### [Caregiver Mobile App]Optional Caregiver Mobile App Add-On:

The Caregiver mobile app offers increased peace of mind for subscribers and their loved ones by
offering helpful information at a glance.

With the app, caregivers can:
* Locate the device on demand
* Ring the device to help find misplaced units
* Receive app notifications for button presses, falls, low battery, power off, and first motion of
the day
* View button press history
* Check device battery level
* Check the device’s first motion of the day and set a target first motion time
* Track steps and set a daily step goal

#### Shipping Policy:

We will ship all medical alert systems and/or components free of charge, through a carrier of our
choice, to customers located in Canada. All products will be shipped during regular business hours:
Monday – Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. EST. Orders received before 3 p.m. EST will be shipped
out the same day. Galaxy Medical Alert Systems Ltd. will not be responsible for any delivery delays
by third party delivery services.

watch to get help as soon as possible. The Fall Detection watch has been designed and recommended by

The Mobile Alert Watch is a lightweight, easy-to-use On Go device containing Fall Detection alert
designed for individuals who live an active lifestyle and want protection wherever they go.

outdoors using advanced 4G LTE cellular, 3G, 2G technology. With built-in GPS and Wi-Fi location
services, users can connect to the 24/7 Galaxy Medical Alert Response Centre from virtually
anywhere.

The device offers instant, hands-free two-way communication, allowing users to speak directly with
trained emergency operators at the press of a button. In addition to emergency assistance, the watch
includes state of the art monitoring features such as heart rate (BPM), blood pressure, blood oxygen
and step counting — all accessible through a simple touch interface.

The Home Cellular Medical Alert System is a reliable, easy-to-use emergency response system designed
for individuals who spend most of their time at home and want immediate access to help in case of an
emergency.

Unlike traditional systems, this unit does not require a landline. It uses secure cellular
(3G/4G/LTE) technology to connect you directly to the Galaxy Medical Alert Response Centre at the
press of a button.

Whether it’s a fall, sudden illness, or any situation where help is needed quickly, trained
emergency operators are available 24/7 to assess the situation and dispatch assistance.
* Senior citizens and elderly individuals living independently
* Individuals with limited mobility or balance issues
* People recovering from surgery or medical procedures
* Individuals with chronic conditions such as heart disease, diabetes, or respiratory issues
* People living alone who want added peace of mind
* Individuals with hearing or vision impairments
* Anyone who may be at risk of falls or medical emergencies at home

photographic or digital records as an alternative to physical retention samples for parallel traded

06.07.2026

[How to (not) use AI for GxP Inspection Responses][191]

In a recent blog post, the U.K. MHRA has outlined examples of responses to inspection reports that
were generated by artificial intelligence (AI), which, in some cases, contain alarming errors.

[Read more][192]

06.07.2026

[Q&As on "GMP meets AI - How to Use Artificial Intelligence in Quality Assurance and Quality
Control"][193]

In February, more than 80 people participated in the Live Online Training organized by the ECA on
the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Quality Assurance and Quality Control. During the Q&A
sessions, numerous interesting questions were asked, which were answered by the presenters. We have
compiled a selection of these questions and answers for you.

## WHO ARE WE?

Every day, at Ziqitza Healthcare Limited (ZHL), we come across medical cases that truly move us,
most of them with the need for urgent medical care. There is only one true way of providing it - to
always be prepared, to be equipped, and to be committed.

Our brand name Ziqitza ( jigyasa + chikitsa) sums up beautifully our efforts to provide the best in
urgent medical response care to those who need it the most ANYWHERE in India be it in rural, urban,
corporates or hospitals. Our motto is that We Commit to Care, Aspire to be the Best, Revolutionize
Services and to Expand our service reach.

We, at Ziqitza, understand that much can be done to save lives in the spur of the moment and
endeavor to deliver prompt services with just one call. Our services include Ambulances, Medical
Helplines, Mobile Medical Units and Corporate Health Solutions ranging from ambulance/ doctor/
medical room which are tailored to provide the best in Emergency Medical Response to patients and
clients.

##### to make sure your loved one is OK.

##### Talk to Joy now:

### [1-415-569-2439][13]
* No apps, no setup — just daily phone calls to check in when you can’t.
* Conversations, games & reminders to keep their mind sharp.
* Daily summaries & alerts so you always know they’re okay.
