# The Nagios Team

## 25+ Years Of Monitoring

Launched in 1999 by founder Ethan Galstad, Nagios has been through a number of incredible changes
over the years. Projects have evolved, team members have changed, products have been launched,
conferences have been held, and history has been made. Ethan continues to lead the commercial and
community aspects of Nagios through different endeavors.

[Ethan Galstad]

# Nagios Books

Check out these Nagios publications and gain advanced insight into
configuration methods and advanced features of Nagios
Several books have been written about Nagios over the years. Some authors have worked at Nagios,
others are simply enthusiasts. All of them are experts. Check out this list of books we compiled of
some of the best Nagios reads out there.
[BooksITGuy]

## Nagios Core Administration Cookbook – Second Edition

Packt Publishing has released [Nagios Core Administration Cookbook – Second Edition][43] written by
Tom Ryder in February of 2016

Packt Publishing is offering **40%** discount to our visitors. Use discount code **NAGIOS40**

[CoreCookbook jpg]

## Learning Nagios – Third Edition

Packt Publishing has released [Learning Nagios – Third Edition][44] written by Wojciech Kocjan &
Piotr Beltowski in August of 2016

Packt Publishing is offering **40%** discount to our visitors. Use discount code **NAGIOS40**

[LearningNagios]

## Learning Nagios 4

Packt Publishing has released [Learning Nagios 4][45] written by Wojciech Kocjan in March of 2014.

Packt Publishing is offering **40%** discount to our visitors. Use discount code **NAGIOS40**

[LearningNagios4 jpg]

## Nagios: Building Enterprise-Grade Monitoring Infrastructures for Systems and Networks

Prentice Hall has released [Nagios: Building Enterprise-Grade Monitoring Infrastructures for Systems
and Networks][46] written by David Josephsen in March of 2013.

[NagiosBuildingEnterpriseGrade jpg]

## Nagios Core Administration Cookbook

Packt Publishing has released [Nagios Core Administration Cookbook][47] written by Tom Ryder in
January of 2013.

Packt Publishing is offering **40%** discount to our visitors. Use discount code **NAGIOS40**

[CoreAdminCookbook jpg]

## Instant Nagios Starter

Packt Publishing has released [Instant Nagios Starter][48] written by Michael Guthrie in May of
2013.

Packt Publishing is offering **40%** discount to our visitors. Use discount code **NAGIOS40**

[instant Nagios Starter]

## Learning Nagios 3.0

Packt Publishing has released [Learning Nagios 3.0][49] written by Wojciech Kocjan in October of
2008.

Packt Publishing is offering **40%** discount to our visitors. Use discount code **NAGIOS40**

[LearningNagios3 jpg]

## Integrated Monitoring With Nagios (Japanese)

Shogo Sato has written a book on Nagios in Japanese called [Nagios 統合監視［実践］リファレンス][50]
(roughly translated “Nagios Integrated Monitoring”).

[Nagiosjapanese jpg]

## Nagios 3 Pour la Supervision et la Métrologie (French)

Shogo Sato has written a book on Nagios in Japanese called [Nagios 統合監視［実践］リファレンス][51]
(roughly translated “Nagios Integrated Monitoring”).

[PraxibuchNagios jpg]

## Praxisbuch Nagios (German)

Tobias Scherbaum has written a book on Nagios called [Praxisbuch Nagios][52].

[PraxibuchNagios2 1 jpg]

## NAGIOS et la Supervision Open Source (French)

Olivier Jan, a key organizer of the Nagios community in France, has written a book on Nagios called
[NAGIOS et la supervision Open Source][53].

[nagiosbook jpg]

## Nagios 3 Enterprise Network Monitoring

Several Nagios community members have contributed to a new book published by Syngress titled
“[Nagios 3 Enterprise Network Monitoring”][54].

[nagiosbook2 jpg]

## Linux Administration Handbook

Nagios is recommended on page 665-666 of the [Linux Administration Handbook, 2nd Edition.][55]
Thanks to Jon Fox for bringing this to our attention.

[nagiosbook3 jpg]

## Building a Monitoring Infrastructure With Nagios

David Josephsen has written a book about Nagios titled “[Building a Monitoring Infractructure With
Nagios][56]”. Click here for more information.

[nagiosbook4 jpg]

## Nagios 2.0 – Beginning to System and Network Monitoring

Shogo Sato has written an book about Nagios titled “Nagios 2.0 – Beginning to system and network
monitoring”. The book is written in Japanese and covers installation, configuration, monitoring
difference services (HTTP, SMTP..) and resources (Load, Processes..). Additionally, the book talks
about integrating Nagios with other software such as pukiwiki, snmptt, and perfparse. More
information can be found [here][57].

[nagiosbook6 jpg]

## Nagios: System and Network Monitoring

Wolfgang Barth has written an excellent book on Nagios titled “Nagios: System and Network
Monitoring”. The chapters cover a variety of topics in detail and I have no doubt that the book will
act as a valuable resource to new and seasoned Nagios users alike. [Check it out!][58]

[nagiosbook7 jpg]

## Pro Nagios 2.0

James Turnbull has written a book titled “Pro Nagios 2.0” which describes how to architect Nagios
installations, deploy agents and plug-ins, and monitor a variety of assets. It also covers
information on how to integrate Nagios with other OSS applications like MRTG and Snort. Click
[here][59] for more information.

[nagiosbook5 jpg]

## Netzwerke mit Linux

Klaus Rodewig has written a book titled “Netzwerke mit Linux” which covers professional networking
with Linux. Chapter 7 of the book covers installation, configuration and use of Nagios. The Appendix
contains commented configuration-directives of Nagios files: nagios.cfg, cgi.cfg and directives for
object templates.

[nagiosbook8 jpg]

## The Nagios Book

Chris Burgess has written “The Nagios Book”, which walks users through the process of setting up a
Nagios installation from scratch. The book is available for free download – in both PDF and HTML
format – [here][60].

[TheNagiosBookOrg]

## Time Management for System Administrators

Nagios gets a mention in Chapter of Tom Limoncelli’s book titled “[Time Management for System
Administrators][61]” (published by O’Reilly). The book was published in November, 2005. Thanks to
L?szl? Garz? and Joshua Hunter for bringing this to my attention.

[TimeManagement]

## Nagios: System- und Netzwerk-Monitoring

Wolfgang Barth wrote a book on Nagios titled[ Nagios: System- und Netzwerk-Monitoring][62] for Open
Source Press. The book was published in November, 2005 in German.

[NagiosSystemUndNetzwerk jpg]

## Network Administrators Survival Guide

Nagios is mentioned in chapter 5 of a Cisco Press book titled [Network Administrators Survival
Guide][63]. The book was published in October, 2005. Thanks to Anand Deveriya for bringing this to
my attention.

[nagiosbook9 jpg]

## Essential SNMP, Second Edition

Nagios is mentioned in the second edition of O’Reilly’s “[Essential SNMP][64]“. The book was written
by Douglas Mauro and Kevin Schmidt and published in September, 2005.

[EssentialSNMP jpg]

## Mastering FreeBSD and OpenBSD Security

Nagios is briefly mentioned in the chapter 4 of O’Reilly’s “[Mastering FreeBSD and OpenBSD
Security][65]“. Readers are taken through Nagios installation and high-level configuration of both
the server component and remote checks using NRPE. The book was written by Yanek Korff, Paco Hope
and Bruce Potter and was published in March, 2005.

[FreeBSD jpg]

## Network Security Hacks

Nagios is mentioned in the first 8 pages in chapter 5 of O’Reilly’s “[Network Security Hacks][66]“.
The book was written by Andrew Lockhart and published in April, 2004. Thanks to Michael Wise for
brining this to my attention.

[nagiosbook10 jpg]

## Open Source Network Administration

Nagios is covered (along with other open source network admin packages) in a book by James Kretchmar
titled “[Open Source Network Administration][67]“. The book was published in October, 2003.

[Nagiosbook11]

## Automating UNIX and Linux Administration

Nagios is mentioned in a book by Kirk Bauer titled “[Automating UNIX and Linux Administration][68]“.
The book was published in September, 2003. Thanks to Claire Connelly for bringing this to my
attention.

[nagiosbook12 jpg]

## Essential System Administration, 3rd Edition

Nagios/Netsaint is mentioned on pages 503 to 511 of O’Reilly’s [Essential System Administration, 3rd
Edition][69]. The book was published in August, 2002. Thanks to Marco Ramos for bringing this to my
attention.

[essentialSystem3 jpg]

## Building Internet Firewalls, 2nd Edition

Nagios/NetSaint is mentioned in O’Reilly’s [Building Internet Firewalls, 2nd Edition][70]. Published
in June of 2000.

[Firewalls jpg]

# What Is Nagios?

Nagios builds industry-leading monitoring solutions that help organizations ensure the health,
performance, and reliability of their IT infrastructure. With Nagios monitoring tools, you can
proactively detect issues, receive instant Nagios alerts, and maintain optimal performance across
servers, networks, applications, and critical services.

[ Explore Nagios Projects ][43]
[ Request a Demo ][44]

## About Nagios Enterprises

Nagios began in 1999, when Ethan Galstad developed the open-source Nagios Core engine for IT
infrastructure monitoring. What started as a solution to monitor network services has evolved into
the world’s most trusted monitoring platform.

Today, [Nagios Enterprises][45] sponsors and supports the open-source monitoring tool while offering
commercial products that extend the power of Naigos Core with advanced visualization, automation,
reporting, and enterprise governance.

Our mission is to make IT environments more stable, more predictable, and easier to manage for teams
of all sizes.

[ [NagiosFullLogo CoreWhite] ][46] Official Nagios Logo

## Built by the Community, For the Community

Open source means open collaboration. From plugins to full-scale integrations, the Nagios Community
powers innovation and reliability across IT infrastructures worldwide. Join the conversation, share
your expertise, and help shape the future of open-source monitoring.

# The Nagios Team

## 25+ Years Of Monitoring

Launched in 1999 by founder Ethan Galstad, Nagios has been through a number of incredible changes
over the years. Projects have evolved, team members have changed, products have been launched,
conferences have been held, and history has been made. Ethan continues to lead the commercial and
community aspects of Nagios through different endeavors.

[Ethan Galstad]

# About Us

We partner with managed care organizations to provide innovative healthcare solutions designed to
drive growth, improve outcomes, reduce costs, and delight members.

###### At a glance

## Who We Are
* With our roots in Plantation, Florida, we extend our reach across the nation, with outposts in
Florida, Nevada, Tennessee, Michigan, Pennsylvania, and Texas.
* We are ranked as one of the fastest growing companies for delivering innovative health
technologies in North America.
* With 3,000+ employees across all locations, we continue to create professional opportunities for
career growth.

##### Mission

Our mission is to help our customers achieve a better quality of life through supplemental benefit
solutions.

##### Core Values

Innovation, Trust, Quality, Commitment, Passion, Integrity, Diversity

###### nationwide

## Our Locations

Texas.

# Home

## 100 Million Happier, Healthier Birthdays

Together, we've already improved the lives of 40 million older adults. Now, we're building on that
momentum with a bold new goal: Creating 100 million happier, healthier birthdays by 2040.

[See How We're Driving Change][115]

## Our Mission

Creating the conditions for everyone to age well.

NCOA delivers the resources, tools, best practices, and advocacy our nation needs to ensure every
person can age with health and financial security—advancing our vision of 100 million happier,
healthier birthdays by 2040.

### Our Work

For more than 75 years, NCOA has driven change that helps people age with health, financial
security, and independence—and we're just getting started.

[Discover how we make a difference][116]
[A group of older adults is participating in a fitness class in a gymnasium. They are standing and
smiling, with chairs spaced out around them for support. The foreground features a woman with curly
hair wearing a black t-shirt and pink patterned pants, smiling at the camera. The gym has a wooden
floor and large windows in the background.]

### Our Promise

We believe every person deserves the opportunity to age well. Learn what guides our work and how
we're creating lasting change.

[Read our commitment to change][117]
[An older woman named Pat, wearing glasses and a patterned blouse, stands at the forefront of a
classroom setting with a smile. Behind her, several other older adults are seated at a long table,
engaged in an activity involving colorful materials. The room has bright lighting and educational
posters on the walls.]

## For every $1 raised, 93¢ supports NCOA programs that advance healthier, more secure aging.

[Donate][118][More Ways to Support NCOA][119]


## Our Partners Help Make Our Work Possible

Creating healthier, more secure futures takes collaboration. NCOA works with corporate partners and
foundations to expand our reach, accelerate impact, and help more people age well in every
community.

Ready to make a greater impact together?

[Partner with NCOA][120]
[Two people are wearing blue Nationwide shirts, where the shirt has the company's logo and the shirt
says 'Doing great things together.']

Giving people, their families, and caregivers a feeling of confidence and safety is what Numera® personal emergency response system (PERS) products are all about. Whether you are an active senior, a lone worker, or someone concerned about personal security, you can go about your daily life with the assurance that help is always within reach.

Hundreds of thousands of people trust Numera’s advanced medical alert devices across the U.S. and Canada. With 4G, GPS, and industry-leading fall detection technology, the Libris Aura™ mPERS and Home Safety Hub give customers the freedom to live independently and age in place safely. The EverThere® portal keeps caregivers connected and reassured, while lone workers and employers benefit from enhanced safety and reduced liability. Each device links directly to a monitoring center, ensuring emergency services are alerted the moment they’re needed.

Numera® solutions deliver more than protection – they empower independence, peace of mind, and support virtually everywhere, all from a single medical alert device.

Aging in Place

Libris Aura™ with EverThere® gives seniors the confidence to live independently, at home or on the go. Caregivers stay connected and reassured, knowing help is always within reach.

FALL DETECTION

With advanced multi-sensor technology and a new barometric sensor, Libris Aura™ delivers the industry’s most accurate fall detection. 4G LTE connectivity ensures users have instant access to trained operators, 24/7.

PROACTIVE WELLNESS

With one touch, emergency help is on the way. Libris Aura™ combines alert services, GPS location tracking, and real-time event notifications to keep family members and healthcare providers informed and connected.

Lone Workers

For retail, delivery, and warehouse employees, Libris Aura™ offers immediate protection and peace of mind. With two-way voice, discreet alert options, and companion wearables, workers can request help openly or in silent mode, ensuring safety in any situation.

COVERT HELP

In sensitive situations, Aura’s silent mode allows users to request help discreetly. Audio and visual cues are suppressed, ensuring an emergency call can be placed without drawing attention.

DISCREET WEARABLE OPTIONS

Aura also pairs with a discreet companion pendant, giving workers flexible, low-profile options for requesting assistance. Monitoring centers can dispatch help immediately and provide critical insight for security and law enforcement.

Personal Security

In today’s world, staying safe matters more than ever. Libris Aura™ offers reliable protection at home, on the road, or while traveling, ensuring you and your loved ones are never alone in an emergency.

AT HOME AND ON THE MOVE

With 4G LTE connectivity and GPS-enabled location services, Libris Aura™ delivers fast, accurate response wherever you are. Coverage across leading carrier networks ensures help can always find you.

PEACE OF MIND

At the touch of a button, Libris Aura™ connects you with trained operators who can dispatch emergency personnel to your exact location. Whether you’re fall-prone, traveling, or simply seeking added security, Aura provides confidence and peace of mind for you and those who care about you.

# 8″ Dual-Drive Powered Sub w/ 200W Amp – Black

No music or movie experience is complete without bass, but in many cases there’s just no room for a
subwoofer. Well, not for an average subwoofer—but the FS8 is no average subwoofer. With an 8-inch
driver, an 8-inch passive radiator and a 200-watt amp, this tiny sub puts out serious couch-shaking
power.

## Description

Big boom for small rooms.
The FS8 is the perfect subwoofer for places where you never thought you could use a subwoofer. Like
bedrooms, designer living rooms and home offices. At less than 14 inches on its longest side, the
FS8 can easily hide behind couches, sit under end tables or nestle in a corner.

Yet there’s nothing tiny about the FS8’s performance. We gave it an 8-inch composite driver with an
extra-wide surround to increase the cone excursion, which dramatically increases deep bass power. We
powered the driver with a 200-watt Class D amp, and added an 8-inch passive radiator to reinforce
the deepest bass notes. The result is a minisub with serious slam—and a fast, musical sound that’ll
thrill both audiophiles and action-movie fans.

# 12″ Dual-Drive Powered Sub w/ 300W Amp – Black

The FS12 is built to blow you away. It’s the best, most powerful free-standing subwoofer we’ve ever
made, with a 300-watt RMS Class D digital amplifier, a seriously beefed-up 12-inch composite cone
woofer and a 12-inch passive radiator to beef up the low bass notes. It’s the perfect sub for
state-of-the-art home theaters.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Features ][25]
* [ Specifications ][26]
* [ Other Specifications ][27]

## Description

Pure muscle in a compact design.
When we designed the FS12, we wanted it to beat every sub we’ve ever made—and not just by a few dB.
We’re confident that when you hear how the FS12 can shake the couch with deep bottom end, while also
pulling out every little bass detail in even the most delicate music recordings, you’ll be totally
blown away.

How’d we do it? Sheer muscle. The FS12 has a 12-inch composite driver with an extra-wide surround
that lets the cone move further and produce more output. It’s driven by a 300-watt Class D amp—and
that’s RMS, not the “peak power” rating many subs use. A passive radiator reinforces the deep bass
and keeps the size down to less than 17 inches on the sub’s longest side.

## Features

12″ Front-Firing Polypropylene-Coated Fiber Composite Woofer
12″ Down-Firing Passive Radiator

Type: Class D Amp

# Ceiling Speaker with 6-1/2″ Aluminum Woofer and 1″ Titanium Tweeter

The Protege C635 elevates in-ceiling sound to a higher level! It’s our first speaker to combine
aluminum and titanium. An 6½-inch aluminum cone woofer provides powerful, punchy deep bass, while a
1-inch titanium dome tweeter delivers some of the clearest, crispest highs you’ve ever heard. All
covered with a stealthy low-profile grille.

## Description

Aluminum + titanium = awesome sound. For the first time, Proficient combines aluminum and titanium
in the same speaker—and the result is musical magic! The Protege C635 mates the powerhouse deep bass
of a 6-1/2 inch aluminum cone with the crystalline highs of a 1-inch titanium dome tweeter.
Together, they deliver dynamic, detailed sound you never expected from a ceiling speaker. The C635
packs all the installation-friendly features you expect from Proficient. With 92 dB sensitivity and
100-watt power handling, it plays loud and clean from practically any amp. With bass to 40 Hz and
highs to 22 kHz, it delivers full-spectrum musical power. And our sleek, unique tweeter bridge and
magnetically attached low-profile grille make it one of the best-looking ceiling speakers ever.

C625TT Ceiling Speaker
The C625TT is the most affordable way to get Proficient-quality stereo sound. With a dual-voice-coil
woofer and dual tweeters, the C625TT reproduces both left and right stereo channels in a single,
easy-to-install in-ceiling speaker. Super-high sensitivity makes the C625TT compatible even with

Stereo doesn’t get any simpler.
The C625TT gives you stereo sound where mounting two speakers is impractical, such as in a hallway
or bathroom. Its 6½-inch polypropylene woofer has dual voice coils so it can reproduce left and
right stereo channels. Dual 1/2″ hard dome tweeters handle the high frequencies. Careful tuning from
our team of devoted audio enthusiast/engineers makes the C625TT a sweet-sounding little speaker.

You can use the C625TT with any amplifier, thanks to its high 92 dB sensitivity. A typical speaker
requires three times as much power! It’s easy to install, too, thanks to a sturdy dogleg mounting
system. All of our 6½-inch ceiling speakers use the same mounting template so you never have to

# 8″ Dual Voice Coil Graphite Woofer & Two Pivoting 1″ Aluminum Dome Tweeter

C825TT Ceiling Speaker
A stiff graphite-cone woofer makes the C825TT one of the world’s best-sounding single-point stereo
speakers. Because it reproduces both left and right channels of stereo sound, one C825TT can replace
two conventional stereo speakers. It’s an ideal choice for places where you don’t have the space or
need for two speakers.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

Superb stereo sound made simple.
With the C825TT in-ceiling speakers, you get truly great stereo sound even in tight spaces. It uses
a dual-voice-coil 8-inch woofer with the same graphite cone material found in many of our better
in-wall and in-ceiling speakers. The stiffness of the graphite gives you much less distortion,
extremely clear sound and a deep bass response down to 28 Hz.

The C825TT’s low-distortion 1-inch aluminum tweeters pivot so you can adjust the stereo effect.
Power handling of 150 watts means the C825TT can really crank out the sound for parties, while its
high sensitivity of 92 dB means it needs just one-third the power of a typical speaker. Tone
switches let you boost bass and/or treble by 3 dB. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# In-Wall Speakers with 6½” Polypropylene Woofers and 1″ Pivoting Silk-Dome Tweeters

The W672 offers an affordable way to get good sound in a budget installation. With satisfying deep
bass down to 36 Hz, high sensitivity for strong output from low-powered amplifiers, and a pivoting
tweeter for easy fine-tuning, the W672 is a great choice for countless multiroom audio and home
theater applications.

## Description

Building a cost-effective speaker like the W672 demands that we make all the right choices. Starting
with our sweet-sounding silk-dome tweeter, which pivots so you can get a little extra kick of treble
wherever you need it. To provide the lows, we chose a 6-1/2-inch polypropylene-cone woofer to
deliver deep, low-distortion bass down to 36Hz.

We know you might want to use the W672 with an inexpensive amplifier, so we make the most of every
watt. With 91 dB sensitivity, the W672 delivers 100 dB with only 8 watts of power! Its 8-ohm
impedance makes it easy to drive. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# In-Wall Speaker with 8″ Graphite Woofer, 1″ Pivoting Aluminum Tweeter and Tone Switches

The W802 sounds so great you won’t believe it’s an in-wall speaker. It combines a stiff, light
graphite-cone woofer with an outstanding aluminum-dome tweeter. The result is incredible bass
response—and a speaker you can drive to loud levels with any amplifier. The W802 makes an ideal
choice for demanding music listeners.

## Description

The W802’s super-stiff 8-inch graphite woofer gives you incredible deep bass response down to 28 Hz,
half an octave below the lowest note on an upright bass. Our 1-inch, low-distortion aluminum-dome
tweeter makes for a perfect match with the big woofer. Switches behind the grille boost the bass
and/or treble by +3 dB for fine-tuning.

With 150-watt power handling, the W802 is capable of volumes over 110 dB. Give it all the power
you’ve got and it won’t even flinch. And 92 dB sensitivity means the W802 gives you more than 100 dB
from just a 10-watt amplifier! A sturdy dogleg mechanism clamps the W802 into a wall with a turn of
a few screws. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

Here’s the ideal ceiling speaker for places where space is tight. The C501’s compact size lets it
fit almost anywhere—even in hallways and walk-in closets—yet its pivoting tweeter and high-quality

Compact, affordable and powerful.
The C501 squeezes into tight spaces where other ceiling speakers can’t fit. Its small size gives it

pivoting ½-inch polyamide hard dome tweeter produces clear highs.

Any amp or receiver can easily drive the C501. Its 8-ohm nominal impedance and unusually high 90 dB
sensitivity give you plenty of volume even with a low-powered multiroom amplifier. For small rooms,
hallways, kitchens, and even the surround channels of a compact media room home theater system, the

# In-Wall Subwoofer with 10-inch Neodymium-Magnet Driver and 250 Watts Power Handling

The IWS105 adds powerful bass to in-wall systems without taking up a single square inch of floor
space. By putting the neodymium magnet inside the speaker cone, we slimmed the woofer so the IWS105
fits flush in a wall. It sounds like a conventional sub, but it’s practically invisible. Add the M3
amplifier to complete your in-wall subwoofer system.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

Subwoofers. We love what they do for movies and music but hate the way they look. Proficient has the
answer: the IWS105 in-wall subwoofer. The IWS105 mounts flush like an in-wall speaker. How can we
get its big 10-inch pulp-fiber woofer to fit in a 3½-inch-deep wall cavity? By moving the powerful
neodymium magnet to the front.

To power the IWS105, use our M3 subwoofer amp. The M3 goes in your equipment rack and connects with
in-wall speaker cable. To get tighter bass and minimize transmission of sound into other rooms, add
the BB-IWS10 back box. No matter how you set it up, the IWS-10’s 36 Hz response and 250-watt power
handling ensure you’ll get great bass. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# Ceiling Speaker with 6-1/2″ Graphite Woofer and 1″ Pivoting Silk-Dome Tweeter

The C626 is a great mid-priced ceiling speaker, blending the high output of a graphite woofer with
the smooth, sweet sound of a silk-dome tweeter. High sensitivity and excellent power handling make
the C626 a superb choice for practically any room in the house, but especially for rooms where you
want the best sound.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

Step up to great graphite sound.
The C626 features one of our very best woofers, a 6½-inch model with a graphite-impregnated cone
that’s stiffer than paper or polypropylene. You get clearer sound with lower distortion, all the way
down to 45 Hz! A sweet-sounding, pivoting 1-inch silk-dome tweeter perfectly complements the
graphite woofer’s refined sound. It’s the ideal ceiling speaker for situations that demand
affordable high performance.

To make the C626 easy to drive for any amplifier, we gave it a forgiving 8-ohm impedance. We also
gave it a sensitivity of 91 dB, so you can run it at high volumes even with a low-powered amplifier.
It uses the same quick, sturdy mounting system and cutout template as our other 6½-inch models, too.
Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

set the switches, you’ll love the C641’s sound, thanks to its low-distortion graphite woofer and

IW530

# In-wall LCR speaker with dual 5¼” graphite woofers and pivoting 1″ aluminum tweeter

You’ll be blown away when you hear how good this compact in-wall LCR sounds—and even more blown away
when you see how little it costs. Dual 5¼-inch graphite woofers give the IW530 a natural and
powerful sound, and our thoughtful design lets you mount the speaker either vertically or
horizontally in the wall.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

Home theater enthusiasts want the dynamics of a big speaker system, but don’t always have the space
for one. The IW530 is perfect for them. Its stiff 5¼-inch graphite woofers have a punchy, dynamic
yet amazingly natural sound. The low-distortion aluminum tweeter pivots so you can direct the sound
where you need it.

Whether you mount it vertically or horizontally, the IW530 fits easily into a standard stud bay.
Tone switches give you ±3 dB adjustment of bass and treble—an extremely useful feature you don’t
usually see at this price point. There’s no easier or more affordable way to build a world-class yet
visually inconspicuous home theater sound system. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# Ceiling Speaker with 6-1/2″ Polypropylene Woofer and -3/4″ Fixed Soft-Dome Tweeter

The C606 is our most affordable 6½-inch ceiling speaker. It’s a perfect choice for applications
where good sound is desired but cost is a major factor. The C606 offers a great combination of sound
quality and ease of installation. High sensitivity makes the C606 easy for any amplifier to drive.
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

Bigger bass, smaller price.
You’ll be amazed when you hear how much sound our most affordable 6½-inch ceiling speaker puts out.
Its sturdy polypropylene woofer is the same type found in many high-quality bookshelf speakers. And
its ¾-inch soft-dome tweeter sounds surprisingly sweet—no surprise when you learn it was engineered
by the same team that designed our top in-wall, on-wall and bookshelf speakers.

The C606’s 90 dB sensitivity delivers high output even with low-powered multiroom audio amplifiers,
so you can get the same volume with about half the power. The C606’s forgiving 8-ohm impedance makes
it easy to drive with any amplifier. It also fits into the same cutout as all of our other 6½-inch
ceiling speakers do, so it’s easy to install. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# Ceiling Speaker with 6-1/2″ Polypropylene Woofer and 1″ Pivoting Soft-Dome Tweeter

The C612 delivers surprisingly good sound quality for its modest price. A pivoting soft-dome tweeter
handles the highs, and a 6½-inch polypropylene-cone woofer dishes out plenty of powerful bottom-end
bass. High sensitivity makes this speaker easy to drive even with low-powered amps.
* [ Description ][24]

## Description

The sweet spot for affordable sound.
The C612 delivers way beyond what you’d expect from such an affordable speaker. Its 6-1/2-inch
polypropylene woofer puts out deep bass down to 45Hz, while its 1-inch pivoting soft-dome tweeter
sings out with smoother treble than you’d expect from such an affordable speaker. You get true
party-level sound without a subwoofer!

With super-high 91 dB sensitivity, the C612 works great with any amplifier. Just 8 watts will get
this speaker up to 100 dB! The C612 also has an 8-ohm nominal impedance, so it’s an easy load for
any amplifier to drive. And for simpler installation, it uses the same mounting template as all of
Proficient Audio’s 6-1/2-inch ceiling speakers. Includes Thin-Bezel Grilles held by Neo Magnets.

# Indoor/outdoor single-point stereo speaker with 6½” woofer and two 1″ tweeters – White

The AW600TT is one of our most versatile speakers. Just one AW600TT delivers full stereo sound. The
speaker’s high efficiency and the impressive bass response of its 6½-inch polypropylene woofer give
satisfying performance from practically any amplifier. And because it’s weatherproof, you can use it
in the garage or even in the backyard!
* [ Description ][24]
* [ Specifications ][25]
* [ Other Specifications ][26]

## Description

All you need is one AW600TT to reproduce both the left and right channels from a stereo system. The
dual Supernil synthetic tweeters give you a spacious sound, and you can pivot them to make the sound
more focused or more diffused. The 6½-inch polypropylene woofer uses dual voice coils to reproduce
both stereo channels into a single driver, and deliver powerful bass down to 50 Hz.

Thanks to its rugged ABS molded enclosure and rustproof, powder-coated aluminum grille, the AW600TT
survives practically any hazards of the backyard: rain, snow, dust, heat, cold and even an
off-target football. Each speaker includes a swivel-mount bracket that can be attached to a wall,
under an eave or on a fence post.

# About OmniWarn Public Safety

[Home][19] > About OmniWarn

**OmniWarn Public Safety** provides emergency notification systems and warning sirens for various
situations such as severe weather, wildfires, and campus alerts. We offer turnkey [mass notification
solutions][20], handling everything from [warning system design][21] and [installation][22] to
[repair and maintenance][23] throughout the United States.

## Driven By Purpose.
## Powered By Safety.

**Our Mission**
At OmniWarn, our mission is encapsulated in our motto: “Alert Today. Alive Tomorrow.” We strive to
provide reliable and effective emergency notification solutions that protect lives and enhance
public safety across the United States.

**Our Vision**
We envision a safer world where advanced emergency communication technology empowers communities,
campuses, and organizations to respond quickly and confidently to any threat. As specialists in
public safety notification systems, OmniWarn strives to lead the industry in reliability, customer
service, and technical excellence.

**Our Core Values**
Our core values serve as the foundation for everything we do. They are not just words on a page—they
represent the beliefs and standards that shape how we operate, how we serve our clients, and how we
interact with one another. These values influence every decision we make, from the field to the
boardroom, and reflect the level of integrity, dedication, and accountability we expect from
ourselves and our team. The work we do carries real-world consequences, and we approach it with the
seriousness and commitment it deserves. Whether responding to an emergency, designing a custom
system, or supporting a long-term partner, our values guide us to deliver consistent, honest, and
results-driven service.

**Trust:** Confidence that your actions will align with our established processes and commitments —
without the need for constant oversight.

**Integrity:** Always do what’s right — without compromise. No matter the situation, the pressure,
or the outcome.

**Customer-First:** We support our customers with clarity and expertise, enabling them to make the
best decisions for the people and communities who depend on them.

[OmniWarn Founders]

## Our History & Growth

**Founded by professionals** with decades of experience in emergency communications and warning
system design, OmniWarn Public Safety began with a goal to modernize how communities and
organizations stay informed during critical events.

Over the years, OmniWarn has grown from a regional installer into a **nationwide provider** of mass
notification and outdoor warning siren systems. Our team has designed, installed, and maintained
systems for cities, universities, industrial facilities, and military bases across the United
States.

# About OmniWarn Public Safety

[Home][19] > About OmniWarn

**OmniWarn Public Safety** provides emergency notification systems and warning sirens for various
situations such as severe weather, wildfires, and campus alerts. We offer turnkey [mass notification
solutions][20], handling everything from [warning system design][21] and [installation][22] to
[repair and maintenance][23] throughout the United States.

## Driven By Purpose.
## Powered By Safety.

**Our Mission**
At OmniWarn, our mission is encapsulated in our motto: “Alert Today. Alive Tomorrow.” We strive to
provide reliable and effective emergency notification solutions that protect lives and enhance
public safety across the United States.

**Our Vision**
We envision a safer world where advanced emergency communication technology empowers communities,
campuses, and organizations to respond quickly and confidently to any threat. As specialists in
public safety notification systems, OmniWarn strives to lead the industry in reliability, customer
service, and technical excellence.

**Our Core Values**
Our core values serve as the foundation for everything we do. They are not just words on a page—they
represent the beliefs and standards that shape how we operate, how we serve our clients, and how we
interact with one another. These values influence every decision we make, from the field to the
boardroom, and reflect the level of integrity, dedication, and accountability we expect from
ourselves and our team. The work we do carries real-world consequences, and we approach it with the
seriousness and commitment it deserves. Whether responding to an emergency, designing a custom
system, or supporting a long-term partner, our values guide us to deliver consistent, honest, and
results-driven service.

**Trust:** Confidence that your actions will align with our established processes and commitments —
without the need for constant oversight.

**Integrity:** Always do what’s right — without compromise. No matter the situation, the pressure,
or the outcome.

**Customer-First:** We support our customers with clarity and expertise, enabling them to make the
best decisions for the people and communities who depend on them.

[OmniWarn Founders]

## Our History & Growth

**Founded by professionals** with decades of experience in emergency communications and warning
system design, OmniWarn Public Safety began with a goal to modernize how communities and
organizations stay informed during critical events.

Over the years, OmniWarn has grown from a regional installer into a **nationwide provider** of mass
notification and outdoor warning siren systems. Our team has designed, installed, and maintained
systems for cities, universities, industrial facilities, and military bases across the United
States.

From early tornado warning sirens in Oklahoma to large-scale giant voice systems for government
agencies, our growth is fueled by a dedication to quality, service, and trust. Today, we’re proud to
serve as the factory-direct Federal Signal provider for six states and a trusted partner to
customers nationwide.

## Community Involvement & Safety Education

At OmniWarn, our commitment to safety extends beyond the systems we install. We’re dedicated to
educating and supporting the communities we serve. Our team regularly participates in public safety
workshops, emergency management conferences, and local preparedness events to help residents and
organizations understand how to respond effectively during emergencies.

We also partner with schools, municipalities, and emergency management agencies to provide
demonstrations and training on [tornado sirens][53], [flood warning systems][54], [lightning
detection systems][55], [wildfire warning systems][56], and alert software. By sharing our
expertise, we help ensure that everyone, from city officials to campus safety directors, knows how
to use these life-saving systems.

factory-trained and certified to install and maintain Federal Signal systems, and we adhere to all

all_classified.polished_summary: Paho, the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO), is dedicated to improving public health across the Americas by providing comprehensive resources and initiatives aimed at disease prevention, health system strengthening, and emergency response. The organization offers a range of services, including publications, data tools, and collaborative health initiatives, while targeting member states and communities to enhance health equity and address pressing health challenges. Through its commitment to innovation and evidence-based practices, PAHO plays a crucial role in promoting health and well-being throughout the region.

The company offers a comprehensive range of resources, including guides on paying for various types of care such as assisted living, memory care, and home care, as well as financial products and assistance options. Targeting seniors and their caregivers, Payingforseniorcare aims to simplify the complexities of eldercare financing and provide valuable insights into available support services.

# In Plain English

In Plain English is a global technology media company founded in 2018 by [Sunil Sandhu][66]. The
platform publishes accessible educational content about software development, artificial
intelligence, cloud computing, and modern technology, with the goal of making complex technical
topics easier for developers and technologists to understand.

The company operates a network of developer-focused publications on Medium, including [JavaScript In
Plain English][67], [Python In Plain English][68], [AI In Plain English][69], and [AWS In Plain
English][70]. These publications collectively reach a large global audience of developers and
technologists and have accumulated more than 400,000 followers, 100,000 published articles, and over
200 million views.

In addition to its publications on Medium, In Plain English also operates its own publishing
platform on its primary domain, where thousands of articles are hosted and distributed
independently. The site currently contains more than 4,000 articles, expanding the platform's reach
beyond Medium while allowing contributors and partner companies to syndicate technical content
directly.

## Editorial Focus

In Plain English covers a broad range of technical topics across the software development ecosystem.
Content published on the platform typically includes:
* programming tutorials and developer guides
* technical explainers and how to articles
* AI and machine learning news and updates
* cloud computing and infrastructure content
* developer tools and frameworks
* startup and engineering culture
* career advice for software engineers

The platform's editorial philosophy is centered on making complex technical topics accessible to a
wide audience of developers, from beginners learning their first programming language to experienced
engineers exploring new technologies.

## Contributor Community

In Plain English operates a community-driven publishing model. Writers from around the world can
create author accounts and contribute articles directly to the platform.

Contributors typically include:
* software engineers and developers
* startup founders and technical leaders
* developer advocates and technical writers
* companies publishing developer-focused content

Many contributors publish independent educational content, while others use the platform to
syndicate technical articles from company engineering blogs in order to reach a broader developer
audience.

# In Plain English

In Plain English is a global technology media company founded in 2018 by [Sunil Sandhu][66]. The
platform publishes accessible educational content about software development, artificial
intelligence, cloud computing, and modern technology, with the goal of making complex technical
topics easier for developers and technologists to understand.

The company operates a network of developer-focused publications on Medium, including [JavaScript In
Plain English][67], [Python In Plain English][68], [AI In Plain English][69], and [AWS In Plain
English][70]. These publications collectively reach a large global audience of developers and
technologists and have accumulated more than 400,000 followers, 100,000 published articles, and over
200 million views.

In addition to its publications on Medium, In Plain English also operates its own publishing
platform on its primary domain, where thousands of articles are hosted and distributed
independently. The site currently contains more than 4,000 articles, expanding the platform's reach
beyond Medium while allowing contributors and partner companies to syndicate technical content
directly.

## Editorial Focus

In Plain English covers a broad range of technical topics across the software development ecosystem.
Content published on the platform typically includes:
* programming tutorials and developer guides
* technical explainers and how to articles
* AI and machine learning news and updates
* cloud computing and infrastructure content
* developer tools and frameworks
* startup and engineering culture
* career advice for software engineers

The platform's editorial philosophy is centered on making complex technical topics accessible to a
wide audience of developers, from beginners learning their first programming language to experienced
engineers exploring new technologies.

## Contributor Community

In Plain English operates a community-driven publishing model. Writers from around the world can
create author accounts and contribute articles directly to the platform.

Contributors typically include:
* software engineers and developers
* startup founders and technical leaders
* developer advocates and technical writers
* companies publishing developer-focused content

Many contributors publish independent educational content, while others use the platform to
syndicate technical articles from company engineering blogs in order to reach a broader developer
audience.

This open publishing approach has enabled thousands of writers from around the world to contribute
technical knowledge and insights, helping the platform grow into one of the larger community driven
developer publications online.

## Global Reach

Today, In Plain English reaches readers in more than 200 countries and attracts millions of monthly
views from developers, engineers, students, and technology enthusiasts.

Developers rely on the platform to:
* learn new programming languages
* stay updated on emerging technologies
* discover developer tools and frameworks
* gain practical insights from working engineers

By combining large scale community contributions with a focus on clear, accessible technical
writing, In Plain English has established itself as a widely recognized source of developer
education and technical knowledge.

## Business Model

In Plain English operates primarily through developer marketing and content partnerships with
technology companies. Revenue is generated through:
* sponsored technical articles
* developer marketing campaigns
* promoted distribution across its publications
* advertising placements on its website

These partnerships allow technology companies to share technical knowledge, product tutorials, and
engineering insights with a large global developer audience while maintaining the platform's focus
on educational content.

In Plain English accepts guest posts and syndication. To publish or syndicate content, visit
[Publish with Us][71] or [buyers.circuit.ooo][72]. For collaborations, visit [Circuit (Developer
Marketing)][73].

# About Us

Falls are the leading cause of injuries and hospital admittances. Expensive hospital stays and
rehabilitation can keep you out of your home for months. To help protect and keep you independent,
Prime Medical Alert is pleased to provide you with 24/7 medical alert monitoring for that “just in
case” situation. With the push of a button, live help is immediately available.

## Prime Medical Alert always offers:
* Free Shipping
* No Contracts
* Lifetime Warranty
* No Hidden Fees
* Easy Setup
* Unlimited Usage

## How the Prime Medical Alert service works

**1. Summon Help**
Press your emergency help button any time to connect to our triple redundant, UL certified
monitoring facility. You can have unlimited emergency contacts, health information, and any other
additional information on file.

**2. Speak to an EMT Certified Emergency Operator**
Once you are connected with our monitoring center, a live EMT (emergency medical technician) will
assist you by either contacting your emergency contacts or directly dispatching a first responder.
Emergency contacts are always notified in the event of a dispatch.

**3. Press the Button and Help is on the Way**
Depending on your instructions, we will notify emergency services, family, friends, neighbors, or
anyone else on your list of emergency contacts. The operator stays on the line until help arrives.

Whether it’s our [high quality equipment][15], multiple options, or [low prices][16], we look
forward to providing you with the same peace-of-mind thousands already enjoy. Call now at
(800)-723-6442.

Falls are the leading cause of injuries and hospital admittances. Expensive hospital stays and
rehabilitation can keep you out of your home for months. To help protect and keep you independent,

* Free Shipping
* No Contracts

* Easy Setup
* Unlimited Usage

## How the Prime Medical Alert service works

**1. Summon Help**
Press your emergency help button any time to connect to our triple redundant, UL certified
monitoring facility. You can have unlimited emergency contacts, health information, and any other
additional information on file.

## About the Prime Medical Alert Product Line

[Medical-Alert-Product-Picture][Medical-Alert-Product-Picture]

Prime Medical Alert offers many different medical alert product solutions to meet your needs.
Whether you are looking for a simple product that comes in the form of a necklace or bracelet and
automatically tests daily, or a cellular medical alert product where you can get help wherever you
happen to be, Prime Medical Alert offers tailored solutions. All of our personal medical alert
products are backed by 24/7 certified EMT monitoring.

The individuals answering the calls are based in the United States and are accent neutral which is
extremely important during emergency situations. They are trained specifically to answer medical
alert product distress calls and can follow a customized protocol.

Some people prefer their contacts notified first before the emergency responders in the event they
can’t respond while others prefer an immediate dispatch with their contacts notified after. For all
of Prime Medical Alert’s products we keep relevant medical information on file to assist the first
responders during an emergency.

All of the products we offer are water resistant. This means they can be used in the shower, while
bathing, while doing the dishes, or doing any other activities that involve water. Even though the
eResponder is a truly cellular product, our other products can be retrofitted to work without a
phone line.

If you don’t have a phone line or are thinking of getting rid of your phone line, mention this to a
Prime Medical Alert product representative and they can ensure delivery of the appropriate medical
alert product.

# 24/7 Medical Alert Systems and Emergency Monitoring Services

SafeGuard personal medical alert systems and monitoring services assist seniors, individuals with
medical conditions and disabilities, and individuals living alone to live more active and
independent lifestyles. Our personal emergency response systems (PERS) are easy to use, affordable,
reliable, and can save lives. With emergency assistance at their fingertips, at-risk individuals
using our medical alert systems and monitoring services can feel safe and secure at all times of the
day.

At SafeGuard, we never take our customers’ trust for granted. We are always ready to help our
customers when they need assistance and we do this by selling reliable medical alert equipment and
by owning and operating our own Emergency Response Center.  We employ highly trained and certified
emergency care specialists with the knowledge and experience to effectively respond to emergency and
non-emergency situations 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Unlike many other medical alert companies
who rely on third party monitoring, we can provide an uncompromising commitment to customer
satisfaction and 24/7 emergency responsiveness through our privately owned and operated Emergency
Response Center.

With offices in Ontario, Michigan, and Florida, we can provide comprehensive solutions for medical
alert and monitoring services to our customers in North America. From medical alert systems that
work only in your home, to personal emergency response systems that can monitor your well-being
virtually anywhere you go, we offer the latest medical alert systems and monitoring services
available in our industry today.

# About Lisbeth Cano | SeniorCanvas.com

Whether you’re helping a parent stay safe at home or figuring out senior living options,
**SeniorCanvas.com** gives you clear, trusted guidance without the fluff.

## Meet Lisbeth Cano

**Clinical Researcher | Former Doctor | Elder Advocate**

[Lisbeth Cano]

Lisbeth joined SeniorCanvas.com after years of caring for older adults, first as a doctor in Costa
Rica, and now as a clinical researcher focused on aging. She’s seen what families go through up
close and is passionate about making senior care easier to understand and access.

> “I’ve worked with older adults in the clinic and in research, and I believe families deserve
> guidance that’s honest, practical, and truly helpful.”

## Why Listen to Lisbeth?

Lisbeth doesn’t just write from theory, she brings real-world experience from healthcare and
clinical research.
* Former practicing doctor in Costa Rica
* Experienced in elder-focused clinical research
* Advocate for aging with dignity and safety
* Writes and reviews most of the content herself

She breaks things down in a clear, honest way, without medical jargon or scare tactics.

## What SeniorCanvas Stands For

This site is for people who need answers, fast.
* Step-by-step checklists
* Real-world comparisons (not sponsored ads)
* Safety guides backed by real sources
* Honest help, not hype

We use data from trusted sources like [NIA][8], [CDC][9], [ACL][10], [Medicare.gov][11], and more.

> Our goal: **Help families make safer, smarter senior care choices.**

## How SeniorCanvas Helps

We organize everything by topic so you can find what you need fast.
* Home Safety: [/aging/home-safety/][12]
* Bathroom Upgrades: [/aging/bathroom-upgrades/][13]
* [Stairlifts][14], [Mobility Aids][15], [Medical Alerts][16]
* Memory and Dementia Help: [/living/memory-care/][17]
* [Caregiver Guides][18] and [Financial Planning][19]

## Questions or Feedback?

Want to suggest a topic or ask something directly?
* [**Reach out to Lisbeth and the team →**][20]

We’re building this to help you, and your parents, feel more prepared.

# About Lisbeth Cano | SeniorCanvas.com

Whether you’re helping a parent stay safe at home or figuring out senior living options,
**SeniorCanvas.com** gives you clear, trusted guidance without the fluff.

## Meet Lisbeth Cano

**Clinical Researcher | Former Doctor | Elder Advocate**

[Lisbeth Cano]

Lisbeth joined SeniorCanvas.com after years of caring for older adults, first as a doctor in Costa
Rica, and now as a clinical researcher focused on aging. She’s seen what families go through up
close and is passionate about making senior care easier to understand and access.

> “I’ve worked with older adults in the clinic and in research, and I believe families deserve
> guidance that’s honest, practical, and truly helpful.”

## Why Listen to Lisbeth?

Lisbeth doesn’t just write from theory, she brings real-world experience from healthcare and
clinical research.
* Former practicing doctor in Costa Rica
* Experienced in elder-focused clinical research
* Advocate for aging with dignity and safety
* Writes and reviews most of the content herself

She breaks things down in a clear, honest way, without medical jargon or scare tactics.

## What SeniorCanvas Stands For

This site is for people who need answers, fast.
* Step-by-step checklists
* Real-world comparisons (not sponsored ads)
* Safety guides backed by real sources
* Honest help, not hype

We use data from trusted sources like [NIA][8], [CDC][9], [ACL][10], [Medicare.gov][11], and more.

> Our goal: **Help families make safer, smarter senior care choices.**

## How SeniorCanvas Helps

We organize everything by topic so you can find what you need fast.
* Home Safety: [/aging/home-safety/][12]
* Bathroom Upgrades: [/aging/bathroom-upgrades/][13]
* [Stairlifts][14], [Mobility Aids][15], [Medical Alerts][16]
* Memory and Dementia Help: [/living/memory-care/][17]
* [Caregiver Guides][18] and [Financial Planning][19]

## Questions or Feedback?

Want to suggest a topic or ask something directly?
* [**Reach out to Lisbeth and the team →**][20]

We’re building this to help you, and your parents, feel more prepared.

Understanding Medical Alert Systems

Find out more on medical alert systems, and what  medical alert system best suits you and your lifestyle. Regain your independence and protect yourself from accidents and unfortunate falls.

In-Home Protection​

In-Home Protection means a medical alert system connected to your home with or without a landline telephone requirements.

On-The-Go Protection​

On-The-Go Protection means a personal emergency response action system with integrated WIFI or GPS system.

On-The-Go Active Seniors​

On-The-Go Protection means a portable medical alert device with both GPS and WiFi advanced location technologies meant for active seniors.

Best Medical Alerts   Understanding Medical Alerts

Top Medical Alert Companies

Since 1974, LifeCall is an American company with a long history of providing excellent monitoring services and efficient emergency alert systems to health care facilities catering to the elderly and individuals for use both indoors and on the go all over the United States.

Read The Review

Call Now

(866) 225-1295

LifeFone provides dependable medical alert systems designed to enhance safety and independence for seniors. With 24/7 emergency monitoring, users can easily connect to trained professionals in case of falls, accidents, or other emergencies. LifeFone offers both at-home and on-the-go options, ensuring seniors receive help quickly whenever they need it.

Read The Review

Pricing

Alert1 Medical Alert Systems delivers emergency response solutions for seniors, focusing on independence and safety. Their wearable devices, available for home and mobile use, connect users to 24/7 monitoring centers staffed by trained responders. With straightforward operation, Alert1 provides peace of mind for seniors and their families during unexpected situations.

Read The Review

Pricing

MobileHelp offers versatile medical alert systems with GPS-enabled devices for both home and mobile use, connecting users to 24/7 emergency monitoring services. Designed for active seniors, MobileHelp’s solutions provide safety and support on the go, ensuring help is accessible anytime, anywhere through easy-to-use wearable devices.

Read The Review

Pricing

Click Here For All Medical Alert Companies Reviews

Locate the Best Medical Alert System In Your Area

Understanding Medical Alert Systems

Find out more on medical alert systems, and what  medical alert system best suits you and your lifestyle. Regain your independence and protect yourself from accidents and unfortunate falls.

In-Home Protection​

In-Home Protection means a medical alert system connected to your home with or without a landline telephone requirements.

On-The-Go Protection​

On-The-Go Protection means a personal emergency response action system with integrated WIFI or GPS system.

On-The-Go Active Seniors​

On-The-Go Protection means a portable medical alert device with both GPS and WiFi advanced location technologies meant for active seniors.

# About

## What We Do

SENIORS BULLETIN was created on the straightforward notion that it is feasible to give great
solution as well as great care to all those who want to keep living life simply and stress-free.
SENIORS BULLETIN provides information to seniors and caregivers with the intent for them to make the
best informed decision. We are dedicated in giving best-in-class solutions. SENIORS BULLETIN is
constantly available and also happy to answer any kind of questions or concerns. To learn more, call
us.

## Who We Are

SENIORS BULLETIN is a diversified health and well-being affiliate company focused on improving
people’s lives through meaningful innovation in the area of healthcare and personal care via medical
alert systems.

SENIORS BULLETIN serves many subscribers, and continues to help customers obtain meaningful and
advanced healthcare and personal care solutions. We help individuals and families lead a more
comfortable, confident life. That is our mission.

# About SeniorsList

## Our Mission

SeniorsList exists to help older adults and their families make confident, informed decisions about
the products and services that affect their daily lives. We believe every senior deserves access to
clear, honest, and expert-vetted information — free from hidden agendas.

From medical alert systems and hearing aids to Medicare plans and home care providers, we research,
test, and review the options that matter most so you don't have to sift through marketing hype on
your own.

## What Sets Us Apart

Too many review sites accept pay-for-placement deals or rehash manufacturer spec sheets. We take a
different approach:
* **Independent editorial:** Affiliate partnerships never influence our ratings or which products we
recommend.
* **Hands-on testing:** Every product review is based on real-world use, not just specification
sheets.
* **Expert credentials:** Our writers hold certifications in senior care, health technology, and
gerontology.

## Our Team

SeniorsList is built by a small, dedicated team of writers, researchers, and advocates who are
passionate about improving the lives of older adults.

### Sarah Mitchell

Editor-in-Chief

Sarah brings over 15 years of experience in senior care advocacy and editorial leadership. A
Certified Senior Advisor (CSA) and former family caregiver, she ensures every piece of content meets
the highest standards of accuracy and compassion.

### David Chen

Senior Writer

David specializes in health technology and insurance topics. With a background in health sciences
research, he helps readers navigate complex decisions about medical devices, coverage options, and
emerging tech for older adults.

### Rachel Torres

Product Reviewer

Rachel personally purchases and tests every product we review, from medical alert systems to hearing
aids. Her hands-on approach and gerontology training ensure our recommendations reflect real-world
performance.

Have a question or want to get in touch? Visit our [contact page][16] or read our [editorial
guidelines][17] to learn more about how we work.

leadership.bio: Sarah brings over 15 years of experience in senior care advocacy and editorial leadership. A Certified Senior Advisor (CSA) and former family caregiver, she ensures every piece of content meets the highest standards of accuracy and compassion.

leadership.name: David Chen

leadership.name: Rachel Torres

all_classified.polished_summary: SeniorsList is dedicated to empowering seniors and their caregivers by providing expert reviews and comprehensive guides on essential products and services that enhance daily living. The company offers a range of resources, including evaluations of medical alert systems, hearing aids, home care services, senior-friendly cell phones, and Medicare guidance, all aimed at helping users make informed decisions tailored to their unique needs. With a focus on healthcare, senior care, and consumer electronics, SeniorsList strives to improve the quality of life for its target audience.

all_classified.company_summary: Seniorstrong is dedicated to enhancing the quality of life for seniors by providing comprehensive resources and support across various domains, including health and wellness, financial planning, and safety. The company offers guidance on aging in place, senior living options, and access to benefits, while also promoting social engagement and intergenerational connections. Targeting seniors and their caregivers, Seniorstrong aims to empower older adults to live independently and confidently.

# About Tech-enhanced Life

## Why This Work Exists

Understanding how aging actually unfolds, and how technology fits into that process, takes time.
Assumptions change as experience accumulates. What seems promising at first may prove disappointing,
while other ideas reveal value only after sustained use.

Tech-enhanced Life and the Longevity Explorers exist to explore these questions thoughtfully, over
time. We focus on lived experience, reflection, and synthesis, and on sharing not just conclusions,
but how and why our thinking evolves.

## Who We Are

> We are a (virtual) community of older adults, their friends, families, and caregivers — called the
> **Longevity Explorers**. We are exploring the future of aging, and the intersection of aging and
> technology.

Our mission is to **improve the quality of life of older adults and their families.**

## What We Do
* We create **insights for older adults** (published on this website and in our Newsletter) — with
an emphasis on pushing off the day at which getting older gets in the way of living life to the
full.
* We enable, and lead the [**Longevity Explorers**][241]: a unique sharing, evaluation, and ideation
community— made up of older adults (in their 60’s, 70’s, 80’s and 90’s), and their
friends, families, and caregivers.
* Sometimes, the community of Longevity Explorers also provide **advisory services for companies** —
who want to develop products and services that older adults actually want, need, and will pay a
premium for.

### The Underlying Idea

We believe that there is huge potential for development of clever new products and services that
will greatly improve the quality of life of all of us as we age.

**Unfortunately, all too often the people who understand the problems, and the people who could
solve those problems, inhabit different worlds.**

We wanted to bring these groups together and work collaboratively to identify and / or help create
new solutions to the challenge of living longer, with higher functionality — at costs that are
affordable to individuals and to nations.

# Get Advice: How to Proceed

We are happy to chat about whatever you would like.

If you would like to ask questions, or get a call scheduled with to discuss whatever you are working
on, go ahead and fill out the short set of questions, including your contact details, by clicking on
the link below.

[Fill out your details.][243]

### Some Guidelines

If all you want is some free advice, that is fine. But if that is what you want, please just say so.

If you want to learn more about what we do so you can decide if we can help your company, that is
fine too.

If you want to brainstorm about a specific project, and get to know how we think and approach
things, we love that sort of stuff.

**If you just want to pitch your product, but are not clear why, that is not so interesting.**

**The more specific you can be about what sort of help you are hoping for, the more likely we are to
have a productive interaction.**

# Archives: Solutions

Solution or potential solution to a "problem"

## [Reading Light for Vision Problems][241]

A chairside floor lamp with a long adjustable gooseneck including a handheld remote with brightness
and warmness for bright white to warm yellow light is a good solution for reading when you have
vision imperfections.

## [The Senior Moment Alexa Skill can remember this for your mother][242]

[ [The Senior Moment Alexa Skill can remember this for your mother] ][243]

One of the great things about Alexa is that she never gets tired of answering the same question. The
Alexa SkillSenior Moment may be the perfect fit for your mother's ATM location question. You can ask
the Skill to remember the perfect answer to that question. Then all your mother has to say
is, ***"Alexa, open Senior Moment."***

## [My Calls: an Alexa Skill for Coordinating Calls][244]

This Alexa skill helps your family members plan their calls so they reach you at times that are
convenient for you.

## [Instant Remote Music Playing][245]

Here is another solution that keeps your Alexa account and that of your parents separate, but still
allows you to start music in the house / room of a person with dementia when you want.

## [Using Alexa Routines to Translate the “How Long” Request][246]

This solution shows how to use Alexa Routines to answer the “Alexa, how long until lunch?” type
questions.

## [Remote Control for the Smoke Alarm][247]

If you, or your remote loved one, is capable of handling a mobile phone app under stressful
conditions, some smoke alarm providers such as Nest allow you to use the app to silence it.

IF… you can find your phone, unlock it, and open the app all during this stressful time.

## [Remote Control of the Other Person’s Camera for Video Call][248]

Don’t you wish you could adjust their camera so they don’t move out of the field of view during Zoom
calls? Well, you can.

## [Alexa Helps Me Recover My Memories][249]

As we age, we tend to forget not only where we leave physical items or upcoming events, but also
important memories such as names, past events, and locations. I found ways Alexa can help with that.

Modern medical alerts are empowering them to do it all and more, safely.

Medical alert devices give peace of mind to both the elderly who are wearing the devices and their
children, grandchildren, and caregivers, who only want what’s best for them.

# How Medical Alert Systems Work

You’ll find all sorts of medical alert devices out there, including wearable devices, wall-mounted
units, and voice-controlled systems. But they all work under the same basic premise: when you need
help, someone is there to respond. Here’s how it works in general:
* The user wears their medical alert device of choice
* If an emergency situation arises, they press the medical alerts button
* The on-call monitoring center will respond immediately, making contact with the wearer
* The responder will ask the user a few questions and decide which type of emergency response is
  appropriate for the situation
* The emergency monitoring agent will then dispatch the appropriate responder to your location and
  remain in contact until help has arrived

## Order with confidence with our 30-day money-back guarantees — no contract required.

30-day Money-Back Guarantee
If equipment is returned undamaged and fully functioning within the 30-day trial period (from date
of shipment to date of return), UnaliWear will provide a free return-shipping label and refund your
entire purchase, minus a $75 restocking fee.

## AARP and Military Veterans get one month FREE!

All AARP members and Military Veterans receive a FREE month added onto the end of the first year of
service (offers cannot be combined). Use coupon code **AARP** or **Veteran** during checkout (right
before you enter your credit card information) or mention it when ordering over the phone
(888-343-1513).

## Changing batteries on your Kanega watch band

## You have multiple watches in your cart.

If you want to order multiple watches, great! Otherwise, please click the cart icon and remove any
extras from your cart prior to checking out. Contact our sales line at [1-888-343-1513][38] if you
need assistance.

## Pre-Shipment Form & Configuration

Once your purchase and payment are complete, we will ask you to provide important information about
the person who will be wearing this Kanega watch and protected by our monitoring and emergency
response services, including:
* Wearer name and contact information
* Wearer band/wrist size
* Service address and access instructions
* WiFi settings
* Emergency contacts
* Medication reminder times (optional)
Our *Care & Safety Experts* will use this information to pre-program and personalize your watch so
that it arrives ready-to-use straight out of the box – **for no additional fee.**

## Your Kanega watch and equipment arrives fully—configured and ready-to-use straight out of the box
## — no programming required.

Our dedicated Care & Safety Experts ensure your Kanega watch arrives pre-programmed and personalized
with you or your loved ones:
* Emergency contacts
* Notification settings
* WiFi settings
* Optional medication reminders
* And more
After your purchase, we will ask you to provide important information about the wearer through a
simple pre-shipment online form. Then our Care & Safety Experts will take care of the rest. They
will also call once your Kanega watch is delivered to answer any questions you have about your
watch, accessories, subscription or services — and will remain available to ensure your watch is
working properly as long as you stay subscribed.

UnaliWear’s patented RealFall™ technology is based on actual fall data from Kanega Watch wearers and
gets smarter about each wearer’s personal movements over time— continuously improving fall detection
accuracy and limiting/eliminating false alerts. No other medical alert system offers this real
fall/related movement learning and continuous improvement technology. [Click here to learn
more.][39]

### Frequently Asked Questions
* What happens in an emergency—say I fall or my loved one falls? Where does the alert go? 911?
1. With the Kanega Watch, you have 3 ways to get help in an emergency–button, voice and fall
detection. All these alerts go to our US-based 24/7 monitoring center. The agent who receives
that alert will try and speak to the wearer through the watch. The agent will say “Hi, this is
X from UnaliWear, do you need help?”
2. If the wearer is responsive, the wearer can speak to the agent and direct whatever care is
needed; from “call my neighbor to help me off the floor” to “call EMS, Police or Fire” or even
“call my daughter and have her come over to get the blankets from the top of the closet” (this
really happened). The agent does what the wearer asks.
3. If the wearer is not responsive, the agent will call the wearer’s phone number and, if there is
no response, immediately call the first listed emergency contact (as listed in the wearer’s
profile) – we recommend that is someone who lives nearby. The agent will say “Hi this is X from
UnaliWear. We just received an alert from (wearer) and (wearer) is not responding. Are you able
to check on (wearer)?” Note: It’s not infrequent where the emergency contact is in the same
house as the wearer and didn’t know the wearer had fallen in the garage.
1. If the answer is no or if no emergency contacts answer the call, the agent will dispatch
local emergency services to the wearer’s location. The agent has the same access to EMS as
911 does, so it is not an extra call to 911, so it saves a step. In addition, the agent can
also provide EMS with the wearer’s medical info—such as medicine allergies, health
conditions, etc.; and, if the wearer is home, can even provide spare key location or lock
box info, so EMS does not have to break down the door. This ensures the EMS response can be
faster and more informed than a generic 911 dispatch.
4. If EMS is dispatched, the agent will inform all the emergency contacts via phone of what has
taken place. Note that our monitoring center agents call from the same phone number, so the
wearer and all emergency contacts can add this number to their phone contact list, so they know
it is not spam.

# Our Story

Our name derives from Cherokee: “Unalii” meaning “friend”, and “Kanega” meaning “speak” – so we are
the “friend that speaks to you.”
Jean Anne Booth thought she was sailing into the sunset. She’d spent 30 years working in
semiconductors and had sold businesses to Apple and Texas Instruments. But while working for a scuba
diving outfit off the coast of Florida, an idea burrowed into her head and wouldn’t leave. In the
end, it was her own mother who pulled her back to shore and into business.
Booth observed her elderly mother, and saw the vulnerability that old age can bring. She noted that
traditional medical alert systems are both ugly and socially stigmatizing, so many people avoid
getting much-needed medical alert systems. As a result, many don’t receive the care they need at
critical moments.

Faced with this challenge, Booth set out on a mission to create a smartwatch that can give
vulnerable populations greater independence. Her company, UnaliWear, has created the Kanega Watch,
the only watch with built-in Fall Detection that connects to emergency response agents 24/7/365.
Until her mother passed away in late 2018, Booth continued to run every prototype by her mother to
make sure her tech made sense in the real world (her mother had the title of “Senior Experience
Officer” – both literally and figuratively). That’s why the Kanega Watch is water-resistant, voice,
button and fall detection activated, and it never needs to be removed to charge (among other key
features) – providing real round-the-clock peace of mind for wearers and those that care for them.
Booth’s mother loved her Kanega Watch and the stylish, discreet protection it provided her and the
growing community of wearers throughout the country.

Our mission is to extend independence with dignity for millions of vulnerable people.
